title: Graphene-enabled dynamic H-J switching of dipole-dipole coupling
summary: Environmental modification of dipole interactions has long been explored in energy transport. Here we consider the effects of a tunable graphene monolayer upon nearly H-type or J-type molecular aggregates, concentrating on the inversion of one type of coupling to the other. Modelling the graphene as being deposited on a metallic substrate, we find that as the surface conductivity of the graphene is varied, there is a corresponding change in the parameter region over which coupling inversion is predicted. This provides a route towards observing the predicted coupling inversion in a real system by dynamically changing the surface conductivity during a single run of an experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可调谐石墨烯单层对近H型或J型分子聚集体中偶极相互作用的影响，重点关注一种耦合类型向另一种耦合类型的反转。研究发现，通过改变石墨烯的表面电导率，可以调控耦合反转发生的参数区域，为在真实系统中动态观察耦合反转提供了实验路径。
AI.motivation: 环境对偶极相互作用的修饰在能量传输研究中已被长期探索，但如何在真实系统中实现并观测耦合类型的反转仍是一个挑战，需要寻找可行的调控手段和实验路径。
AI.method: 将石墨烯建模为沉积在金属基底上，通过改变石墨烯的表面电导率来研究其对近H型或J型分子聚集体耦合类型反转的影响，分析反转预测对应的参数区域随表面电导率的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现，随着石墨烯表面电导率的变化，耦合反转预测所对应的参数区域也会相应改变，证明表面电导率是调控耦合反转的有效手段。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态改变石墨烯表面电导率，可以在单次实验运行中实现对耦合反转的观测，为在真实系统中验证耦合反转现象提供了可行途径。

title: Classical dipolar Heisenberg models on the Archimedean and Laves lattices
summary: We study classical Heisenberg spins interacting through the dipole--dipole interaction on the eleven Archimedean and eight Laves planar lattices at canonical geometry, which reduce to fifteen distinct vertex sets. For each lattice we compute the Fourier-space interaction matrix $\Am(\bk)$, extract the Luttinger--Tisza ordering wave vector $\bk_{0}$, determine the classical ground state by unconstrained minimization on the commensurate magnetic cell, and evaluate the linearized spin-wave dispersion $\varepsilon_{i}(\bk)$ along the high-symmetry path of the (magnetic) Brillouin zone together with the Holstein--Primakoff moment reduction. The ground states fall into three classes: five are collinear, two are non-collinear at angles commensurate with the lattice symmetry, and eight cant at transcendental angles, which we determine to thirty digits. Across the family, failure of the Luttinger--Tisza strong condition coincides exactly with the appearance of incommensurate canting, with no exceptions in either direction. Truncating the interaction range shows that whether a lattice cants is fixed by the local coordination geometry, whereas the value of the canting angle is set by the long-range tail. The quantum corrections are governed by the magnon spectrum through the size of the magnetic basis and are uncorrelated with frustration, so that the frustration and fluctuation classifications are independent; the corner-sharing lattices host the narrowest low-energy branches. The results constitute a spectral atlas of dipolar Heisenberg systems on the full family of $1$-uniform planar tilings and their duals, and provide predictions for inelastic neutron scattering in materials whose magnetic ions occupy Archimedean or Laves lattices, and for artificial arrays of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了偶极-偶极相互作用下的经典海森堡自旋系统，覆盖了全部十一种阿基米德平面晶格和八种拉维斯平面晶格（共归约为十五种不同的顶点集）。对每种晶格，作者计算了傅里叶空间相互作用矩阵，提取了Luttinger-Tisza（LT）序波矢，在相容磁胞上通过无约束极小化确定了经典基态，并评估了线性化自旋波色散和Holstein-Primakoff力矩缩减。研究发现基态分为三类：五种共线、两种以与晶格对称性相称角度非共线、八种以超越角度摆动（精确到三十位数字）。LT强条件失效与不相称摆动的出现精确吻合，无一例外。截断相互作用范围表明晶格是否摆动由局域配位几何决定，而摆动角数值由长程尾部设定。量子修正由磁基尺寸决定的磁振子谱主导，与阻挫不相关，即阻挫与涨落分类相互独立。
AI.motivation: 偶极相互作用在磁系统（尤其是纳米磁体阵列和磁性材料）中具有重要的物理意义，但此前缺乏对阿基米德和拉维斯平面晶格上偶极海森堡系统的系统性谱学分析。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立完整的谱学图谱，以理解晶格几何、阻挫、基态构型与量子涨落之间的关系，并为非弹性中子散射和人工偶极耦合纳米磁体阵列提供理论预测。
AI.method: 作者采用的分析方法包括：(1) 对每种晶格构造傅里叶空间相互作用矩阵；(2) 提取Luttinger-Tisza序波矢以进行初步基态判断；(3) 在相容磁胞上执行无约束极小化以获得精确经典基态；(4) 计算沿磁布里渊区高对称路径的线性化自旋波色散及Holstein-Primakoff力矩缩减；(5) 通过截断相互作用范围区分局域几何与长程尾部对摆动的影响。
AI.result: 基态可分为三类：五个共线构型，两个非共线但角度与晶格对称性相称的构型，以及八个以超越角度摆动的构型。LT强条件的失效与不相称摆动的出现完全一一对应。晶格是否摆动由局域配位几何决定，而摆动角的具体数值由长程相互作用尾部决定。角共享晶格具有最窄的低能磁振子分支。量子修正由磁基尺寸（即磁振子谱）主导，与阻挫无关，表明阻挫与涨落分类相互独立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为全部1-均匀平面镶嵌及其对偶晶格上的偶极海森堡系统提供了完整的谱学图谱，阐明了晶格几何、长程相互作用、阻挫与量子涨落之间的内在联系，并为实验研究（非弹性中子散射和人工偶极纳米磁体阵列）提供了理论预测基础。

title: Dipolar order across Bravais lattice space: classification, spin waves, and a four-attractor phase diagram
summary: Every crystal is a Bravais lattice decorated by a basis, so the dipolar ordering of the fourteen Bravais lattices is the natural starting point for any systematic theory of dipolar magnetism in three dimensions. We determine it here in a single common framework: the interaction tensor is Ewald-summed, the classical ground state is obtained by minimising the lowest Luttinger--Tisza band over the entire Brillouin zone, and the linear spin-wave spectrum with its zero-point corrections is computed for every lattice whose order is collinear. Three results emerge that are not properties of individual lattices but of the landscape. First, two structural principles --- the exact tracelessness of the dipolar tensor in three dimensions, and its identical vanishing at $\mathbf k=0$ for every cubic-symmetric lattice --- explain the ordering type, the absence of first-order cubic anisotropy, and the systematics of the zero-point moment reduction. Second, exactly one lattice defeats the Luttinger--Tisza construction: for face-centred orthorhombic the optimal eigenvector is not circular, the single-$\mathbf k$ state is a spin-density wave of non-constant length, and the tabulated energy is a strict lower bound; direct supercell minimisation gives the true ground state. Third, optimising each family over its free metric parameters collapses the whole of Bravais space onto only \emph{four} attractors, with body-centred tetragonal the global optimum and a single interior optimum at rhombohedral $α=62.42^\circ$ lying below face-centred cubic. Three independent published benchmarks are reproduced.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一框架下系统研究了三维空间中全部十四种Bravais晶格的偶极有序。通过Ewald求和计算相互作用张量、在整个布里渊区最小化最低Luttinger-Tisza能带获得经典基态，并对所有共线有序晶格计算线性自旋波谱及其零点修正。
AI.motivation: 每个晶体都是由Bravais晶格和基矢构成，因此十四种Bravais晶格的偶极有序是三维偶极磁性任何系统性理论的自然起点。此前缺乏一个统一框架来全面研究所有Bravais晶格的偶极磁有序。
AI.method: 采用统一框架：(1) 相互作用张量通过Ewald求和计算；(2) 通过在整个布里渊区最小化最低Luttinger-Tisza能带来确定经典基态；(3) 对每个共线有序晶格计算线性自旋波谱及零点修正。
AI.result: 三个关键结果：(1) 两个结构原理——三维偶极张量的严格无迹性以及所有立方对称晶格在k=0处张量的恒等消失——解释了有序类型、一阶立方各向异性的缺失和零点矩缩减的系统性规律；(2) 恰好一种晶格（面心正交）打破了Luttinger-Tisza构造，其最优本征矢量非圆对称，单k态为长度不恒定的自旋密度波；(3) 对每个族优化自由度量参数后，整个Bravais空间塌缩为仅四个吸引子，其中体心四方为全局最优，菱面体α=62.42°处存在一个低于面心立方的内部最优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了所有十四种Bravais晶格偶极有序的完整统一描述，揭示了三个超越单一晶格性质的"地貌级"结果，并成功复现了三个独立已发表的基准结果，为三维偶极磁性理论奠定了系统性基础。

title: FrOGS: Discrete Neural Sampler for Independent Alloy Configurations Across Chemical Conditions
comment: Submitted to the AI4Mat workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Predicting the thermodynamic properties of an alloy requires sampling its configurations across many chemical conditions and recovering free energies on a common absolute scale. Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is the standard tool, but it requires separate simulations at different conditions, and auxiliary free-energy methods such as thermodynamic integration are used to place results on a common absolute scale. Modern discrete neural samplers typically use reverse KL divergence as the objective and can be mode-seeking or biased. We present Free energy Offering Generative Sampler (FrOGS), a hybrid discrete neural sampler that couples an autoregressive model to a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) to be trained jointly under a single shared loss. FrOGS draws i.i.d. configurations, returns an unbiased estimate of the partition function, and gives consistent estimates of thermodynamic observables. We train a single model across a wide range of chemical conditions to produce estimates on a common absolute free-energy scale. FrOGS matches exact finite-size results on the 2D Ising model and reference phase diagrams for AgPd and CuAu, without mode collapse. We additionally compare to SEGAL, a published autoregressive baseline, and find that only FrOGS recovers the stability range of the CuAu$_3$ phase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FrOGS（自由能提供生成采样器），一种将自回归模型与连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）耦合的混合离散神经采样器，通过单一共享损失联合训练，能够生成独立同分布配置、无偏估计配分函数，并在宽化学条件下以统一绝对自由能标度给出热力学可观测量的一致估计。
AI.motivation: 合金热力学性质预测需要在多种化学条件下采样构型并以绝对标度恢复自由能。传统MCMC需在不同条件下分别模拟，并借助热力学积分等辅助自由能方法实现统一绝对标度。现有离散神经采样器通常以反向KL散度为目标，存在模式寻求或偏差问题，难以满足精确性与无偏性要求。
AI.method: FrOGS采用混合架构：将自回归生成模型与连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）结合，二者在同一共享损失函数下联合训练。该模型生成独立同分布构型，能够无偏估计配分函数，并给出热力学可观测量的统计一致估计；单一模型可在宽范围化学条件下训练，输出统一绝对自由能标度的结果。
AI.result: 在二维Ising模型上匹配精确有限尺寸结果，在AgPd和CuAu体系上复现参考相图且无模式坍塌。与已发表的自回归基线SEGAL对比，仅FrOGS能够恢复CuAu₃相的稳定区间。
AI.conclusion: FrOGS作为一种混合离散神经采样器，在效率和精度上均优于现有自回归基线，能够以单一模型覆盖宽化学条件并给出统一绝对标度上的热力学预测，是合金热力学性质预测的有力工具。

title: A Unified Description of Dirac-Cone Anisotropies in Two Dimensions
summary: Anisotropies in two-dimensional materials are responsible for a variety of effects that significantly modify their physical properties. In this paper, we present a covariant modification of the Dirac equation that incorporates anisotropies into the effective low-energy description around the Dirac point. The model is constructed by analogy with a Lorentz-violating extension of the Standard Model of elementary particles and yields a (2+1)-dimensional framework describing physical effects such as shifted, tilted, and distorted Dirac cones through its free parameters. The proposed model thus provides a general and unified framework in which distinct anisotropy-induced modifications of the Dirac spectrum and their combinations can be systematically characterized. We further apply the model to strained graphene and show that its effective parameters can be quantitatively extracted from first-principles electronic band structures while retaining a direct geometrical interpretation. These results establish a connection between the microscopic electronic structure and a material-independent effective description of anisotropic two-dimensional Dirac systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将各向异性引入二维材料狄拉克方程的协变修正模型，该模型类比标准模型中的洛伦兹对称性破缺扩展，通过自由参数统一描述偏移、倾斜和畸变的狄拉克锥，并成功应用于应变石墨烯，实现了从第一性原理电子能带结构中定量提取有效参数。
AI.motivation: 二维材料中的各向异性会显著改变其物理性质，但目前缺乏一个统一、普适的框架来系统描述狄拉克点附近各种各向异性诱导的效应（如锥体偏移、倾斜和畸变）及其组合。
AI.method: 类比粒子物理标准模型中的洛伦兹对称性破缺扩展，构建(2+1)维狄拉克方程的协变修正框架，通过自由参数表征不同类型的各向异性效应，并将其应用于应变石墨烯以验证模型的实用性。
AI.result: 模型能够通过自由参数统一描述偏移、倾斜和畸变的狄拉克锥；在应变石墨烯应用中，有效参数可从第一性原理电子能带结构中定量提取，同时保持直接的几何解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了微观电子结构与材料无关的各向异性二维狄拉克系统有效描述之间的联系，提供了一个系统表征不同各向异性诱导修饰及其组合的通用统一框架。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate for Oxygen Vacancy Dynamics in epitaxial $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$ on Si memristors via Dynamic Spectral Optimization
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for modeling semiconductor devices, yet standard architectures struggle with severe numerical stiffness and multiscale spatial discrepancies inherent to oxide heterostructures. Here, we demonstrate a cascaded PINN architecture coupled with a custom second-order Chebyshev second kind polynomial spectral optimizer (DSO V2 Hybrid) to model ion-electronic drift-diffusion transport in Pt/SrTiO$_3$/Si memristive heterostructures across a 20 nm STO film on a 380 $μ$m Si substrate. By isolating potential, carrier density, and vacancy transport into four sequentially trained sub-neural-networks, our model circumvents condition numbers exceeding $10^{16}$ without operator splitting. The trained surrogate reproduces experimental conductive-AFM current-voltage hysteresis ($R^2 > 0.96$) while ensuring strict Poisson consistency across continuous space. Compared to conventional finite-element solvers (e.g., COMSOL), the PINN surrogate enables differentiable inverse parameter estimation and linear time inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种级联物理信息神经网络（PINN）架构，结合自定义的二阶Chebyshev第二类多项式谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid），用于模拟Pt/SrTiO₃/Si忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子漂移扩散输运，成功规避了超过10¹⁶的条件数，并在导电AFM电流-电压滞回曲线预测上达到R²>0.96。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN架构难以处理氧化物异质结构中固有的严重数值刚性和多尺度空间差异（如20 nm STO薄膜与380 μm Si衬底的巨大尺度跨度），且常规方法面临条件数过高（>10¹⁶）的挑战。
AI.method: 采用级联PINN架构，将电势、载流子密度和空位输运解耦为四个顺序训练的子神经网络，并配合自定义的二阶Chebyshev第二类多项式谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid），无需算子分裂即可规避极端条件数问题。
AI.result: 训练后的代理模型能够复现实验导电AFM电流-电压滞回曲线（R²>0.96），并确保连续空间上的严格泊松一致性；相比传统有限元求解器（如COMSOL），PINN代理支持可微分的逆参数估计且推理时间为线性。
AI.conclusion: 级联PINN架构有效解决了半导体氧化物异质结构中的数值刚性与多尺度建模难题，为忆阻器件建模提供了兼具精度与效率的替代方案，并具备可微分的逆问题求解优势。

title: BU-MBAR: A hybrid solution strategy for the MBAR equations
summary: The multi-state Bennett acceptance ratio (MBAR) equations combine the data collected under different thermodynamic conditions in a statistically optimal way. Due to their practical importance, several solution strategies have been devised to optimize the convergence of the resulting set of coupled equations. However, even with graphics processing unit (GPU) acceleration, the convergence of these methods can still be either unstable or slow. We propose a new approach where the equations are interpreted as the limit of infinitesimal bin width of the respective weighted histogram analysis method (WHAM). In the proposed binned-to-unbinned MBAR (BU-MBAR) method, the bin width is adapted dynamically to ensure a stable and efficient convergence to the asymptotic solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的BU-MBAR方法，通过将MBAR方程解释为WHAM在无穷小bin宽度下的极限，并动态自适应bin宽度，以实现稳定且高效的收敛，解决了现有MBAR求解策略即使借助GPU加速仍存在不稳定或收敛慢的问题。
AI.motivation: MBAR方程在统计上最优地整合不同热力学条件下的数据，具有重要的实际意义。现有的求解策略虽然已有多种优化方案，但即使在GPU加速下，收敛过程仍然可能不稳定或收敛缓慢，因此需要一种新的、更稳健高效的求解方法。
AI.method: 作者将MBAR方程解释为加权直方图分析方法（WHAM）在bin宽度趋近于零时的极限。在此基础上提出binned-to-unbinned MBAR（BU-MBAR）方法，通过动态调整bin宽度，保证求解过程既稳定又能高效地收敛到渐近解。
AI.result: BU-MBAR方法能够实现稳定且高效的收敛到MBAR方程的渐近解，克服了现有方法在收敛稳定性或速度方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新颖的MBAR方程求解策略，通过连接WHAM与MBAR的理论框架并采用动态bin宽度自适应策略，为MBAR方程的数值求解提供了更稳定高效的替代方案。

title: Direct Validation of Superconductivity through Contact-Free Detection of Persistent Supercurrents Using Room-Temperature Quantum Magnetometry
summary: The accelerated emergence of new materials is driving the search for high temperature superconductors, but rapid experimental validation remains a critical bottleneck, particularly for microscopic samples under high pressure. Here, we demonstrate one-step direct superconductivity validation through room-temperature, contact-free detection of remnant supercurrents. The technique utilizes a cryogen-free optically pumped atomic magnetometer to detect the temperature-dependent magnetic field produced by supercurrents of a superconductor. The superconducting transition is directly identified by the abrupt disappearance of magnetic field from the remnant supercurrent above the transition temperature and the reversal of the supercurrent direction upon reversing the applied magnetic field. Validated on YBCO microcrystals and REBCO tape, this technique detects pico-Tesla magnetic fields from supercurrents induced by the ambient Earth's magnetic field in a millimeter-sized REBCO square disk, as well as from sub-100 micrometer YBCO microcrystals compatible with high-pressure diamond anvil cells. The use of a ferrite flux guide enables sensitive detection from centimeter-scale distances. Requiring no electrical contacts, magnetic coils, or integrated magnetic sensors, this non-invasive, room-temperature platform offers a scalable approach for high-throughput screening and validation of superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种室温、无接触、单步直接验证超导电性的新技术，利用无制冷剂的光泵原子磁力计检测超导体残余超电流产生的温度依赖磁场，从而直接识别超导转变。该技术在YBCO微晶和REBCO带材上得到验证，能检测皮特斯拉级磁场，适用于高压金刚石压砧条件，无需电接触或集成磁传感器，为超导材料的高通量筛选提供可扩展方案。
AI.motivation: 新材料加速涌现推动高温超导体探索，但快速实验验证仍是关键瓶颈，尤其是高压下微观样品的验证尤为困难。现有方法需要电接触或集成磁传感器，难以满足高通量筛选需求。
AI.method: 利用无制冷剂的光泵原子磁力计（optically pumped atomic magnetometer），在室温条件下无接触检测超导残余超电流产生的温度依赖磁场。通过超导转变温度以上残余超电流磁场的突然消失以及外加磁场反转时超电流方向的反转来直接识别超导转变。采用铁氧体磁通导引器实现厘米级距离的灵敏检测。
AI.result: 在YBCO微晶和REBCO带材上得到验证。该技术检测到毫米级REBCO方盘中由环境地磁场感应超电流产生的皮特斯拉级磁场，以及适用于高压金刚石压砧的小于100微米的YBCO微晶的磁场信号。
AI.conclusion: 该非侵入式室温检测平台无需电接触、磁线圈或集成磁传感器，为超导体的高通量筛选和验证提供了可扩展的方法，有望解决高压微观样品快速验证这一关键瓶颈。

title: Scaling Neural Network Quantum States for Ab Initio Quantum Chemistry
summary: Neural-network quantum states (NNQSs) can represent many-electron wave functions without explicitly enumerating the determinant space, but their accuracy depends jointly on model size and variational-optimization effort. Here we characterize this dependence for a physics-conditioned autoregressive NNQS trained separately on two six-molecule source benchmarks. Across eight model sizes and five optimization milestones, we find that model size and optimization steps jointly shape the energy error. The capacity advantage of larger models becomes more apparent with sufficient optimization, while the returns from additional optimization vary with model size. We capture this coupling using an interaction scaling law and quantify the cumulative compute of each evaluated configuration. The resulting error-compute Pareto frontiers provide a practical decision rule for jointly selecting model size and optimization steps under a given compute budget within the evaluated range. Furthermore, we find that this beneficial scaling trend persists during fine-tuning on held-out N$_2$. Pretrained models show decreasing error with increasing model size, with a steeper reduction following pretraining on the Hard benchmark. Together, these results place autoregressive neural quantum states within the broader landscape of empirical neural scaling and open a quantitative route toward the systematic scaling of neural quantum solvers for ab initio quantum chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了物理条件自回归神经网络量子态(NNQS)在从头算量子化学中的扩展行为，通过两个六分子基准数据集、八种模型规模和五个优化里程碑，揭示了模型规模与优化步数共同影响能量误差的耦合关系，提出交互扩展定律和误差-计算Pareto前沿用于在给定计算预算下联合选择模型大小与优化步数，并在N₂微调中验证了扩展趋势的保持性。
AI.motivation: 神经网络量子态可无需显式枚举行列式空间来表示多电子波函数，但其精度同时依赖模型规模和变分优化努力，两者如何共同影响精度尚不清楚，缺乏系统性的扩展规律指导。
AI.method: 在两种六分子源基准上分别训练物理条件自回归NNQS，扫描八种模型规模和五个优化里程碑，采用交互扩展定律捕捉模型规模与优化步数的耦合效应，量化每种配置的累积计算量并构建误差-计算Pareto前沿，同时在留出的N₂上进行微调验证。
AI.result: 模型规模与优化步数联合决定能量误差；更大模型的容量优势在充分优化后更明显，额外优化的收益随模型规模变化。导出Pareto前沿决策规则，且该扩展趋势在N₂微调中保持——预训练模型误差随规模增大而减小，Hard基准预训练后下降更陡峭。
AI.conclusion: 自回归神经网络量子态可置于经验神经扩展规律的更广阔图景中，为从头算量子化学中神经量子求解器的系统化扩展提供了定量路径。

title: Valley polarization dependence of candidate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in monolayer graphene
summary: We investigate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states in monolayer graphene, focusing on the experimentally observed filling fractions $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Owing to the approximate SU(4) symmetry arising from spin and valley degrees of freedom, graphene hosts a rich variety of multi-component fractional quantum Hall states with different polarization configurations. Using the Chern-Simons composite fermion framework for SU(4) systems, we construct candidate variational wave functions corresponding to distinct spin, valley, and mixed polarization states. The ground-state energies of these states are evaluated numerically using the Coulomb interaction in spherical geometry. By comparing energies across different polarization sectors, we identify the energetically favored configurations at $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Our variational energy comparison suggests that the energetically favored candidate states correspond to multi-component correlated quantum Hall liquids. Within the restricted family of trial states considered here, these states differ from a simple composite-fermion Fermi-sea description. These findings provide insight into the role of valley polarization and SU(4) symmetry in stabilizing even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in graphene.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单层石墨烯中偶分母分数量子霍尔态（ν=1/2和ν=1/4），利用Chern-Simons复合费米子框架构建了具有不同自旋、谷和混合极化构型的多组分变分波函数，并通过球面几何中的库仑相互作用数值比较各极化扇区的基态能量，识别出能量上更有利的候选态为多组分关联量子霍尔液体，有别于简单的复合费米子费米海描述。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯中因自旋和谷自由度构成的近似SU(4)对称性，可产生丰富的多组分分数量子霍尔态，但实验观测到的偶分母填充分数（ν=1/2和1/4）背后的具体极化构型和物理机制尚需阐明。
AI.method: 采用Chern-Simons复合费米子框架处理SU(4)系统，构建对应不同自旋、谷及混合极化状态的候选变分波函数；在球面几何下利用库仑相互作用对这些态的基态能量进行数值评估和比较。
AI.result: 变分能量比较表明，在ν=1/2和ν=1/4处能量上最有利的候选态对应于多组分关联量子霍尔液体，而非简单的复合费米子费米海态。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了谷极化与SU(4)对称性在稳定石墨烯偶分母分数量子霍尔态中的关键作用，为理解这类量子霍尔态的形成机制提供了新见解。

title: Battery open-circuit voltage is not purely chemical
summary: Open-circuit-voltage (OCV) curves are commonly treated as intrinsic chemical properties of electrode materials. However, this view is incomplete. In ion-insertion batteries, OCV also depends on mechanical state and microstructure. Using finite-element simulations and asymptotic analysis, we show that particle swelling and external loads promote particle--particle contact that generates compressive stresses, shifting the inserted-ion chemical potential. The OCV correction is nonlinear, follows Hertzian contact scaling, and depends on particle arrangement. Identical materials can therefore exhibit different OCV curves in different electrode microstructures. Furthermore, in full cells, electrodes are mechanically coupled through the common stack stress. Thus, cell OCV is a chemo-mechanical property of the entire battery architecture, not chemistry alone.

AI.tldr: 本文指出开路电压（OCV）并非电极材料纯粹的内在化学属性。通过有限元模拟和渐近分析，作者证明在离子插层电池中，颗粒膨胀和外部载荷会诱发颗粒间接触，进而产生压应力并改变嵌入离子的化学势，导致OCV发生非线性的、符合赫兹接触标度且依赖颗粒排列的修正。在全电池中，电极通过堆叠应力机械耦合，因此电池OCV是整个电池架构的化学-力学耦合属性。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将OCV曲线视为电极材料的内在化学性质，但这种认识是不完整的。在离子插层电池中，机械状态和微观结构同样影响OCV，需要修正这一认知框架。
AI.method: 采用有限元模拟和渐近分析两种手段，研究颗粒膨胀和外部载荷引起的颗粒间接触，分析其对嵌入离子化学势的影响以及由此产生的OCV修正。
AI.result: （1）OCV修正是非线性的，遵循赫兹接触标度规律，并依赖于颗粒排列方式；（2）相同材料在不同电极微观结构中会表现出不同的OCV曲线；（3）在全电池中，电极通过共同的堆叠应力发生机械耦合，因此OCV是整个电池架构的化学-力学性质。
AI.conclusion: OCV不能仅视为化学成分决定的量，而是受到机械状态和微结构影响的化学-力学耦合属性。电池OCV由整体架构（而非单一材料化学）决定。

title: Computing high-order mixed derivatives in physics-informed neural networks using multi-index Bell polynomials
summary: Physics-informed neural networks for high-order partial differential equations require mixed input derivatives and their gradients with respect to the network parameters. Standard implementations obtain an order-$K$ derivative by repeated automatic differentiation. We instead organize the forward recursion of the multivariate Faà di Bruno formula and its explicit backpropagation over a prescribed downward-closed set of multi-indices, with the Bell-polynomial convolutions tabulated once. The forward pass carries only the derivatives the differential operator requires. The backward pass propagates gradients from losses formed from any subset of them, including nonlinear products and coupled fields. Both recursions are exact up to roundoff and avoid nested computational graphs. An independent Taylor-jet implementation, symbolic checks of the test problems, and finite differences verify derivatives and loss gradients through order seven. On one CPU core, the method evaluates 330 mixed derivatives with respect to four inputs through order seven and the corresponding loss gradient without the memory failures observed for several nested implementations. Numerical tests include third-, fifth-, and seventh-order dispersive equations, incompressible flow, and a manufactured five-field electrohydrodynamic system. The seventh-order Zakharov-Kuznetsov test in $3+1$ dimensions has a relative solution error of $6\times10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于高阶偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络（PINN）实现方法，通过组织多元Faà di Bruno公式的前向递归和其显式反向传播，基于预定的下闭多指标集合构建，避免嵌套计算图，能够高效精确地计算高阶混合导数及其损失梯度。方法在七个CPU核心（原文单核）上单核即可评估300多个混合导数及对应梯度，并成功应用于三阶、五阶、七阶色散方程、不可压缩流和五场电流体动力学系统的数值测试。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN实现中，高阶偏微分方程（PDE）所需的混合输入导数需要通过重复自动微分（AD）获得，这会产生嵌套计算图，导致内存消耗大、计算效率低，甚至出现内存失败。需要一种更高效、精确的方法来计算高阶导数和损失梯度。
AI.method: 组织多元Faà di Bruno公式的前向递归及其显式反向传播：1) 在预定的向下闭集（downward-closed set）的多指标集合上进行计算；2) Bell多项式卷积只制表一次；3) 前向传播仅携带微分算子所需的导数；4) 反向传播从任意子集的损失（包括非线性乘积和耦合场）传播梯度；5) 避免嵌套计算图，两个递归都精确到舍入误差范围内。
AI.result: 通过独立的Taylor-jet实现、符号检查和有限差分验证了七阶导数和损失梯度。在单个CPU核心上，方法能够评估相对于四个输入的330个混合导数（达七阶）及相应损失梯度，而多个嵌套实现出现内存失败。数值测试包括三阶、五阶、七阶色散方程、不可压缩流和五场电流体动力学系统；七阶Zakharov-Kuznetsov测试（3+1维）的相对解误差为6×10⁻⁴。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种替代重复自动微分的高阶PINN导数计算方法，通过精确的显式递归避免了嵌套计算图的内存和效率瓶颈，能够处理高阶色散方程和复杂多场耦合系统，具有高精度和高计算效率的实用价值。

title: Doping dependence of local moments in infinite layer nickelates
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 82 references, 5 supplementary figures, 6 supplementary tables
summary: The infinite layer nickelates are notable for their lack of long-range antiferromagnetic ordering, in contrast to the parent compounds of the superconducting cuprates. Instead, the nickelates show evidence of short-range glassy behavior in both the undoped and optimally-doped regimes, implying that local electronic moments exist independent of superconductivity. However, the systematic doping-dependent magnetic behavior is not yet fully resolved, and characterizing it could uncover the relationship between local moments and the superconducting dome. In this work, we use muon spin rotation ($μ$SR) on a (La,Sr)NiO$_2$ doping series from the undoped parent compound, through the superconducting dome, to the over-doped normal state (Sr substitution 0% $\leq$ x $\leq$ 25%) to probe the magnetic ground state and the temperature-dependent static and dynamic behavior. We find that local moments experience spin freezing into a glassy state at temperatures on the order of a few tens of kelvin regardless of the doping level. We also observe a subtle destabilization of the glassy state with increased hole doping. These observations suggest that magnetism and superconductivity are largely decoupled phenomena with indirect interactions described in a multi-orbital framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过μSR技术系统研究了(La,Sr)NiO₂掺杂系列（0%-25%）的磁性基态，发现局部磁矩在不同掺杂水平下均在几十开尔文温度发生自旋冻结进入玻璃态，且空穴掺杂会轻微削弱玻璃态稳定性，表明磁性与超导性基本解耦。
AI.motivation: 无限层镍酸盐缺乏长程反铁磁有序，但在未掺杂和最佳掺杂区域均显示出短程玻璃态行为，表明存在独立的局域电子磁矩。然而，系统性的掺杂依赖磁性行为尚未完全阐明，理解这一点有助于揭示局域磁矩与超导穹顶之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用μSR技术系统探测(La,Sr)NiO₂掺杂系列样品（从未掺杂母体化合物、经过超导穹顶、到过掺杂正常态，Sr替代范围为0%至25%），表征磁性基态及温度依赖的静态和动态行为。
AI.result: 发现无论掺杂水平如何，局域磁矩都会在几十开尔文量级的温度下自旋冻结进入玻璃态；同时观察到空穴掺杂增加会使玻璃态发生轻微的失稳。
AI.conclusion: 这些观察表明，磁性和超导性在很大程度上是解耦的现象，二者的相互作用是间接的，需要在多轨道框架下加以描述。

title: Molecular Transferability of a Noble-Gas Coordinate for Electronegativity Equalization
comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Supporting Information and data/code archive included as ancillary files
summary: Charge-equilibration models predict how electrons redistribute over a molecule more cheaply than quantum chemistry, and each begins from a table of atomic electronegativities and hardnesses. A recent table replaces ionization energies and electron affinities with one geometric quantity: each main-group atom's fractional distance to the noble gas closing its row. Holding geometries, electrostatic damping and the molecule list fixed, we compare it with spectroscopic values, with its own kernel refitted, and with a quadratic control, over a primary set of fifty-two molecules and ions at the B3LYP/def2-TZVP level. Two structural consequences follow from the table construction rather than the equalization solver. Atoms at equal fractional distance receive identical electronegativities, so the dipole moments of chlorine monofluoride, iodine monobromide and sulfur dioxide vanish exactly, and the measured $0.72$ debye $\mathrm{HF}/\mathrm{HCl}$ gap is lost. Because the first period is excluded, hydrogen retains its spectroscopic electronegativity above every geometric value, reversing $\mathrm{O{-}H}$, $\mathrm{N{-}H}$ and hydrogen-halide polarity. Fitted alike, geometric and quadratic kernels agree to $0.0022$ electron per atom, so predictions are set by the fitted energy scales, not the kernel shape. Resolving the electronegativity scale period by period restores correct polarity in all five polyatomic heavy-atom-hydrogen tests.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了一种基于几何量（主族原子到行末惰性气体的分数距离）而非光谱值（电离能/电子亲和能）的新电负性表在电荷平衡模型中的表现，发现其几何构造本身导致偶极矩方向错误和氢键极性反转等结构性问题，并证明预测结果主要由拟合能量尺度决定而非核函数形状。
AI.motivation: 电荷平衡模型需要原子电负性和硬度表作为输入，传统的谱学参数（电离能与电子亲和能）计算成本高，因此近期有研究者提出仅用一个几何量——主族原子到其所在周期行尾惰性气体的分数距离——来替代这些谱学值。作者希望检验这种几何电负性表在电荷平衡模型中的实际预测能力与结构后果。
AI.method: 在固定几何构型、静电阻尼和分子列表的情况下，作者在52个分子和离子的B3LYP/def2-TZVP水平上进行对比实验。比较对象包括：几何电负性表、谱学值、Refitted核函数、以及二次型对照组。同时分析几何构造本身（等分距等电负性、排除第一周期）引发的结构后果，并通过分周期重新标定电负性尺度进行修复验证。
AI.result: 几何表构造导致三个结构性问题：(1) 等分数距离的原子电负性相同，使ClF、IBr和SO2偶极矩恰好为零，并丢失HF/HCl的0.72德拜差距；(2) 因排除第一周期，氢的电负性高于所有几何值，导致O-H、N-H及氢卤化物极性反转；(3) 拟合后几何与二次核函数在每原子0.0022电子误差内一致，说明预测由能量尺度而非核形状决定。分周期解析电负性尺度可恢复全部5个多原子重原子-氢测试的正确极性。
AI.conclusion: 几何电负性表的预测偏差主要源于表构造本身而非电荷平衡算法的求解过程。尽管核函数拟合后表现一致，但几何表在极化方向上的根本性缺陷需要通过分周期重新标定来解决，才能保留该方法的低成本优势同时纠正极性错误。

title: Orbital current rectifier and linear magnon Edelstein effect in $p$-wave antialtermagnets
summary: We show that $p$-wave magnets efficiently generate magnetization via a linear thermal Edelstein effect arising from the orbital magnetic moments of their magnons. Furthermore, they can generate perfectly nonreciprocal orbital currents through a purely even-order nonlinear response. This makes them promising candidates for orbital-current rectification. Because these transport phenomena originate from the orbital magnetic moment of magnons, they connect magnonics and orbitronics. More generally, we find that odd-parity-wave magnets with coplanar ground states host magnons with zero spin magnetic moment. Instead the magnons carry a collinear, out-of-plane orbital magnetic moment, realizing an orbital version of antialtermagnetism. We establish these general results using symmetry arguments and demonstrate them explicitly for a coplanar ground state with the minimal number of sublattices, inspired by the ground state of CeNiAsO. Our conclusions hold both in absence and presence of spin-orbit coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文发现p波磁体能通过磁振子的轨道磁矩产生线性的热Edelstein效应来实现高效磁化，并能通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，连接了磁振子学和轨道电子学。此外，具有共面基态的奇宇称波磁体中的磁振子携带零自旋磁矩但具有共线的面外轨道磁矩，实现了轨道版本的反对称反铁磁态。
AI.motivation: 探索p波磁体中磁振子相关的输运现象，特别是轨道磁矩引起的热Edelstein效应和非线性轨道电流整流，并揭示奇宇称波磁体中共面基态下磁振子的特殊磁矩特性，从而建立磁振子学与轨道电子学之间的联系。
AI.method: 使用对称性论证建立一般性结论，并以CeNiAsO基态启发的具有最少子格数的共面基态为具体模型进行显式演示。研究考虑了有无自旋轨道耦合两种情况。
AI.result: 发现：(1) p波磁体通过磁振子轨道磁矩产生线性热Edelstein效应，高效生成磁化；(2) 通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，可用于轨道电流整流；(3) 奇宇称波磁体的共面基态中磁振子具有零自旋磁矩但携带共线面外轨道磁矩，即轨道反反铁磁(orbital antialtermagnetism)。
AI.conclusion: p波磁体是轨道电流整流的候选材料，其磁振子输运现象连接了磁振子学与轨道电子学领域。这些结果在有无自旋轨道耦合下均成立，为开发新型自旋/轨道电子器件提供了理论依据。

title: Decoherence-controlled collective criticality in a two-dimensional quantum Stag Hunt
summary: Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality condition of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (\textit{EWL}) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice. For the restricted strategies $\mathsf{Q}=i\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathsf{D}=i\mathbb{Y}$, noisy two-player payoff matrices are determined for phase damping, depolarization, and amplitude damping and mapped exactly to channel dependent Ising parameters $\mathfrak{J}(Γ,p)$ and $\mathfrak{H}(Γ,p)$. Phase damping and depolarization show the clearest contrast: they share the same microscopic neutrality branch $\mathfrak{H}=0$, while only depolarization suppresses the interaction as $(1-p)^2$. At $β=1$, this produces an exact depolarization-driven square-lattice critical point at $p_{*}\approx 0.233460\ldots$, whereas phase damping remains in the ordered coexistence regime along the same neutrality branch. Monte Carlo finite size scaling is consistent with two-dimensional Ising criticality and distinguishes field driven coexistence below $p_{*}$ from a smooth crossover above it. Amplitude damping additionally reveals a strong dependence on channel placement: the post-strategy neutrality branch reaches $Γ=0$ at $p=1/3$ and then disappears. Resource negativity further shows that microscopic two-qubit entanglement and collective interaction strength are distinct quantities. The resulting extended lattice remains an ordinary classical Ising system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究量子退相干如何影响嵌入方格上的EWL Stag Hunt量子博弈。研究发现物理退相干能保持微观策略中立条件，同时改变对应相互作用群体的热力学状态。通过将噪声双人收益矩阵精确映射为依赖于信道的Ising参数，作者揭示了相位阻尼与退极化在热力学行为上的显著差异：退极化在β=1时产生精确的方格临界点（p*≈0.233460），而相位阻尼停留在有序共存区域。Monte Carlo有限尺寸标度与二维Ising临界性一致。
AI.motivation: 探索量子博弈在真实环境（存在退相干）下的行为，理解微观量子性质（策略中立性）与宏观集体热力学行为之间的联系与区别，特别是验证量子噪声通道如何影响从微观博弈到宏观统计力学模型的映射。
AI.method: 将EWL Stag Hunt博弈嵌入方格作为独立最近邻相互作用，限制策略为Q=iZ和D=iY。针对相位阻尼、退极化和振幅阻尼三种噪声通道，计算噪声双人收益矩阵，并精确映射为依赖于信道的Ising参数J(Γ,p)和H(Γ,p)。使用Monte Carlo有限尺寸标度分析相变行为。
AI.result: 相位阻尼和退极化共享相同的微观中立分支H=0，但只有退极化以(1-p)²方式抑制相互作用。在β=1时退极化产生精确的方格临界点p*≈0.233460，相位阻尼保持有序共存。振幅阻尼依赖通道位置：后策略中立分支在p=1/3时达到Γ=0后消失。资源负性表明微观两量子比特纠缠与集体相互作用强度是不同的量。该扩展晶格仍是普通经典Ising系统。
AI.conclusion: 量子退相干通道的类型可以仅通过影响宏观热力学而保留微观博弈结构（策略中立性），两者是分离的。量子博弈的统计力学实现本质上仍为经典Ising系统，但噪声通道的选择决定了群体水平上的相行为，展示了微观量子信息与宏观集体现象之间丰富而微妙的联系。

title: IDMate: Window-resolved self-consistent-field proposal screening with finite-temperature response bounds
summary: We introduce IDMate, a Kohn--Sham framework for screening approximate self-consistent-field (SCF) states with a finite-temperature response bound and deterministic reference-map recovery. A charge-neutral factorization separates electronic conditioning from mixer amplification, while fixed-point-preserving rank-one interventions test their roles in the linearized dynamics. For a fixed Hamiltonian, exact electron number, and temperature, strong convexity of the Mermin free-energy functional yields an a posteriori density-matrix bound in a selected spectral window. Across $3{,}586$ stress trials, $1{,}942$ proposals were accepted and none exceeded the window criterion. Under trial independence, the one-sided $95\%$ zero-event upper bound is $8.4\times10^{-4}$; treating the 70 correlated ladders as independent units gives $4.2\times10^{-2}$ per ladder. In three reference configurations, the integrated screening rule replaced ten reference-map evaluations, reproduced the reference-scoring trajectories, and satisfied every terminal comparison criterion. Window and full-space deviations differ by six to eleven orders of magnitude; full-space distance classifies the window decisions with a descriptive pooled AUC of $0.694$ (row-bootstrap $95\%$ interval $[0.544,\,0.831]$). A predefined cross-lineage work model does not meet its acceptance criterion, and serial proposal construction makes the production implementation $7.87$ times as costly under the predefined charged-cost accounting as its all-reference counterfactual. IDMate establishes a rigorous exact-trace window bound, a tested accept-or-recover rule, and explicit full-space and implementation targets for net acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDMate，一种Kohn-Sham框架，用于筛选近似自洽场（SCF）状态，具有有限温度响应界限和确定性参考图恢复机制。通过电荷中性分解和保持不动点的秩一干预来测试电子条件与混合器放大的作用，并利用Mermin自由能泛函的强凸性推导出后验密度矩阵界限。实验表明该框架在3,586次压力试验中表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 近似自洽场（SCF）计算在材料科学和量子化学中广泛使用，但其收敛性缺乏严格的数学保证。研究者希望建立一种能够筛选SCF状态、提供有限温度响应界限，并能在失败时确定性恢复参考图的框架，以确保计算结果的可靠性和可验证性。
AI.method: 采用Kohn-Sham框架，通过电荷中性因子分解将电子条件与混合器放大分离；执行保持不动点的秩一干预以在线性化动力学中测试其作用；对固定哈密顿量、精确电子数和温度条件，利用Mermin自由能泛函的强凸性推导选定谱窗口中的后验密度矩阵界限；采用集成筛选规则替代参考图评估。
AI.result: 在3,586次压力试验中，1,942个提案被接受且无一超过窗口标准。在试验独立性下，单侧95%零事件上限为8.4×10⁻⁴；将70个相关阶梯作为独立单元则为4.2×10⁻²每阶梯。窗口与全空间偏差相差6到11个数量级；全空间距离描述性池化AUC为0.694（行自举95%区间[0.544, 0.831]）。预定义的跨谱系工作模型未达到接受标准，串行提议构建使生产实现成本比全参考反事实高7.87倍。
AI.conclusion: IDMate建立了严格的精确迹窗口界限、经过测试的接受或恢复规则，并明确了全空间偏差和实现层面的净加速目标。尽管存在实现成本较高和跨谱系工作模型未达标的问题，但该框架提供了可验证的SCF状态筛选方法。

title: Stochastic Operator Inference for reduced-order modeling of capillary wave turbulence using experimental measurements
summary: Modeling complex physical phenomena directly from experimental data poses fundamental challenges: measurement devices introduce noise and biases into the data, the governing equations are often unknown or intractable, and the dynamics observed experimentally may exhibit stochastic behavior. In this paper, we consider capillary wave turbulence---an example of nonlinear wave interactions at a microfluidic interface---measured by ultra-high-speed digital holographic microscopy. With the goal to learn an efficient model directly from these data, we adapt a stochastic extension of Operator Inference to learn low-dimensional stochastic differential equation representations of the microscale wave dynamics from experimental measurements. Each experiment is repeated 16 times, and 10 different conditions are created by changing the nondimensional acoustic capillary number through an excitation device. In addition, we propose a new strategy to select the reduced-order model dimension, based on both mean and covariance errors. We further add Tikhonov regularization to the stochastic Operator Inference framework and show that, beyond its conventional role as a numerical stabilization technique in deterministic settings, it has a physically meaningful interpretation as controlling the spectral content of the learned stochastic dynamics. We demonstrate that the resulting stochastic reduced-order models faithfully capture salient physical features of capillary wave turbulence across a range of experimental conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文从高速数字全息显微镜实验数据中，通过随机扩展的Operator Inference方法学习毛细波湍流的低维随机微分方程模型，并提出了基于均值和协方差误差的降阶模型维度选择策略以及带有物理意义的Tikhonov正则化方法。
AI.motivation: 直接从实验数据建模复杂物理现象面临三大挑战：测量设备引入噪声和偏差、控制方程未知或难以处理、实验观测可能表现出随机行为。因此需要一种能够从数据中直接学习高效模型的方法。
AI.method: 1. 将Operator Inference扩展为随机形式，学习低维随机微分方程表示微尺度波动力学。2. 提出基于均值和协方差误差的新型降阶模型维度选择策略。3. 在随机Operator Inference框架中加入Tikhonov正则化，并赋予其物理意义——控制所学随机动力学的频谱内容。
AI.result: 所得到的随机降阶模型能够忠实地捕获毛细波湍流在多种实验条件下的关键物理特征。实验设计包含16次重复实验，以及通过改变无量纲声学毛细数产生的10种不同实验条件。
AI.conclusion: 随机Operator Inference结合所提出的维度选择策略和Tikhonov正则化方法，能够有效地从实验测量数据中学习出可泛化的随机动力学模型，且正则化在随机框架中具有超越数值稳定性的物理含义。

title: Tunable Chern superconductivity of PtBi$_2$ in slab geometry
summary: Recent experiments indicate that PtBi$_2$ is a Weyl semimetal whose surfaces become topological superconductors with i-wave gap symmetry at low temperature. The bulk hosts 12 Weyl cones while in the superconducting state each of the two surfaces hosts in addition 6 Majorana cones. We study a simplified model in a slab geometry, where the finite thickness gaps out the bulk Weyl cones and leaves the surface Majorana cones as the low-energy degrees of freedom. We identify two competing mechanisms that gap these cones: inter-cone hybridization opens a trivial gap, whereas a Zeeman field opens a nontrivial one. In the nontrivial regime, chiral Majorana edge modes connect the gapped cones. We determine their wavefunction profile and relate it to the momentum-space distribution of the cones. Mapping out the phase diagram, we find both trivial and nontrivial regions in the quasi-two-dimensional limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究PtBi2超导体表面Majorana锥的稳定性问题，在有限厚度的slab几何中，识别出两种竞争机制（锥间杂化打开平庸能隙，塞曼场打开非平庸能隙），并绘制了准二维极限下的完整相图。
AI.motivation: 实验表明PtBi2是一种Weyl半金属，其表面在低温下成为具有i-wave能隙对称性的拓扑超导体，每个表面拥有6个Majorana锥。理解这些Majorana锥在简化模型中的稳定性及其能隙机制对于揭示该体系的拓扑性质至关重要。
AI.method: 作者在slab几何中建立简化模型，利用有限厚度使体Weyl锥被gap掉，仅保留表面Majorana锥作为低能自由度。研究两种作用机制：（1）锥间杂化导致平庸能隙；（2）塞曼场打开非平庸能隙。通过映射相图分析准二维极限下的拓扑区域。
AI.result: 发现系统存在两种竞争机制：锥间杂化打开平庸能隙，而塞曼场打开非平庸能隙。在非平庸区域中，手性Majorana边缘模连接被gap的锥体，作者确定了这些边缘模的波函数分布并将其与锥体在动量空间的分布关联起来。相图中同时存在平庸和非平庸区域。
AI.conclusion: 在PtBi2表面超导体的准二维极限下，Majorana锥的稳定性取决于锥间杂化与塞曼效应之间的竞争，非平庸拓扑相可通过塞曼场实现，其特征是手性Majorana边缘模的出现。

title: Enumerating Chemical Structures, Stereoisomers, and Stereogenic Units with Analytic Combinatorics
comment: Submitted to J. Math. Chem. 27 pages, 7 figures
summary: The enumeration of chemical structures traditionally relies on graph- and group-theoretic techniques, including Pólya theory, in order to account for stereochemical symmetries. These methods require bespoke derivations and methods for each molecular family of interest, and quickly become very intricate for nontrivial classes. In this work, we demonstrate that analytic combinatorics provides a unifying, highly extensible, and relatively simple framework for enumeration problems. Using the symbolic method, we show that classical counting problems, such as the enumeration of acyclic alkanes and other hydrocarbon families, can be naturally solved via concise combinatorial specifications of the class of interest. We first demonstrate the simplicity of this approach by replicating existing results in this framework, requiring significantly less work than previously necessary, and then extend these ideas to more complex problems, counting broader classes of molecules accounting for both tetrahedral and E/Z stereoisomerism, counting the distribution of stereogenic units, and enumerating achiral and meso compounds. All results are made reproducible through CombOL, our open-source software package which automates the translation of combinatorial specifications into generating functions using the symbolic method, and performs both univariate and multivariate enumeration.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了解析组合学（analytic combinatorics）可作为化学结构计数的统一且高度可扩展的框架。作者利用符号方法（symbolic method）将经典问题（如无环烷烃和烃类家族的计数）转化为简洁的组合规格，并扩展到更复杂的情况，包括四面体和E/Z立体异构体计数、立体单元分布统计，以及非手性和内消旋化合物的枚举。所有结果通过开源软件CombOL实现可复现。
AI.motivation: 传统化学结构计数依赖图和群论技术（如Pólya理论），需要为每个分子家族进行定制推导，对于非平凡结构类变得非常复杂。作者旨在提供一个统一、可扩展且相对简单的框架来替代这些繁琐的方法。
AI.method: 采用解析组合学的符号方法，将分子类别表示为简洁的组合规格（combinatorial specifications），自动翻译为生成函数进行单变量和多变量枚举。同时开发了开源软件包CombOL来自动化这一过程。
AI.result: 成功复现了经典计数结果（如无环烷烃等），且工作量显著减少；将框架扩展到更复杂的问题，包括计数包含四面体和E/Z立体异构的更广泛分子类别、统计立体单元的分布，以及枚举非手性和内消旋化合物。
AI.conclusion: 解析组合学为化学结构计数提供了一个统一且易于扩展的框架，较传统方法大幅简化了推导过程，并通过CombOL软件实现了结果的完全可复现性。

title: Tuning Andreev reflection and conductance in proximitized nanowires through the spin-orbit field direction
summary: We investigate the Andreev reflection (AR) and the nonlinear conductance in a normal-superconductor junction realized with a proximitized semiconductor nanowire exposed to a magnetic field along its axis. We show that, while at zero energy the AR coefficient is determined by the topological phase of the superconducting side of the junction, at finite energy the AR is strongly affected by the directions of the Rashba spin-orbit field characterizing the normal and the proximitized sides. The tunability of the AR and the nonlinear conductance as a function of the spin-orbit misalignment angle is particularly pronounced when the proximitized side is in the topologically trivial phase. The spin-orbit field direction is revealed to be an efficient knob to control the electron transport through the hybrid junction, realizing an electrically widely tunable device. The implementation in realistic setups is discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由近邻化半导体纳米线构成的正常-超导结中的安德烈夫反射和非线性电导，发现自旋轨道场方向是控制电子输运的有效手段。
AI.motivation: 探索通过自旋轨道场方向（而非仅依赖拓扑相变）来调控正常-超导结中安德烈夫反射和非线性电导的可行性，以期实现可广泛电调谐的器件。
AI.method: 对轴向磁场下的近邻化半导体纳米线组成的NS结，分别分析零能量下AR系数与拓扑相的关系，以及有限能量下AR受正常侧与近邻化侧Rashba自旋轨道场方向（错配角）的影响。
AI.result: 零能量下AR系数由超导侧拓扑相决定；有限能量下AR强烈依赖于两侧自旋轨道场方向。当近邻化侧处于拓扑平庸相时，AR和非线性电导对错配角的角度调谐尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 自旋轨道场方向可作为控制混合结电子输运的高效调控旋钮，能实现电学上广泛可调的器件，并讨论了在现实实验装置中的实现方案。

title: Antiferromagnetism-altered plasmon dynamics
summary: The interaction between plasmons and magnons is a long-sought phenomenon with implications for fundamental physics and spintronics applications. In three-dimensional systems, this coupling is suppressed by the large mismatch in energy scales, but two-dimensional (2D) plasmons with gapless dispersion can overlap with magnons over a broad spectral range. Despite numerous theoretical predictions, experimental observation of magnon-plasmon interaction has remained elusive. In this work, we study a first-of-its-kind hybrid plasmon-magnon platform based on 2D materials. By deploying scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) with terahertz radiation, we image propagating plasmon wavepackets at a graphene/NiPS$_3$ interface and track their dynamics across the antiferromagnetic transition of NiPS$_3$. We observe a clear renormalization of the plasmon-polariton dispersion concurrent with the onset of antiferromagnetic order. With complementary Raman scattering and nano-terahertz spectroscopy, we unveil spectral weight redistribution and dielectric screening changes, potentially associated with the multi-magnon continuum, as the underlying mechanism. These results provide solid evidence of coupling between plasmon and antiferromagnetic order, marking a cornerstone for a potential platform for hybrid magnon-plasmon interactions in 2D materials, opening avenues for coherent spin-plasmon devices and tunable terahertz spintronic components.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次在二维材料（石墨烯/NiPS₃界面）中实现了等离激元-磁振子混合平台，通过太赫兹s-SNOM成像观测到跨NiPS₃反铁磁转变的等离激元波包传播，并观察到与反铁磁序起始同步的等离激元-极化激元色散重整化，为二维材料中磁振子-等离激元耦合提供了坚实实验证据。
AI.motivation: 磁振子与等离激元的相互作用在基础物理和自旋电子学中有重要潜力，但三维体系中因能量尺度不匹配而受到抑制。虽然二维等离激元理论上可以与磁振子重叠，但实验观测长期缺失，亟需实验平台验证该耦合。
AI.method: 研究者构建了基于二维材料的混合等离激元-磁振子平台：采用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）结合太赫兹辐射，在石墨烯/NiPS₃界面成像传播的等离激元波包，并追踪其跨NiPS₃反铁磁转变的动力学过程；辅以互补的拉曼散射和纳米太赫兹光谱分析介电屏蔽和光谱权重变化。
AI.result: 观察到等离激元-极化激元色散在与NiPS₃反铁磁序起始同步出现明显重整化；拉曼散射和纳米太赫兹光谱揭示了光谱权重再分布和介电屏蔽变化，可能与多磁振子连续谱相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为等离激元与反铁磁序之间的耦合提供了有力证据，标志着二维材料中混合磁振子-等离激元相互作用的基石性平台，为相干自旋-等离激元器件和可调谐太赫兹自旋电子组件开辟了道路。

title: Constituent-Tagged Transfer Linking Cluster Dynamics to Static Scaling
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material: 6 pages, 1 figure, and 3 tables
summary: Clusters that merge and split have no unique genealogy. Tracking the host size of a conserved constituent defines $q_*$ by $\langle(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}\rangle=1$, with $q_*\ne0$. Across coupled map networks, coagulation-fragmentation dynamics, and Vicsek systems, $q_*\simeqα-2$ without fitting, where $c(s)\propto s^{-α}$ on the same size window. Radius scans locate the known Vicsek interaction radius and recover an independently specified clustering scale in experimental active rods. Local scale covariance yields the relation, while a tent map counterexample shows when reducing the stationary balance at each parent size to one moment fails.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一个无需拟合的普适标度关系：对于发生合并与分裂的团簇系统，跟踪守恒组分的宿主大小可定义q_*（通过⟨(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}⟩=1，且q_*≠0）。在耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂动力学和Vicsek系统中，q_*≈α−2成立（无需任何拟合参数），其中c(s)∝s^{−α}定义在同一尺寸窗口上。该关系通过局部标度协方差推导得出，并可用帐篷映射构造的反例说明当将每个母体尺寸的稳态平衡简化为单一矩时该关系何时失效。
AI.motivation: 传统的团簇尺寸分布指数α可用于描述系统的团簇统计，但缺乏一个能够刻画"宿主-组分"层级关系的独立标度量。作者希望找到一种超越尺寸分布的新方法，来预测和描述合并-分裂动态系统中团簇的随机演化特征，特别是利用守恒组分的宿主尺寸追踪来获得独立的普适指数q_*。
AI.method: 通过定义守恒组分的宿主尺寸追踪算子q_*（满足⟨(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}⟩=1），作者系统地检验了三种不同系统：耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂动力学和Vicsek自组织系统，并提取了团簇尺寸分布c(s)∝s^{−α}。通过半径扫描实验验证了Vicsek相互作用半径和实验活性棒的独立设定的聚类尺度，并用局部标度协方差理论推导了q_*≈α−2的关系，最后用帐篷映射构造反例来说明该关系的适用边界。
AI.result: 在所有测试系统中，q_*与α−2高度吻合，且不需要任何拟合参数。半径扫描能准确定位已知的Vicsek相互作用半径并恢复实验活性棒中独立设定的聚类尺度。局部标度协方差理论成功地推导出了该关系，而帐篷映射反例揭示了该关系成立的条件限制。
AI.conclusion: q_*≈α−2是一个跨系统普适且无需拟合的标度关系，它通过宿主尺寸追踪给出了团簇尺寸分布之外的独立、互补的标度信息。该关系可作为一种新的分析工具应用于广泛的自组织动态系统中，但其适用性受限于每个母体尺寸的稳态平衡是否能被单一矩充分描述。

title: Interplay between Isomerization and Spin Crossover in 1D Fe-Indigo Coordination Polymers on Ag substrates
summary: Spin-crossover (SCO) compounds offer a route to switchable molecular functionality in reduced dimensions. However, one-dimensional (1D) SCO chains, which offer the possibility to study ligand fields other than the paradigmatic octahedral field, remain comparatively little studied. Here, we use first-principles density functional theory (DFT+$U$) to investigate Fe-indigo coordination-polymer chains synthesized experimentally on Ag(111) and Ag(100) substrates. These display a rich interplay between changes in ligand field (isomerization) and spin crossover. On-surface isomerization on Ag(111) interconverts (N,O)-chelated \textit{trans} configuration and (N,N)-/(O,O)-chelated \textit{cis} configurations at the Fe centers. The lowest-energy \textit{trans} and \textit{cis} solutions on Ag(111) have different spin configurations over the interval $0.66<U<3.00$~eV. At the reference value $U=1$~eV, the preferred \textit{trans} solution is the mixed LS--LS--HS configuration, whereas the preferred \textit{cis} solution is LS--LS--LS. The experimentally observed preference for \textit{cis} chains on Ag(111) and \textit{trans} chains on Ag(100) is reproduced for the range $0.88<U<3.75$~eV. To interpret these results, toy models and spin-resolved Fe $3d$ projected densities of states are used, while freestanding-chain calculations reveal a strain-sensitive LS--HS competition. These results provide a microscopic explanation for isomerization-controlled spin-state switching in a 1D coordination polymer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理DFT+U计算，系统地研究了在Ag(111)和Ag(100)基底上合成的Fe-靛蓝一维配位聚合物链，揭示了配体场异构化与自旋交叉之间的复杂相互作用，为异构化控制的自旋态切换提供了微观解释。
AI.motivation: 自旋交叉(SCO)化合物在低维体系中提供可切换的分子功能途径，但一维SCO链研究相对较少，特别是除了典型八面体配体场之外的其他配体场构型尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论(DFT+U)，对Ag(111)和Ag(100)基底上实验合成的Fe-靛蓝配位聚合物链进行系统计算。分析了trans（N,O-螯合）和cis（N,N-/(O,O)-螯合）两种构型的自旋态能量竞争，结合玩具模型、自旋分辨的Fe 3d投影态密度以及自由链应变计算进行解释。
AI.result: 在Ag(111)上，最低能量的trans和cis解在0.66<U<3.00 eV区间呈现不同自旋构型。参考值U=1 eV时，trans优先为混合LS-LS-HS构型，而cis为LS-LS-LS。实验观测的Ag(111)偏好cis链、Ag(100)偏好trans链在0.88<U<3.75 eV范围内被复现。
AI.conclusion: 结果为一维配位聚合物中由异构化控制的自旋态切换提供了微观解释，表明配体场异构化与基底效应共同调控了自旋交叉行为。

title: Spectral and Eigenvector Crossovers in Random Mixed Graphs
summary: We study the spectral and eigenvector properties of random mixed graphs, combining undirected and directed interactions, using random matrix theory (RMT). The network is represented by a Hermitian adjacency matrix, with undirected links as real entries and directed links as purely imaginary conjugate pairs, ensuring a real spectrum. Network density is controlled by the connection probability, while directionality sets the fraction of directed edges. We focus on the GOE-to-GUE crossover: at fixed connectivity, increasing directionality breaks time-reversal symmetry and drives spectral statistics from GOE to GUE. We show that this transition requires sufficient connectivity. In sparse networks, weak level repulsion produces Poisson statistics regardless of directionality. At fixed directionality, increasing connectivity drives a Poisson-to-GUE crossover; only above a sparsity threshold does the directionality-induced GOE-to-GUE transition emerge. In the dense regime, where the spectral density follows the Wigner semicircle law, the crossover is characterized using spacing distributions, spacing ratios, and spectral rigidity. In sparse networks, where unfolding is unreliable, spacing-ratio statistics provide an unfolding-free characterization. Eigenvector structure is examined through multifractal dimensions and component distributions, while Kullback--Leibler divergence confirms the robustness of the transitions. Applied to S&P 500 mixed graphs, the framework reveals a GOE-to-GUE crossover across four major market crashes. Denser crisis periods show sharper crossovers than sparser recovery periods. The results provide a unified picture of how connectivity and symmetry breaking govern spectral and eigenvector universality, while providing a transparent probe of changing financial-market organization.

AI.tldr: 本文利用随机矩阵理论研究混合随机图（同时包含无向与有向交互）的谱与特征向量性质，揭示连接性与方向性如何协同驱动GOE-GUE及泊松-GUE跃迁，并将该框架应用于S&P 500市场崩溃分析。
AI.motivation: 理解网络拓扑（连接性）与方向性（对称性破缺）如何共同影响谱统计与特征向量普适性，并希望提供一个可应用于金融等真实网络的统一分析框架。
AI.method: 采用厄米邻接矩阵表示混合图（无向边为实数元，有向边为纯虚数共轭对），通过连接概率控制密度、方向性分数控制有向边比例，分别研究GOE-GUE跃迁（固定连接性下增大方向性）与泊松-GUE跃迁（固定方向性下增大连接性），采用间距分布、间距比、谱刚性、多重分形维数及KL散度等工具分析，并应用于S&P 500真实数据。
AI.result: 发现GOE-GUE跃迁需要足够的连接性；稀疏网络中无论方向性如何均呈现泊松统计。稠密区谱密度符合维格纳半圆律，跃迁可用多种统计量刻画；稀疏网络需使用无需展开的间距比统计。应用于S&P 500发现四次市场崩溃均呈现GOE-GUE跃迁，且更稠密的危机期比稀疏恢复期展现出更尖锐的跃迁。
AI.conclusion: 连接性与对称性破缺共同决定了谱和特征向量普适性，该框架为检测金融市场组织结构的变化提供了透明探针。

title: A Superconducting Peierls Instability
comment: Main text: 11 pages, 5 figures; Methods: 7 pages, 1 figure; Supplementary Material: 12 pages, 5 figures
summary: The Peierls instability is a foundational mechanism in condensed matter physics, showing how the electron--phonon interaction can transform a simple metal into an insulating state with a new lattice periodicity. In a one-dimensional (1D) metal the Peierls instability follows from the enhanced electronic response at wavevector $Q=2k_F$ (connecting the Fermi points) producing a Kohn anomaly: a softening of the phonon mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates the tell-tale Peierls periodic lattice distortion and charge-density wave (CDW) that gaps the electronic spectrum. Here we show an analogous instability at the edge of a two-dimensional (2D) superconductor, where a dispersing Andreev bound state (ABS) hosts Bogoliubov Fermi points at $\pm k_c$. The enhanced quasiparticle response at the connecting wavevector $Q=2k_c$ couples directly to pairing-fluctuations and produces a superconducting Kohn anomaly: a softening of a pairing mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates an edge pair-density wave (PDW) that gaps the ABS. We refer to this as a superconducting Peierls instability and identify the boundary quasiparticle structure that enables it. As a concrete realization, we consider a square-lattice extended Hubbard model whose mixed-symmetry $s+d+ip$ state hosts a dispersing ABS with zero-energy crossings at finite edge momenta. Using self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) calculations we show that the order parameter develops an edge PDW, with the wavevector set by the superconducting Kohn anomaly, that gaps the ABS crossings. Our results identify a novel mechanism for spontaneous translation-symmetry breaking in a superconductor. As this superconducting Peierls mechanism does not require an extensive zero-energy flat band or topologically protected edge states, it may apply broadly to unconventional superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"超导Peierls不稳定性"机制：在二维超导体的边缘，色散的Andreev束缚态（ABS）中存在的Bogoliubov费米点通过增强的准粒子响应产生"超导Kohn异常"（配对模式的软化），该模式凝聚后产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），从而打开ABS的能隙。这一机制不需要零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态，可广泛适用于非常规超导体。
AI.motivation: 传统Peierls不稳定性描述了1D金属中电子-声子耦合导致的晶格畸变和CDW。作者希望探索超导体系中是否存在类似的类比机制——即边缘态中的准粒子响应能否通过配对涨落产生自发平移对称性破缺。
AI.method: 1) 理论类比：将1D金属中的Peierls机制映射到2D超导体的边缘，识别出边缘ABS中±kc处Bogoliubov费米点的角色；2) 数值验证：采用平方晶格扩展Hubbard模型，其混合对称性s+d+ip态具有色散ABS并在有限边缘动量处存在零能交叉；3) 通过自洽Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）计算验证边缘PDW的形成及其波矢由超导Kohn异常决定。
AI.result: BdG计算证明序参量在边缘发展出PDW，其波矢由超导Kohn异常确定，能打开ABS的交叉能隙。该系统实现了"超导Peierls不稳定性"的自发平移对称性破缺。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一种全新的自发平移对称性破缺机制——超导Peierls不稳定性，它不需要零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态，因此可能广泛适用于各类非常规超导体，为理解超导体边缘配对密度波的形成提供了新视角。

title: Unraveling the PFAS helix: A statistical approach
summary: The extreme persistence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the environment is rooted in their three-dimensional molecular conformation. The helical twist adopted by perfluoroalkyl chains due to hyperconjugation involving their recalcitrant C-F bonds governs their resistance to degradation, yet a quantitative, continuous metric for helicity has remained absent. Here we introduce a data-driven framework that quantifies backbone helicity using three statistical descriptors: void-state (binary occupancy) spatial autocorrelations, local backbone principal component analysis, and persistent homology. We further validate each statistical descriptor against geometric dihedral benchmarks and DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra. The framework is initially established on a homologous series of perfluorocarboxylic acids (FC2 through FC16) and their hydrogenated analogues, then extended across perfluorosulfonic acids, fluorotelomer alcohols, polyfluoroalkyl hexanoic acid analogues, and longer-chain PFOA and PFOS analogues. Agreement between statistical, geometric, and spectroscopic definitions of helicity is established for PFCAs and extended to structurally distinct subfamilies, including PFOA analogues of varying fluorine content and perfluorosulfonic acids, demonstrating that the descriptors are robust to changes in headgroup chemistry and fluorine substitution pattern. The framework provides a chemistry-agnostic toolset for incorporating backbone conformation into predictive models of PFAS environmental fate and degradation reactivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的框架，利用三种统计描述符（空洞态空间自相关、局部主成分分析和持续同调）来定量描述全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的主链螺旋度，并通过几何二面角基准和DFT计算的振动圆二色谱进行验证，为预测PFAS环境归趋和降解反应性提供了化学无关的工具集。
AI.motivation: PFAS在环境中的极端持久性源于其三维分子构象——全氟烷基链因C-F键的超共轭作用呈现螺旋扭转，这主导了其抗降解性。然而此前缺乏一个定量、连续的主链螺旋度量指标，阻碍了将构象信息整合到PFAS环境行为的预测模型中。
AI.method: 该框架使用三种统计描述符来量化主链螺旋度：1) 空洞态（二元占用）空间自相关；2) 局部主链主成分分析；3) 持续同调。每种描述符均与几何二面角基准和DFT计算的振动圆二色谱（VCD）进行交叉验证。框架首先在FC2至FC16的全氟羧酸同系物及其氢化类似物上建立，然后扩展至全氟磺酸、氟调聚醇、多氟己酸类似物以及长链PFOA和PFOS类似物。
AI.result: 统计、几何和光谱定义下的螺旋度在全氟羧酸中达成了一致，并可扩展至结构不同的亚家族，包括不同氟含量的PFOA类似物和全氟磺酸。结果表明这些描述符对头基化学和氟取代模式的变化具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个化学无关的工具集，可以将主链构象纳入PFAS环境归趋和降解反应性的预测模型中，弥补了PFAS持久性构象基础研究中定量度量的空白。

title: Flux noise without flux tunability in superconducting qubits
summary: Flux noise is unanimously recognised as a leading dephasing mechanism for flux-tunable superconducting qubits. However, our microscopic understanding remains incomplete, and basic effects like Faraday's law of induction have only very recently come into focus. Based on a quantum geometric description of the Faraday effect, we provide an in-depth derivation of the coupling of generic magnetic sources to thin film superconducting structures, under appropriate consideration of the device geometry. We apply the resulting framework to time-varying magnetic dipoles, describing surface or substrate spins, as well as current-carrying flux lines. We show that flux noise not only affects dephasing, but also provides a fundamental limit for the qubit quality factor - notably, even when the qubit contains no loops and is thus nominally not flux-tunable. Assuming surface spins as the origin for universal flux noise, we expect that this quality factor limit might be reached in the near term. For flux lines, we formulate a minimal safety distance to conserve the qubit performance, potentially constraining the scale-up of quantum hardware. This distance is boosted in the presence of large capacitor wings typical for transmons, due to a lensing of the electromotive field which is largely independent of Meissner screening.

AI.tldr: 本文基于法拉第效应的量子几何描述，深入推导了通用磁源与薄膜超导结构的耦合机制，并将其应用于表面/衬底自旋和载流磁通线等时变磁偶极子。研究发现磁通噪声不仅导致退相干，还对量子比特品质因数构成根本限制——即使量子比特不含回路、名义上不可磁通调谐。若表面自旋是普适磁通噪声的起源，该品质因数极限可能在短期内达到。对于磁通线，文章提出了保持量子比特性能的最小安全距离，该距离在transmon典型的大电容翼存在时会因电动势场的透镜效应而增大，可能制约量子硬件的规模化。
AI.motivation: 磁通噪声被公认为可磁通调谐超导量子比特的主要退相干机制，但其微观理解尚不完整，甚至连法拉第感应定律等基本效应直到最近才受到关注。作者旨在通过量子几何框架提供更完整的理论推导，厘清通用磁源与薄膜超导结构的耦合本质及其对量子比特性能的全面影响。
AI.method: 本文采用基于法拉第效应的量子几何描述方法，对通用磁源与薄膜超导结构的耦合进行了深入的解析推导，并充分考虑了器件几何结构的影响。作者将所构建的理论框架应用于两类时变磁源：(1)描述表面或衬底自旋的时变磁偶极子；(2)载流磁通线。
AI.result: 作者证明磁通噪声不仅引起退相干，还对量子比特品质因数构成根本性限制——即使量子比特不含回路且名义上不可磁通调谐。假设表面自旋为普适磁通噪声的起源，该品质因数极限可能在短期内被达到。对于磁通线，作者推导出保持量子比特性能所需的最小安全距离，该距离在transmon典型的大电容翼存在时显著增大，原因是电动势场的透镜效应，且该效应在很大程度上独立于Meissner屏蔽。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了磁通噪声对量子比特的影响远超退相干本身，还设定了品质因数的根本上限，并对量子硬件规模化（特别是transmon的大电容翼设计）提出了潜在的空间布局约束（安全距离），为超导量子计算硬件的设计提供了重要理论指导。

title: Moiré-induced altermagnetism from nonmagnetic constituents
summary: We propose a mechanism for nonmagnetic materials to develop altermagnetic order by moiré interference with nonmagnetic substrate, which is driven by structural relaxation and spontaneous twirls in moiré domain walls of lattice-mismatched moiré square lattices. When doped with one electron per moiré domain, a correlated insulating gap is opened by electron interaction. Depending on the location of the moiré potential minima, the moiré bands can show d-wave or g-wave altermagnetic splitting. The former can be enhanced by a finite twist angle; the latter is sensitive to strains that drive a transition to d-wave.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在非磁性材料中通过摩尔纹干涉产生交变磁序的机制。该机制由晶格失配的摩尔纹方格中的结构弛豫和摩尔纹畴壁的自发扭转驱动。在每个摩尔纹畴掺杂一个电子时，电子相互作用会打开关联绝缘隙。根据摩尔纹势能最小值的位置，摩尔纹能带可表现出d波或g波交变磁劈裂，前者可通过有限扭转角增强，后者对应变敏感并可转变为d波。
AI.motivation: 探索在非磁性材料中实现交变磁序的新途径，利用摩尔纹工程来调控电子结构和磁性。
AI.method: 通过摩尔纹干涉机制，利用晶格失配的摩尔纹方格中的结构弛豫和畴壁自发扭转，结合电子掺杂和相互作用效应来实现交变磁序。
AI.result: 在每摩尔纹畴掺杂一个电子时，关联绝缘隙打开；摩尔纹能带可显示d波或g波交变磁劈裂，d波可通过有限扭转角增强，g波对应变敏感并可转变为d波。
AI.conclusion: 摩尔纹工程为非磁性材料提供了一种实现可调谐交变磁序的平台，其磁性对称性（d波或g波）可通过扭转角和应变进行调控。

title: An Ultrathin Laterally Conductive Mesh Interphase Enables Spatially Extended Zinc Deposition for Aqueous Zinc Batteries
summary: Zn metal anodes often suffer from nonuniform interfacial reactions during cycling, resulting in uneven deposition and dendrite growth. Existing artificial interphases can mitigate side reactions or regulate nucleation, but rarely achieve regulation of the interfacial electron/field distribution to sustain uniform deposition at the evolving Zn/electrolyte interface. Here, we develop an Au mesh interphase (AuMI), an ultrathin two-dimensional Au aerogel network that couples lateral electron redistribution with open pathways for ions. During Zn plating/stripping, the conductive AuMI distributes electron transport across the Zn surface, while its porous mesh preserves Zn$^{2+}$ access, enabling more uniform interfacial reactions. Experiments and simulations show that AuMI homogenizes the interfacial electric field and current distribution, promotes more uniform Zn plating/stripping, and limits dendrite growth. As a result, this regulated interfacial reaction mode enables AuMI Zn symmetric cells to operate stably for 3000 h at 1 mA cm$^{-2}$/1 mAh cm$^{-2}$ and for 1100 h at 10 mA cm$^{-2}$/10 mAh cm$^{-2}$, while AuMI Zn||NVO (NaV$_3$O$_8$\cdot$1.5H$_2$O) full cells retain 80.8 % capacity after over 5000 cycles at 1 A g$^{-1}$. These findings highlight the importance of combining ultrathin architecture, lateral electron transport, and open Zn2+ access in artificial interphases for stable aqueous Zn metal anodes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种超薄二维金气凝胶网格界面层（AuMI），通过横向电子再分布与开放离子通道的协同作用，调控锌/电解质界面的电子与电场分布，实现均匀的锌沉积/剥离，显著提升水系锌金属负极的稳定性（对称电池3000小时，全电池5000次循环保持80.8%容量）。
AI.motivation: 锌金属负极在循环中常因非均匀界面反应导致不均匀沉积和枝晶生长。现有的人工界面层虽能抑制副反应或调节成核，但很少能同时调控界面电子/电场分布来维持不断演化的锌/电解质界面上的均匀沉积。
AI.method: 开发了一种Au网格界面层（AuMI），即超薄二维Au气凝胶网络。该结构具有双重功能：导电的AuMI将电子传输分散到锌表面各处，实现横向电子再分布；多孔网格结构保持Zn²⁺的开放通道，确保离子可及性，从而促进更均匀的界面反应。
AI.result: 实验和模拟表明AuMI能均匀化界面电场和电流分布，促进均匀的锌沉积/剥离并抑制枝晶生长。AuMI锌对称电池在1 mA cm⁻²/1 mAh cm⁻²条件下稳定运行3000小时，在10 mA cm⁻²/10 mAh cm⁻²条件下运行1100小时；AuMI Zn||NVO全电池在1 A g⁻¹下经5000次循环后仍保持80.8%的容量。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了在人工界面层设计中结合超薄架构、横向电子传输和开放Zn²⁺通道三者对于实现稳定水系锌金属负极的重要性，为界面层设计提供了新思路。

title: Reactive calcium carbonate precipitation from an atomic cluster expansion potential and enhanced sampling
summary: Calcium carbonate formation from aqueous solution is central to biomineralization and to carbon sequestration through mineral carbonation. At near-neutral pH, the process is highly reactive, with proton transfer mediating the interconversion between carbonate species. Most atomistic simulations to date either treat carbonate speciation as fixed or consider proton transfer only in small clusters. Here, we combine an ab initio trained atomic cluster expansion (ACE) machine-learning potential for molecular dynamics with enhanced sampling to enable reactive simulations of the early stages of calcium carbonate precipitation at previously inaccessible length and time scales. We study proton transfer and carbonate speciation in ion pairs and triplets, as well as in the collective aggregation of many ions. Our simulations with few ions show that ion association provides a favorable pathway for proton transfer, facilitating interconversion between carbonate, bicarbonate, and carbonic acid. In many-ion systems, proton transfer occurs spontaneously alongside aggregation, and we observe significant changes in the coordination environments as species evolve during the simulations. These results show that ion aggregation and chemical reactivity can be strongly coupled during the early stages of nucleation from solution.

AI.tldr: 本文结合从头算训练的原子簇展开（ACE）机器学习势与增强采样方法，实现了碳酸钙沉淀早期阶段在以往无法触及的长度和时间尺度上的反应性分子动力学模拟，揭示了离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利途径，并证明离子聚集与化学活性在成核早期阶段可强耦合。
AI.motivation: 碳酸钙从水溶液中的形成对生物矿化和碳封存至关重要，但大多数原子模拟要么将碳酸盐物种视作固定不变，要么仅在小的团簇中考虑质子转移，无法准确捕捉近中性pH下质子转移介导的碳酸盐物种间相互转化的快速反应过程。
AI.method: 开发并应用了基于从头算训练的原子簇展开（ACE）机器学习势，结合增强采样技术进行分子动力学模拟，分别研究离子对与三重离子中的质子转移和碳酸盐物种分布，以及多离子体系的集体聚集过程。
AI.result: 在少离子体系中，离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利路径，促进了碳酸盐、碳酸氢盐和碳酸之间的相互转化；在多离子体系中，质子转移在聚集过程中自发发生，并观察到物种演化伴随配位环境的显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，在从溶液中成核的早期阶段，离子聚集与化学反应性可以强烈耦合，为理解碳酸钙沉淀机制提供了新的见解。

title: Microscopically exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model
summary: We derive an exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model, i.e. inverse-square interacting bosons on a line, from microscopic first principles.

AI.tldr: 本文从微观第一性原理出发，推导出量子Calogero模型（即直线上反平方相互作用的玻色子）的精确输运方程。
AI.motivation: 量子Calogero模型是一类具有精确可解性的相互作用玻色子系统，其输运性质的严格描述对于理解量子多体物理和可积系统中的输运现象具有重要意义。此前缺乏从微观层面严格推导其输运方程的工作。
AI.method: 从微观第一性原理出发，利用Calogero模型的可积结构，严格推导出精确的输运方程。
AI.result: 获得了量子Calogero模型的精确输运方程，该方程是从微观原理直接导出的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为量子Calogero模型的输运性质提供了严格的微观理论基础，有助于深入理解可积量子系统中的输运现象。

title: Deterministic nanofabrication for engineering nanowire quantum dot devices
comment: Main: 26 pages, 5 figures SI: 16 pages, 13 figures
summary: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are a leading platform for realising bright, wavelength-tunable sources of single and entangled photon pairs for photonic quantum technologies. Site-selected nanowire quantum dots (NWQDs) are a promising platform for fabricating such photonic devices in a scalable manner. However, implementing additional structures around the photonic nanowire while maintaining its vertical growth geometry has remained a challenge. In this work, we develop a deterministic pick-and-place technique to conduct a vertical-to-vertical transfer of NWQDs from the growth substrate to arbitrary templates. Using this transfer technique, we enhance the photon extraction efficiency to 75% by implementing a bottom gold mirror and tune the emission wavelength by 3.6 GHz via implementing electrostatic gates around the QD. Importantly, we measure low-multiphoton probability (g^(2)(0) = 0.002) and high indistinguishability (>80% for +/-100 ps) of the QD emission after the transfer process, yielding high-quality devices. These results demonstrate the repeatability and versatility of the developed transfer technique, which is an enabling step towards scalable single and entangled photon sources.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种确定性拾取-放置技术，实现纳米线量子点从生长基底到任意模板的垂直-垂直转移，并通过底部金镜和静电门控分别将光子提取效率提升至75%并将发射波长调谐3.6 GHz，转移后器件保持低多光子概率（g²(0)=0.002）和高不可区分性（>80%），展示了该技术在可扩展单光子和纠缠光子源方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 半导体量子点是实现明亮、波长可调的单光子与纠缠光子源领先平台，位点选择性纳米线量子点具备可扩展制造优势，但在保持垂直生长几何的同时在光子纳米线周围集成额外结构（如反射镜、静电门控）一直是技术挑战，亟需一种能实现器件级集成的确定性转移方案。
AI.method: 开发确定性拾取-放置（pick-and-place）技术，将纳米线量子点从生长基底垂直转移至任意模板（垂直-垂直转移）；转移后在器件上集成底部金镜以提高光子提取效率（提升至75%），并集成静电门控实现对发射波长的电学调谐（达3.6 GHz）。
AI.result: 通过底部金镜将光子提取效率提升至75%；通过静电门控实现3.6 GHz的波长调谐；转移工艺后的量子点发射保持低多光子概率（g²(0)=0.002）和高不可区分性（对±100 ps窗口超过80%）。
AI.conclusion: 该转移技术具有可重复性和通用性，为可扩展单光子和纠缠光子源的实现提供了关键使能步骤。

title: Resolving the Magnetic Ground-State Controversy in RuO2 through A Flat Magnetic Energy Landscape
summary: Rutile RuO2 is a prominent candidate for altermagnetism, yet its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial, with experiments reporting either a nonmagnetic state or altermagnetic order. Here, we develop a generalized environment-dependent spin-lattice framework that unifies localized Heisenberg exchange, itinerant Stoner magnetism via Landau spin fluctuations, and spin-orbit-coupling-mediated spin-lattice interactions. Parameterized from a high-throughput first-principles database using machine-learning and solved by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations, the framework reveals an exceptionally flat magnetic energy landscape in RuO2, where the nonmagnetic state lies nearly degenerate with multiple altermagnetic configurations. We find that material perturbations, exemplified by intrinsic defects, select distinct magnetic ground states primarily by modifying the localized Heisenberg exchange, with perturbation-induced itinerant Stoner polarization provides an essential secondary contribution. Spin-orbit coupling controls the orientation and stability of the Néel vector, but does not determine the emergence of long-range magnetic order. These results provide a unified explanation for the conflicting experimental observations and establish a general microscopic framework for understanding how material perturbations select competing magnetic ground states in systems with nearly flat magnetic energy landscapes.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对金红石RuO2磁性基态争议问题，开发了一个广义的环境依赖自旋-晶格框架，结合局域Heisenberg交换、巡游Stoner磁性（通过Landau自旋涨落）和自旋-轨道耦合介导的自旋-晶格相互作用。通过机器学习从高通量第一性原理数据库中参数化，并用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟求解，揭示了RuO2中异常平坦的磁性能量景观——非磁态与多种交错磁构型近乎简并。研究发现材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过修改局域Heisenberg交换来选择不同的磁性基态，巡游Stoner极化提供重要的次级贡献，而自旋-轨道耦合控制Néel矢量的取向和稳定性但不决定长程磁序的出现。
AI.motivation: 金红石RuO2是交错磁性的重要候选材料，但实验对它的磁性基态存在根本性矛盾——有的报道非磁态，有的报道交错磁有序。这种争议迫切需要统一的理论框架来解释。
AI.method: 开发一种广义的环境依赖自旋-晶格框架，将局域Heisenberg交换、通过Landau自旋涨落描述的巡游Stoner磁性、以及自旋-轨道耦合介导的自旋-晶格相互作用统一起来。参数从高通量第一性原理数据库通过机器学习获得，通过大规模蒙特卡洛模拟求解。
AI.result: 发现RuO2存在异常平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多个交错磁构型几乎简并。材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过改变局域Heisenberg交换来选择不同的基态，巡游Stoner极化提供必要的次级贡献。自旋-轨道耦合仅控制Néel向量的取向和稳定性，不决定长程磁序的出现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为相互矛盾的实验观测提供了统一解释，建立了理解在近乎平坦磁性能量景观体系中材料扰动如何选择竞争磁性基态的通用微观框架。

title: Thermal history controls the optoelectronic response of lead halide perovskites through structure and dynamics
summary: Lead halide perovskites are promising optoelectronic materials for photovoltaics, light emission and detection. Their efficiencies in PV now approach the detailed-balance limit, leaving stability as the principal barrier. The intrinsic instabilities studied to date centre on ionic motion within a fixed, homogeneous lattice. Here we identify a further source of intrinsic structural instability, hidden in the lattice dynamics. Mapping caesium, methylammonium and formamidinium-based compositions with Cl, Br, I and mixed X-sites through all accessible phases, using single crystal X-ray and neutron diffuse scattering, machine-learning-assisted molecular dynamics, a phenomenological octahedral tilt model and hyperspectral photoluminescence, we find that nearly every composition hosts equilibrium local structural fluctuations: dynamic nanodomains of correlated octahedral tilts, a few nanometres in size, that locally break the crystallographic symmetry. Three complementary levers control them. The A-site cation sets their symmetry, shape and anisotropy, from sparse, isotropic and tetragonal in formamidinium-based compositions to dense, anisotropic and orthorhombic in nominally cubic caesium-based ones, the most locally disordered we studied. The halide controls the dynamic disorder and the phase-transition sequence. Thermal history is the third: different ramp rates drive nominally identical compositions into distinct crystallographic phases, each with its own hidden local order. In MAPbI3, the heating rate alone changes the photoluminescence quantum efficiency across the phase transition. Because these transitions lie within device operating ranges, from terrestrial thermal cycling to the extremes of space, thermal history may shape the local structure, and hence the optoelectronic response, throughout fabrication and operation, establishing it as a design variable alongside composition.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了铅卤钙钛矿材料中一种新的内在结构不稳定性来源——隐藏在晶格动力学中的动态纳米域（几个纳米大小、局部破坏晶体对称性的相关八面体倾斜波动），几乎存在于所有组分中，并可由A位阳离子、卤化物和热历史三种杠杆调控，影响材料的光电性能。
AI.motivation: 铅卤钙钛矿的光电转换效率已接近详细平衡极限，稳定性成为其应用的主要障碍。此前研究的内在失稳机制集中在固定均匀晶格内的离子运动，但忽略了晶格动力学中可能隐藏的结构不稳定性，这限制了对其稳定性问题的全面理解。
AI.method: 综合运用多种手段：单晶X射线和中子漫散射、机器学习辅助分子动力学、现象学八面体倾斜模型以及高光谱光致发光技术，系统测绘了铯、甲胺、甲脒基组分与Cl、Br、I及混合X位在所有可及相中的结构与动力学特征。
AI.result: 发现几乎所有组分都含有平衡态局部结构涨落——动态纳米域（数纳米尺寸、局部破坏晶体对称性的相关八面体倾斜），三个互补杠杆可调控它们：A位阳离子决定其对称性、形貌和各向异性（从甲脒基的稀疏、各向同性、四方到铯基体名义立方的最密集、各向异性、正交）；卤素控制动态无序和相变序列；热历史是第三杠杆，不同升温速率可使相同组分进入不同晶相，如MAPbI3中仅升温速率就能改变相变过程中的光致发光量子效率。
AI.conclusion: 由于这些相变位于器件工作温度范围内（从地面热循环到太空极端环境），热历史可能在制造和运行全过程中塑造局部结构进而影响光电响应，应将其与组分并列作为重要的设计变量加以考虑。

title: Wavefunctions for Anyon Superconductors
summary: Anyon superconductivity arises from the condensation of mobile anyons rather than from a conventional Cooper instability, yet a systematic wavefunction description remains lacking. We develop a hierarchy-wavefunction construction for superconducting states derived from parent topological orders and identify their off-diagonal long-range order, condensate charge, chiral central charge, and residual topological order through the plasma analogy and topological field theories. We construct Abelian and non-Abelian examples descending from the semion state, a $ν=2/3$ hierarchy state, the $ν=1/3$ Laughlin state, $ν=1$ integer quantum Hall state, and Pfaffian state. Remarkably, for the semion case, the superconducting many-semion wavefunction is equivalent to a state of fermionized anyons filling two effective Landau levels, recovering Laughlin's original construction of semion superconductor. Finally, we show that hierarchy wavefunctions emerge naturally in the dilute, long-distance limit of the anyon-Hilbert-space formulation, which applies to ideal Chern bands and moiré bands of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$. Our results establish a unified wavefunction-level framework linking anyon condensation, superconducting order, and topological field theory.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套描述任意子超导态的层级波函数构造方法，通过父拓扑序出发建立波函数，并利用等离子体类比和拓扑场论确定了离对角长程序、凝聚电荷、手性中心荷及残余拓扑序。作者构造了从半子态、ν=2/3层级态、ν=1/3 Laughlin态、ν=1整数量子霍尔态及Pfaffian态衍生的阿贝尔和非阿贝尔超导例子。特别地，半子超导的多半子波函数等价于填充两个有效朗道能级的费米化任意子态，重现了Laughlin的原始构造。最后，层级波函数被证明自然出现在任意子希尔伯特空间表述的稀薄长距离极限中，适用于理想Chern带和扭曲双层MoTe₂的moiré带。
AI.motivation: 任意子超导源于移动任意子的凝聚而非传统的Cooper不稳定性，但缺乏系统性的波函数描述。作者旨在填补这一空白，建立统一的波函数级框架来连接任意子凝聚、超导序和拓扑场论。
AI.method: 采用层级波函数构造方法，从父拓扑序出发构建超导态；利用等离子体类比分析离对角长程序；通过拓扑场论识别凝聚电荷、手性中心荷和残余拓扑序；并展示了层级波函数在任意子希尔伯特空间表述稀薄极限下的自然涌现。
AI.result: 成功构造了多个阿贝尔和非阿贝尔任意子超导实例；证明了半子超导波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效朗道能级，重现Laughlin原始构造；建立了适用于实际材料系统（理想Chern带和moiré带）的统一框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了连接任意子凝聚、超导序与拓扑场论的统一波函数级框架，为理解任意子超导提供了系统的理论工具，并可直接应用于扭曲双层MoTe₂等实际材料平台。

title: Overlimiting Ion Transport and Reaction Limitations in Charged Porous Media
summary: Electrochemical reaction rates are controlled by both interfacial charge-transfer kinetics and reactive-ion transport. In charged porous media, fixed charges enrich reactive counterions near pore walls, enabling transport beyond the classical diffusion limit via surface conduction (SC). Under overlimiting conditions, classical Butler-Volmer kinetics predict indefinitely increasing current with overpotential, contrasting with microscopic electron-transfer theories, which impose a finite reaction-limited current. Here, we couple the one-dimensional leaky membrane model to coupled ion-electron transfer (CIET) kinetics to examine the interplay between transport and reaction limitations. The limiting behavior is governed by the scaled surface charge $(\tildeρ_s)$ and a Damköhler number $(Da)$ comparing reaction-limited and diffusion-limited currents. We derive analytical limiting-current expressions for neutral, positive, and negatively charged porous media, mapping underlimiting-to-overlimiting transitions in the $(Da,\tildeρ_s)$ plane. By preventing reactive-ion depletion, SC restores polarization-curve sensitivity to charge-transfer kinetics that would otherwise be obscured by diffusion limitation. Fitting to published Cu electrodeposition data in charged AAO membranes yields $Da\approx24$. CIET parameters fitted to AAO($-$) also describe AAO($+$) and predict a finite AAO($-$) reaction limit beyond the applied voltage range. These results provide a framework for distinguishing transport-limited and reaction-limited responses in electrochemical systems and establish charged porous media as platforms to reveal electrochemical reaction-kinetic descriptors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将一维泄漏膜模型与耦合离子-电子转移(CIET)动力学相结合，研究了带电多孔介质中传输与反应限制之间的相互作用。研究表明表面传导(SC)能防止反应性离子耗尽，恢复极化曲线对电荷转移动力学的敏感性，并在(Da, ρ̃s)平面上绘制了欠限到过限转变图。拟合铜电沉积实验数据得到Da≈24，建立了区分传输限制与反应限制响应的框架。
AI.motivation: 经典Butler-Volmer动力学预测过限条件下电流会随过电位无限增加，这与微观电子转移理论所要求的有限反应限制电流相矛盾。此外，在带电多孔介质中，表面电荷对离子传输的增强效应（表面传导）与反应动力学之间的相互作用尚未被系统研究，需要统一框架来区分传输限制和反应限制的响应。
AI.method: 将一维泄漏膜模型与耦合离子-电子转移(CIET)动力学耦合，分析电荷传输与反应限制的相互作用。通过无量纲参数——缩放表面电荷(ρ̃s)和Damköhler数(Da，反应限制电流与扩散限制电流之比)——来系统描述体系行为，并推导中性、正电荷和负电荷多孔介质中解析极限电流表达式，在(Da, ρ̃s)平面上绘制欠限到过限转变图。
AI.result: 推导了不同表面电荷状态下多孔介质的解析极限电流表达式；证明表面传导通过防止反应性离子耗尽恢复极化曲线对电荷转移动力学的敏感性；拟合已发表的AAO膜中铜电沉积数据得Da≈24；从AAO(−)拟合的CIET参数可描述AAO(+)的行为，并预测AAO(−)存在超出所施加电压范围的有限反应极限。
AI.conclusion: 建立了区分电化学系统中传输限制与反应限制响应的框架，证明带电多孔介质可作为揭示电化学反应动力学描述符的有效平台，为解决经典动力学预测与微观理论之间的不一致提供了新途径。

title: Large deviations for linear regressions
comment: 7 pages, 2 figs in main text. Supplemental material included
summary: Linear regression is one of the simplest and most widely used tools to learn patterns from data: it fits a set of coefficients so that a linear combination of predictors best matches observed responses. The quality of the fit is measured by the residual sum of squares, the total squared mismatch between predictions and data, whose minimum defines the training loss. We consider Gaussian design and noise, with teacher coefficients independently drawn from a general distribution $p(β)$, and a general class of separable regularizers, including Ridge and Lasso. Using the zero-temperature replica method, we compute analytically the large-deviation statistics of the minimum training loss for large numbers $P$ of predictors and $N$ of observations, with $r=P/N$ fixed. The rate function we compute governs rare sample-to-sample fluctuations of the optimal loss. Extensive numerical simulations are in excellent agreement with our theory and clearly show a pronounced deviation from the Gaussian regime of typical fluctuations in the tails.

AI.tldr: 本文利用零温复制方法，对线性回归在一般可分正则化（包括Ridge和Lasso）下的最小训练损失的罕见波动（大偏差统计）进行了理论分析，并推导了速率函数。
AI.motivation: 线性回归中训练损失的最小值（训练损失）的统计特性通常只关注典型波动（高斯尺度），但在高维场景中稀有样本的极端波动可能偏离高斯行为，理解这些偏离对评估模型泛化能力和损失分布的鲁棒性至关重要。
AI.method: 考虑高斯设计和噪声，教师系数独立采样自一般分布p(β)，采用一般可分正则化器（涵盖Ridge和Lasso），利用零温复制方法在P个预测变量、N个观测、r=P/N固定的大规模极限下解析计算最小训练损失的大偏差速率函数。
AI.result: 推导出了控制最优损失罕见样本涨落的速率函数。广泛数值模拟与理论高度吻合，清楚表明在尾部区域与典型涨落的高斯区出现显著偏离。
AI.conclusion: 理论框架成功刻画了线性回归训练损失在尾部区域的非高斯罕见波动，为理解正则化回归在高维极限下的损失分布细节提供了严格的解析工具。

title: Topological Boundary States and the Edge Chain in Semi-Infinite Two-Dimensional Insulators
summary: We show that it is possible to compute the adiabatically protected edge and corner states of semi-infinite, two-dimensional, topological insulators by considering the first layer of lattice sites, what we call the "edge chain," independently from the bulk. We start by accepting this claim as an ansatz, then, using the Shemesh theorem, we show that the edge states one finds using our procedure are adiabatically protected, provided we restrict ourselves to adiabatic evolutions that do not break chiral symmetry. We show explicit examples of our method in a 2D extension of the SSH model, the SSH3 model, the Haldane model and the Breathing Kagome Lattice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种计算二维拓扑绝缘体中受绝热保护的边缘态和角态的新方法：仅通过考虑半无限系统中第一层晶格位点（称为"边缘链"）独立于体态进行计算。作者将该假设作为出发点，利用Shemesh定理证明了在保持手征对称性的绝热演化下，该方法找到的边缘态是受绝热保护的。
AI.motivation: 传统计算拓扑绝缘体边缘态和角态的方法通常需要对整个体态进行计算，计算复杂度较高。作者希望找到一种更简便的方法，仅通过分析边缘第一层晶格位点就能获得受保护的自旋/角态。
AI.method: 作者首先将"边缘链可以独立于体态进行计算"作为ansatz（假设），然后利用Shemesh定理严格证明，在限制于不破坏手征对称性的绝热演化条件下，通过该过程找到的边缘态受绝热保护。随后将该方法应用于多个具体模型的二维推广。
AI.result: 作者在4个具体模型中展示了该方法的有效性：2D SSH模型的扩展、SSH3模型、Haldane模型以及Breathing Kagome晶格，成功计算出了绝热保护的边缘态和角态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过仅分析边缘链可以高效且可靠地获得二维拓扑绝缘体的受保护边缘态和角态，前提是限制在手征对称性保持的绝热演化下。这为拓扑态的计算提供了一种简化的新途径。

title: Symmetry-breaking line defects embedded to a 3D $O(N)$ critical bulk
summary: While spontaneous breaking of a discrete symmetry in one-dimensional classical systems with short-range interactions is absent, it is expected that a line defect embedded in a bulk criticality exhibits a stable discrete symmetry spontaneous breaking. Here, we investigate the behavior of a pinning-field line defect immersed in a 3D bulk that remains tuned to the $O(N)$ Wilson-Fisher critical point. Employing the fuzzy sphere technique, we provide convincing evidence of the existence of stable defect conformal fixed points, and we demonstrate their renormalization group stability by showing no relevant operator and less effective degrees of freedom than that at bulk fixed point via $g$-function. Moreover, we investigate the defect domain wall operator for various $N$, and we identify that it becomes irrelevance for $N\gtrsim 3$ but it is relevant for $N<3$.These evidence indicate that a one-dimensional defect coupled to a critical bulk cannot support a stable symmetry spontaneously broken defect fixed point due to domain wall proliferation for $N<3$ Wilson-Fisher universality, while in the case of $N \gtrsim 3$ a symmetry broken defect is possible.
