AI.tldr: 本文利用模糊球面技术研究了浸入3D O(N) Wilson-Fisher临界体中的钉扎场线缺陷，证明了稳定缺陷共形不动点的存在，并通过g-函数展示了其重整化群稳定性。研究发现缺陷畴壁算子对于N≳3时变为无关算子，而对N<3时是相关算子，表明N<3时因畴壁增殖无法支持自发对称破缺的缺陷不动点，而N≳3时对称破缺缺陷是可能的。
AI.motivation: 一维经典短程相互作用系统中离散对称性的自发破缺通常不存在，但在嵌入体临界性的线缺陷中可能存在稳定的离散对称性自发破缺。作者希望探究钉扎场线缺陷浸入3D O(N) Wilson-Fisher临界体中的行为，以确定缺陷是否能支撑稳定的对称破缺不动点。
AI.method: 采用模糊球面（fuzzy sphere）技术将3D体保持在O(N) Wilson-Fisher临界点上，研究钉扎场线缺陷的性质。通过g-函数分析缺陷不动点的自由度与重整化群稳定性，并系统研究不同N值下缺陷畴壁算子的标度维度/相关性。
AI.result: 提供了稳定缺陷共形不动点存在的令人信服证据；通过g-函数表明无相关算子且有效自由度少于体不动点，验证了RG稳定性。畴壁算子分析显示：N≲3时畴壁算子相关，N≳3时变为无关，即N=3附近存在临界转变。
AI.conclusion: 对于N<3的Wilson-Fisher普适类，一维缺陷耦合到临界体无法支撑稳定的对称性自发破缺缺陷不动点（因畴壁增殖）；而对于N≳3，对称破缺的缺陷是可能的。

title: A Strategy Toward Room Temperature Topological Hall Effect via Local Moment Magnetism
summary: Topological spin textures in local moment systems hold great promise for technological applications due to their large magnetic moments, strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC), and high tunability. Finding new spin textures that are stable near room temperature is paramount to maximizing their potential for applications. Here, we provide a strategy for realizing topological spin textures at high temperatures by identifying rare earth ($R$) magnets ordering at or near room temperature. We demonstrate the feasibility of this strategy in one of these magnets, hexagonal Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, which orders at $T_C$ = 285 K. The indication for topological spin textures comes from topological Hall effect (THE), which, in Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, occurs between $T$ = 100 - 200 K, an order of magnitude higher temperature than in other reported $R$-based systems. Our results present an opportunity to explore the role of SOC, anisotropic exchange, geometric frustration, and magnetic interactions in stabilizing topological spin textures, and provide a pathway toward realizing them near room temperature in $R$-based magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在稀土(R)基磁性材料中于高温下实现拓扑自旋纹理的策略，并通过六方Gd₅Pb₃（居里温度TC=285 K）验证了其可行性，在该材料中观测到100-200 K温度范围内的拓扑霍尔效应（THE），比之前报道的其他R基体系高出一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 拓扑自旋纹理在局域磁矩体系中因大磁矩、强自旋轨道耦合和高可调性而对技术应用具有重大前景，但现有拓扑自旋纹理的稳定温度通常过低，亟需找到接近室温稳定的新自旋纹理，以最大化其应用潜力。
AI.method: 作者提出一种策略：通过识别在室温或接近室温下有序的稀土磁体来寻找高温拓扑自旋纹理。具体方法是在六方Gd₅Pb₃（TC=285 K）中进行实验，通过拓扑霍尔效应（THE）来检测拓扑自旋纹理的存在，测量其在100-200 K温度范围内出现的信号。
AI.result: Gd₅Pb₃的拓扑霍尔效应出现在100-200 K温度范围内，这比其他已报道的R基体系高出一个数量级的温度。材料的磁序温度高达285 K，接近室温。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为探索SOC、各向异性交换、几何阻挫和磁相互作用在稳定拓扑自旋纹理中的作用提供了机遇，并为在R基磁体中于接近室温实现拓扑自旋纹理提供了可行路径。

title: Stochastic Tensor Contraction for Efficient MP2 Exchange
summary: Second-order Moller--Plesset perturbation theory (MP2) is one of the simplest correlated wave-function methods, but its conventional $O(N^5)$ cost limits its application to large systems. Stochastic tensor contraction (STC) has recently appeared as a general technique to evaluate high-order tensor contractions in quantum chemistry. Here, we apply STC to the exchange contribution of Laplace-transformed MP2, which is the source of $O(N^5)$ scaling in the formulation. The resulting STC exchange algorithm has an $O(N^3)$ deterministic setup cost and an $O(N^2)$ stochastic cost at fixed absolute error. The estimator is unbiased and provides a way to specify the target stochastic error by estimating the number of required samples before the full calculation. We implement the algorithm using a hybrid deterministic--stochastic evaluation strategy, with grouped index sampling, to reduce the computational prefactor. Over a range of benchmark molecules containing up to $\sim 7000$ basis functions, the stochastic exchange evaluation takes as little as $1/270$ of the time of a complete DF-MP2 calculation on the same system. Within the Laplace-transformed formulation, the $O(N^4)$ scaling direct contribution is thus the only significant cost. Our results further substantiate the power of STC to serve as a general tensor-contraction engine for quantum chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机张量收缩（STC）的拉普拉斯变换MP2交换项算法，将传统O(N⁵)的DF-MP2计算中交换项的随机成本降至O(N²)（固定绝对误差），确定性设置成本为O(N³)。在含约7000个基函数的基准分子上，随机交换评估仅占完整DF-MP2计算的1/270时间，使得O(N⁴)的直接项成为唯一显著成本，进一步证明了STC作为量子化学通用张量收缩引擎的能力。
AI.motivation: MP2是简单的相关波函数方法，但传统的O(N⁵)计算成本限制了其在大体系中的应用，特别是拉普拉斯变换MP2中的交换贡献是O(N⁵)标度的来源，亟需降复杂度方法。
AI.method: 将STC（随机张量收缩）应用于拉普拉斯变换MP2的交换项；采用无偏估计器，并能在完整计算前通过估算所需样本数来指定目标随机误差；实现采用确定性-随机混合评估策略，并配合分组索引抽样来降低计算预因子。
AI.result: 算法确定性设置成本O(N³)，固定绝对误差下随机成本O(N²)；在含约7000个基函数的基准分子上，随机交换评估仅占完整DF-MP2计算时间的1/270；O(N⁴)的直接贡献项成为唯一显著的计算成本来源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了STC作为量子化学通用张量收缩引擎的强大潜力，有效消除了MP2方法中的O(N⁵)瓶颈，实现了对大体系MP2计算成本的大幅降低。

title: Death by mutants: unusual multicritical dynamics in a two-species model for absorbing state transitions
summary: We explore the phases and active-to-absorbing state phase transitions (AAPT) in a two-species model, where the species A and its mutant B are {\em asymmetrically} or {\em nonreciprocally} coupled. We identify a multicritical point that connects the global absorbing state of both the species and its mutant, with a uniform active state. The critical dynamics at this multicritical point is studied within the lowest order perturbation theory. This asymmetric coupling between species A and mutant B leads to unequal and distinct upper critical dimensions $d_c^A$ and $d_c^B$ respectively for A and B dynamics. We show that the multicritical point in this model is characterised by an unusual breakdown of scale-invariance by fluctuation-induced logarithmic modulations with power law behaviour of the order parameter and correlation lengths of the species A at all dimensions $d<d_c^A$. Above $d_c^A$, conventional scale-invariance is restored. The dynamics of the mutant species B belongs to the DP universality class with an upper critical dimension of $d_c^B=4$

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个双物种模型中的相与活性-吸收态相变（AAPT），其中物种A及其突变体B之间存在非对称（非互易）耦合。研究发现了一个连接全局吸收态与均匀活性态的多临界点，并揭示了A和B动力学分别具有不同的上临界维度（d_c^A和d_c^B）。在该多临界点，物种A在所有维度d<d_c^A下表现出尺度不变性的异常破缺，由涨落诱导的对数调制取代，而突变体B则属于DP普适类，其上限维度为d_c^B=4。
AI.motivation: 探索非对称（非互易）耦合的双物种模型中的相变行为，特别是理解当两个物种以非对称方式相互作用时，活性-吸收态相变的多临界点特性以及不同普适类之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用最低阶微扰理论（lowest order perturbation theory）研究多临界点处的临界动力学，通过分析非对称耦合导致的物种A与B的上临界维度差异来揭示临界行为。
AI.result: 发现该模型存在一个多临界点，连接全局吸收态与均匀活性态。物种A和B具有不同的上临界维度d_c^A和d_c^B。在d<d_c^A时，物种A的序参量和关联长度表现出涨落诱导的对数调制的幂律行为，即尺度不变性的异常破缺；当d>d_c^A时恢复常规的尺度不变性。突变体B的动态属于DP普适类，上临界维度为d_c^B=4。
AI.conclusion: 非对称耦合导致了两个物种在临界行为上的根本性差异：物种A在低维下呈现非常规的对数调制临界行为，而物种B遵循标准的DP普适类。这种非对称耦合机制为理解非互易系统中的相变提供了新的视角。

title: Built-In Electric Field Modulation of Spontaneous Magnetism and Thermospin Transport in Boron-Nitrogen Doped Zigzag Graphene Nanoribbons
summary: Zigzag-edged graphene nanoribbons (ZGNRs) host large magnetic moments at two zigzag edges due to spontaneous magnetism, whose ground state is antiferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (AF state). In this paper, the spontaneous magnetism and thermoelectricity of ZGNRs with periodic substituted doping of boron and nitrogen atoms along the axial direction are investigated by first principle calculation. The doping induces an internal electric field, which modulates the magnetic moments at the two zigzag edges and the band structure with spin splitting. For varying doping configuration, the ground state could be AF state, ferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (FM state), or degenerated pair of AF and FM states. External transversal static electric field can further modulate the magnetic moments and the band structure. By designing the doping configuration and the external field, pure thermal spin current with the absence of thermal charge current can be generated at room temperature, which can be switched on and off by flipping the magnetic configuration between AF and FM states. Thus, the doped ZGNRs can be applied as prototype devices for spin-caloritronic.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了轴向周期性硼氮共掺杂的锯齿形石墨烯纳米带（ZGNRs）的自发磁性和热电性质。掺杂诱导内部电场可调控两条锯齿边的磁矩和自旋劈裂的能带结构，通过设计掺杂构型和外部横向静电场，可在室温下产生纯热自旋电流，并能通过在AF和FM态间翻转磁构型实现开关，为自旋量热电子学器件提供原型。
AI.motivation: 锯齿形石墨烯纳米带具有两个锯齿边缘上的大磁矩和反铁磁自旋有序边缘态（AF态），但其热电性质及如何调控磁构型实现自旋热电应用尚未充分探索。掺杂可诱导内电场，有望调控磁矩和能带结构，从而实现纯热自旋电流的产生和调控。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，对ZGNRs沿轴向进行周期性的硼（B）和氮（N）原子替代掺杂。掺杂引入内部电场，进而调控两个锯齿边的磁矩以及自旋劈裂的能带结构。研究不同掺杂构型下的基态磁构型（AF、FM或两者简并）。并进一步施加外部横向静电场进行调控，设计掺杂构型与外部场的组合以实现热自旋电流的产生与开关控制。
AI.result: 不同掺杂构型下基态可以是AF态、FM态或AF与FM简并态。外部横向静电场可进一步调节磁矩和能带结构。通过设计掺杂构型和外部场，在室温下可获得无热荷电流的纯热自旋电流，且该电流可通过在AF与FM磁构型间翻转实现开关切换。
AI.conclusion: 硼氮掺杂的ZGNRs可通过掺杂构型设计和外部电场调控实现可控的纯热自旋电流产生，并能通过磁构型翻转进行开关，可作为自旋量热电子学（spin-caloritronic）的原型器件。

title: Studying line defect at Deconfined Quantum Criticality via fuzzy sphere regularization
summary: The interplay between bulk critical fluctuations and nontrivial topology can enrich defect physics and give rise to novel defect universality classes. Understanding the fate of such defects therefore constitutes an important open problem. In this work, we studied a particularly simple setting: a (0+1)-dimensional pinning-field defect coupled to a (2+1)-dimensional deconfined quantum critical bulk. Using the fuzzy-sphere regularization, we numerically investigated the defect operator spectrum and extracted several universal quantities characterizing the defect conformal fixed point, including the scaling dimensions of defect-changing(creating) operators and the defect \(g\)-function. These results establish the first numerical characterization of line-defect conformal data at deconfined quantum criticality and may stimulate further investigations of defect critical phenomena in topological quantum critical matter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了(0+1)维钉扎场缺陷与(2+1)维解禁闭量子临界体的耦合，利用模糊球面正则化方法数值研究了缺陷算子谱，提取了缺陷改变(创建)算子的标度维数和缺陷g函数等普适量，首次建立了解禁闭量子临界点处线缺陷共形数据的数值表征。
AI.motivation: 体临界涨落与非平庸拓扑之间的相互作用可以丰富缺陷物理并产生新的缺陷普适类，理解这类缺陷的命运是一个重要的开放问题。
AI.method: 采用模糊球面正则化方法，数值研究一个(0+1)维钉扎场缺陷耦合到(2+1)维解禁闭量子临界体系统，提取缺陷算子谱并计算多个普适物理量。
AI.result: 获得了缺陷改变(创建)算子的标度维数和缺陷g函数等普适量，建立了解禁闭量子临界点线缺陷共形数据的首个数值表征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了拓扑量子临界物质中缺陷临界现象研究的空白，可能激发对该领域进一步的研究探索。

title: Grain boundary evolution in nanoparticles
summary: Grain boundary evolution is a key dynamical process that enables structural rearrangements in nanoparticles and drives them towards low energy configurations. Grain boundaries can also enhance catalytic properties, making it important to understand the elementary processes underlying their evolution for grain boundary engineering in nanoparticles. Compared with bulk materials, nanoparticles have additional rotational and translational degrees of freedom, can accommodate structural changes through shape relaxation, and grain boundaries terminate at free surfaces. However, the atomic-scale mechanisms of GB evolution under these less constrained conditions remain comparatively less understood than in bulk materials. Here, using atomistic simulations, we focus on low energy $\Sigma3$ (coherent twin boundary) and $\Sigma11$ grain boundaries, which are among the persistent compact GB structures that emerge during nanoparticle structural evolution. We identify two fundamental atomic displacements, column shift (C) and screw shift (S), that recur during the evolution of these grain boundaries and their junctions. These displacements occur through different atomic pathways and combine in different ways to generate grain boundary migration, structural transformations, and junction evolution. In particular, the same initial and final grain boundary configurations can be connected through different atomic pathways, and a column shift can occur either as a full shift or through disconnection kinks. C and S remain identifiable even when the grain boundary character changes, for example during a $\Sigma11$ to $\Sigma3$ transformation. An understanding of these elementary GB processes can help identify strategies to control grain boundary evolution and thereby engineer GB structures in nanoparticles.

AI.tldr: 通过原子模拟，本文研究了纳米颗粒中低能Σ3和Σ11晶界演化中的基本原子位移机制，识别出柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S）两种基本原子位移，它们通过不同原子路径组合生成晶界迁移、结构转变和结点演化。
AI.motivation: 晶界演化是纳米颗粒结构重排和向低能构型演化的关键动力学过程，还能增强催化性能。与块体材料相比，纳米颗粒具有额外的转动和平移自由度、可通过形状弛豫适应结构变化，晶界终止于自由表面，但这些受限较少条件下的晶界演化原子机制仍不如块体材料中被理解得透彻。
AI.method: 使用原子模拟（atomistic simulations），聚焦于纳米颗粒结构演化中持续出现的紧凑晶界结构——低能Σ3（共格孪晶界）和Σ11晶界，分析其演化过程中反复出现的基本原子位移及其组合方式。
AI.result: 识别出两种基本原子位移：柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S）。它们通过不同原子路径实现，组合方式多样，可生成晶界迁移、结构转变和结点演化。相同的初末晶界构型可通过不同原子路径连接；柱位移既可整体发生也可通过断开扭结（disconnection kinks）发生。在晶界性质改变（如Σ11向Σ3转变）时，C和S仍可辨识。
AI.conclusion: 理解这些基本晶界过程有助于为纳米颗粒中的晶界工程提供策略，从而控制晶界演化并设计晶界结构。

title: Generative Nested Sampling of Atomistic Thermodynamic Landscapes
summary: Nested sampling (NS) resolves the thermodynamics of an atomistic system from a single simulation, but its practical reach is limited by the Markov-chain updates needed to decorrelate walkers within each likelihood-constrained ensemble. Flow-based NS has removed this bottleneck for gravitational-wave (GW) inference, yet its transfer to atomistic systems is not merely a change of application. Comparing a GW150914-like binary-black-hole likelihood with an eight-particle two-dimensional Lennard-Jones (LJ) system of comparable dimensionality, we show that the two landscapes differ fundamentally: atomistic multimodality is discrete and combinatorial, generated by particle permutations separated by hard collision walls, and its coordinate coupling is dense and collective, whereas the GW posterior exhibits smooth degeneracies and localized parameter coupling. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce NS-Flows: a single conditional normalizing flow, conditioned on the NS energy bound and trained on a sliding window of recent live sets, that replaces MCMC by direct parallel draws corrected by importance-weighted rejection resampling. Live sets supply data self-consistently, allowing flow training without structured priors or a pre-existing dataset. For LJ disks in PBC, the algorithm reduces energy evaluations by over two orders of magnitude and wall-clock time by roughly one third, an advantage that becomes increasingly favorable as the cost of the potential grows. The flow's generation efficiency further acts as a physical diagnostic: it varies non-monotonically along the annealing trajectory, is lowest in the dense disordered regime, and is quantitatively captured by the constrained ensemble's internal mode complexity together with target drift across the training window, identifying liquid-like ensembles, rather than prior-target separation, as the hard case for current flow architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍NS-Flows，一种将归一化流与嵌套采样结合的方法，用于原子系统的热力学计算。通过对比引力波推断与Lennard-Jones系统的似然景观差异，作者发现原子系统的多模态是离散组合性的（来自粒子置换），并使用条件归一化流替代MCMC更新，将能量评估减少两个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 嵌套采样（NS）可以从单次模拟中解析原子系统的热力学，但其实际应用受限于马尔可夫链更新在似然约束系综内去相关游走者的瓶颈。流式NS已成功用于引力波推断，但将其迁移到原子系统并非简单的应用变更，因为两者的景观结构存在根本差异。作者旨在诊断这一差异并开发适用于原子系统的流式NS方法。
AI.method: 作者首先对比了GW150914-like双黑洞似然与八粒子二维Lennard-Jones系统（维度相当），揭示原子系统多模态是离散组合性的（由粒子置换产生，被硬碰撞墙分隔），且坐标耦合密集而集体化；而GW后验呈现平滑简并和局部参数耦合。基于此，引入NS-Flows：使用单个条件归一化流（以NS能量界为条件），在最近live sets的滑动窗口上训练，通过重要性加权拒绝重采样进行直接并行采样替代MCMC。Live sets自洽提供数据，无需结构化先验或预存在数据集。
AI.result: 对于周期性边界条件下的LJ圆盘，NS-Flows将能量评估减少两个数量级以上，墙钟时间减少约三分之一，且随势能计算成本增加优势更明显。流生成效率可作为物理诊断工具：沿退火轨迹非单调变化，在稠密无序态最低，可被约束系综的内部模式复杂度和训练窗口内的目标漂移定量捕捉，识别出液体样系综（而非先验-目标分离）是当前流架构的难点。
AI.conclusion: 原子系统与引力波推断的似然景观存在本质差异，NS-Flows通过条件归一化流成功替代MCMC推进嵌套采样，大幅提升计算效率。此外，流架构的生成效率揭示了液体样系综是当前归一化流架构的主要挑战，为未来架构改进指明了方向。

title: Diabatic Seam Space Sampling for Hydrogen Tunneling Systems with Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Theory
summary: Hydrogen tunneling is central to many chemical and biological processes. Herein, we introduce the vibronic-SHAKE (V-SHAKE) approach to comprehensively sample energy-conserving molecular configurations enabling hydrogen tunneling. A constrained form of nuclear-electronic orbital multistate density functional theory (NEO-MSDFT) dynamics, where the tunneling hydrogen nucleus is quantized, is used to sample geometries in the diabatic seam space corresponding to the intersection of the reactant and product NEO-DFT diabatic vibronic surfaces. V-SHAKE is applied to hydrogen and deuterium tunneling in 4-cyanobutanolate and Z-4-hydroxybut-3-en-2-one. The vibronic coupling is found to vary significantly in the diabatic seam space, mainly due to changes in the donor-acceptor distance. The reaction coordinate and gradient of the vibronic coupling at the minimum energy crossing point are nearly orthogonal and are dominated by motions stabilizing the product relative to the reactant or decreasing the donor-acceptor distance, respectively. V-SHAKE provides fundamental insights and validation for assumptions underlying rate theories.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了V-SHAKE方法，用于全面采样允许氢隧穿的等能量分子构型，并应用于4-氰基丁醇和Z-4-羟基丁-3-烯-2-酮中的氢与氘隧穿研究。
AI.motivation: 氢隧穿是许多化学和生物过程中的核心机制，但目前缺乏能够全面采样允许氢隧穿的分子构型的方法，限制了对其机理的理解以及速率理论假设的验证。
AI.method: 提出了V-SHAKE（vibronic-SHAKE）方法，采用约束形式的核电子轨道多态密度泛函理论（NEO-MSDFT）动力学，其中隧穿氢核被量子化，用于在反应物与产物的NEO-DFT非绝热电子振动表面相交的非绝热缝隙空间中采样几何构型。
AI.result: 在非绝热缝隙空间中，振动耦合因供体-受体距离的变化而显著变化；最小能量交叉点处的反应坐标与振动耦合梯度近乎正交，前者由稳定产物相对反应物的运动主导，后者由缩短供体-受体距离的运动主导。
AI.conclusion: V-SHAKE为理解和验证速率理论背后的基本假设提供了重要洞见和验证。

title: Accelerating stochastic processes through nonequilibrium driving: Thermodynamic constraints on the maximum speed-up
summary: We derive a new set of bounds controlling the speed-up of the survival rate of trajectory-dependent observables induced by the application of a perturbation. Via the study of survival probabilities in two different contexts, continuous-time Markov jump processes and overdamped diffusions, we obtain different fashions of the bound on the achievable boost. These bounds, obtained by a nonlinear response theory of constrained path probabilities, are explicitly linked to thermodynamics. For arbitrary time-dependent survival rates, we find a linear bound that depends on both the perturbation strength and the entropy production rate prior to the perturbation. For rare processes characterized by a constant survival rate, the bound is exponential and is determined by the excess heat generated by the perturbation. We exemplify the inequalities on two prototypical model systems, namely, a unicyclic network and forced diffusion in a bistable potential.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了一组新的约束条件，用以控制由扰动引起的轨迹依赖可观测量存活率加速上限。通过研究连续时间马尔可夫跳跃过程和过阻尼扩散两种情境下的存活概率，获得了不同形式的可实现加速上界，并将这些界限与热力学明确联系起来。
AI.motivation: 在随机动力学系统中，理解扰动如何加速稀有事件（如逃逸、转变）的存活率衰减是一个重要问题。作者希望建立扰动强度与存活率加速之间的定量热力学界限，为预测和控制轨迹依赖过程提供理论框架。
AI.method: 采用受约束路径概率的非线性响应理论，研究两类动态过程：(1) 连续时间马尔可夫跳跃过程；(2) 过阻尼扩散过程。针对任意时间依赖的存活率推导线性界限，针对恒定存活率的稀有过程推导指数界限。
AI.result: 对于任意时间依赖的存活率，得到了一个线性界限，同时依赖于扰动强度和扰动前的熵产生率。对于存活率恒定的稀有过程，界限呈指数形式，由扰动产生的过量热量决定。通过单环网络和双稳态势阱中的受迫扩散两个原型模型验证了不等式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了扰动驱动的存活率加速与热力学量（熵产生率和过量热）之间的定量联系，为稀有事件加速提供了统一的非线性响应理论框架。

title: Spectral Function Method and Janus Quantum Numbers in Quasiperiodic Systems
summary: The absence of translational symmetry in quasiperiodic systems invalidates conventional band theory, posing the central challenge in the field. Building upon the incommensurate energy band (IEB) concept, we establish a unified spectral theory for quasiperiodic systems by introducing two key advances. First, we develop an efficient spectral function method that calculates $A(k,ω)$ using a small truncated Hamiltonian matrix, bypassing full diagonalization. It converges via a distinctive successive locking of energy moments, yielding exact thermodynamic-limit results without finite-size scaling. Second, we introduce that quasiperiodic eigenstates possess Janus quantum numbers: a single eigenstate, continuously tracked across localization transitions, carries dual labels in momentum and real space, which naturally reduce to the familiar Bloch momentum and band index in the commensurate limit. Together with IEB, these advances constitute a ``band theory'' for quasiperiodic systems, enabling us to define, compute, and label states with the same facility as in periodic ones.

AI.tldr: 本文针对准周期系统缺乏平移对称性而无法应用传统能带理论的难题，基于非公度能带(IEB)概念建立统一的光谱理论，提出两项关键进展：高效的谱函数计算方法（避免全对角化）和"雅努斯量子数"（同一本征态兼具动量空间与实空间的双重标签），从而为准周期系统构建了一套可类比周期系统的"能带理论"。
AI.motivation: 准周期系统由于缺乏平移对称性，无法应用传统的布洛赫能带理论，这是该领域的核心挑战。解决这一对称性缺失带来的理论困境，使准周期系统也能像周期系统一样被方便地定义、计算和标记态，是本研究的主要动机。
AI.method: 该研究提出两项关键技术：一是发展高效的谱函数方法A(k,ω)，仅用小型截断哈密顿矩阵即可计算，无需全对角化，通过能量矩的逐级锁定实现收敛，无需有限尺寸标度即可获得精确热力学极限结果；二是引入"雅努斯量子数"概念，即准周期本征态在跨越局域化转变时被连续追踪，单一本征态同时携带动量空间与实空间的双重量子标签，在公度极限下自然退化为传统布洛赫动量与能带指标。
AI.result: 结合非公度能带(IEB)概念与上述两项进展，本文成功建立了准周期系统的统一光谱理论，使得准周期系统能够像周期系统一样方便地定义、计算和标记量子态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为准周期系统提供了一个完整的"能带理论"框架，弥合了准周期与周期系统之间的理论鸿沟，为理解和描述准周期系统中的电子性质提供了新的基础工具。

title: Such stuff as magic is made on: compact operator algebra, stabilizer polytope and the structure of reduced density matrices in a Kitaev spin liquid
summary: Quantum many-body systems exhibit rich and complex behaviour. Magic has recently emerged as a powerful new diagnostic for probing such systems, complementing other key features such as many-body entanglement. Here, starting from an investigation of the onset of magic within subsystems of a larger many-body quantum system, we show that intricate structures emerge which shed important light on the underlying many-body physics. Focusing on the Kitaev honeycomb model, we first identify the temperature below which local subsystems acquire magic. Remarkably, we find that the optimal magic witnesses active at the onset of magic reveal compact operator spaces that continue to capture the local thermal states throughout their subsequent evolution. For the six-site hexagonal marginal, this connection can be made stronger: the same operator space emerges independently from the symmetries of the local marginal and forms the symmetry-resolved plaquette algebra. When these symmetries are realized exactly, the local state lies entirely within this algebra and the reduced robustness of magic is equal to the full robustness of magic. The same reduced description can also be applied to other local quantum resources, which we illustrate using genuine multipartite entanglement. Furthermore, the operator spaces possess a rich algebraic structure in the form of finite-dimensional Euclidean Jordan algebras, with a natural interpretation in terms of bond and bond-cycle operators. Our general methodology therefore show how the onset of local magic can reveal a compact, physically meaningful operator structure underlying the finite-temperature Kitaev spin liquid, and opens up a new avenue towards reduced descriptions of quantum resources in many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多体量子系统中局域"魔幻性"(magic)的出现，以Kitaev蜂窝模型为例，发现局域热态获得魔幻性的温度阈值，并揭示出捕获这些状态的紧凑算子空间具有对称性分辨的plaquette代数结构及有限维欧几里得Jordan代数结构。
AI.motivation: 量子多体系统表现出丰富复杂的物理行为，魔幻性作为新兴的诊断工具可补充多体纠缠等传统度量。作者希望从子系统层面研究魔幻性的出现，以揭示底层多体物理的精细结构。
AI.method: 以Kitaev蜂窝模型为研究对象，考察更大多体系统中子系统的魔幻性出现阈值（温度）；利用最优魔幻性见证者识别活跃于魔幻性起始处的算子空间；对六比特六边形边界的局域边缘态，基于其对称性独立推导同一算子空间，构成对称性分辨的plaquette代数；并利用有限维欧几里得Jordan代数刻画这些算子空间的代数结构。
AI.result: 发现局域子系统获得魔幻性的温度阈值；最优魔幻性见证者揭示出紧凑算子空间，能持续刻画随后的局域热态演化；对于六比特六边形边缘态，该算子空间与对称性导出的plaquette代数一致；当对称性精确实现时，局域态的约化鲁棒魔幻性等于完整鲁棒魔幻性；该约化描述同样适用于多体纠缠等其他量子资源；算子空间体现为有限维欧几里得Jordan代数，可按键和键环算子进行自然诠释。
AI.conclusion: 局域魔幻性的出现能够揭示有限温度Kitaev自旋液体背后紧凑且物理上有意义的算子结构，为多体系统中量子资源的约化描述开辟了新途径。

title: Polaron Self-Trapping Rates from First Principles
summary: Polaron formation, also known as self-trapping, is a process akin to nonradiative carrier capture at point defects or impurities. In this work, we develop the formalism to determine how long it takes to form a small hole or electron polaron from first principles. We employ an accurate, fully first-principles approach based on a Koopmans compliant hybrid functional. The self-trapping rate is the product of two components: the nonradiative capture coefficient, which we evaluate using a one-dimensional approximation, and the maximum density of polaron sites, whose physics we elucidate based on finite-size interactions present in supercells. We apply our methodology to several technologically relevant materials known to host hole polarons, Ga$_2$O$_3$, Al$_2$O$_3$, BeO, KBr, MgO, NaCl, SiO$_2$, SnO$_2$, TiO$_2$, and ZnO, and to an electron polaron in rutile TiO$_2$. We also study an emerging semiconductor, rutile GeO$_2$, where we find that polaron formation could hamper $p$-type conductivity. The calculated self-trapping lifetimes span 7 orders of magnitude, from $10^{-1}$ to $10^6$~ps, in agreement with experiments where available, and providing detailed insight into the dynamics of carrier localization and relaxation in solids.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套基于第一性原理的形式化方法，用于计算小极化子（空穴或电子）的自陷形成时间。该方法采用Koopmans兼容的杂化泛函，将自陷速率分解为非辐射俘获系数与极化子位点最大密度的乘积。作者将该方法应用于多种技术相关材料，计算得到的自陷寿命跨越7个数量级（10^-1到10^6 ps），与实验数据吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 极化子形成（自陷）类似于非辐射载流子俘获过程，对材料的载流子输运和光电性能有重要影响。然而，此前缺乏从第一性原理精确确定小极化子形成时间的形式化框架，这限制了人们对载流子局域化和弛豫动力学的深入理解。
AI.method: 基于Koopmans兼容的杂化泛函的完全第一性原理方法。自陷速率作为两个分量的乘积：(1) 使用一维近似评估的非辐射俘获系数；(2) 极化子位点的最大密度，其物理机制通过超胞中的有限尺寸相互作用来阐明。
AI.result: 应用于多种已知寄主空穴极化子的材料（Ga2O3、Al2O3、BeO、KBr、MgO、NaCl、SiO2、SnO2、TiO2和ZnO）以及金红石TiO2中的电子极化子。还研究了新兴半导体金红石GeO2，发现极化子形成可能阻碍p型导电。计算的自陷寿命跨越7个数量级（10^-1到10^6 ps），与可用实验数据一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了从第一性原理定量计算极化子自陷动力学的可靠框架，揭示了多种材料中载流子局域化和弛豫的详细物理图像，并指出极化子形成可能是限制金红石GeO2实现p型导电的关键因素。

title: Frenkel line of Yukawa fluids within the self-consistent relaxation theory
summary: For a simple model fluid, the Yukawa fluid, the condition for dynamic crossover, known as the Frenkel line, is defined. The condition is related to the fact that the roton minimum in the dispersion relation of longitudinal acoustic-like excitations exists only when the collective vibrational dynamics of particles dominates in the liquid. Based on the self-consistent relaxation theory for the Yukawa fluid, thermodynamic states are determined in which the roton minimum disappears. The obtained values of the state parameters for the Frenkel line are consistent with the results of studies in which the position of this line on the phase diagram of the Yukawa fluid was determined using molecular dynamics simulations. It is shown that the Frenkel line in this system can be determined directly from the structural characteristic -- the static structure factor. A physical interpretation of the roton minimum frequency for the simple liquids near the Frenkel line is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自洽弛豫理论研究了Yukawa流体中Frenkel线的动态交叉条件，发现该条件与纵声学激发色散关系中roton最小值的消失相关，并证明了Frenkel线可直接由静态结构因子确定。
AI.motivation: 在简单流体（Yukawa流体）中，需要明确动态交叉（Frenkel线）的物理条件。此前Frenkel线的位置主要通过分子动力学模拟确定，缺乏基于理论框架的严格定义，也缺少与结构特性直接关联的判据。
AI.method: 基于自洽弛豫理论（self-consistent relaxation theory）分析Yukawa流体的纵声学激发色散关系，确定roton最小值消失对应的热力学状态；并将理论结果与分子动力学模拟结果对比验证，同时利用静态结构因子作为Frenkel线的直接判定依据。
AI.result: 确定了Yukawa流体中roton最小值消失的相图位置，所得Frenkel线状态参数与分子动力学模拟结果一致；证明了Frenkel线可由静态结构因子直接确定；并提出了近Frenkel线处roton最小频率的物理解释。
AI.conclusion: Frenkel线的本质条件是液体中roton最小值消失，即集体振动动力学不再主导粒子运动；该线可通过静态结构因子这一结构特征直接确定，为简单液体的动态交叉提供了理论依据和实用判据。

title: Low-Frequency Charge Noise in Bilayer Graphene Quantum Dots
summary: Bilayer graphene (BLG) quantum dots (QDs) are a promising platform for semiconductor qubits. However, the low-frequency charge noise that may ultimately limit coherence has remained largely unexplored. Here, we systematically characterize charge noise in gate-defined BLG QDs using transport-based noise spectroscopy. We extract a median amplitude of $ S_μ^{1/2} (1~\text{Hz}) = 1.16~μ\text{eV}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, placing BLG well within the range reported for established semiconductor quantum-dot platforms. Across variations in charge occupation, confinement, source-drain bias, and charge-sensor operating conditions, neither the noise amplitude nor the spectral dependence shows a reproducible trend in electrostatic tuning, indicating that we extracted the intrinsic semiconductor noise. Consistent noise levels are further observed in double QDs and confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout. Extending the study to BLG devices incorporating transition metal dichalcogenide layers reveals no measurable charge noise increase in weakly proximitized QDs. These results validate BLG as a viable platform for coherent quantum information processing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统表征了栅极定义的 bilayer graphene (BLG) 量子点中的低频电荷噪声，测得中位噪声幅度 S_μ^{1/2}(1Hz)=1.16 μeV/√Hz，与已建立的半导体量子点平台相当。噪声幅度和频谱特性对静电调谐参数无重复性趋势依赖，表明提取的是本征半导体噪声。双量子点及超导谐振器色散读出实验均证实了噪声水平的一致性；弱近邻化的过渡金属二硫族化物层不会引入可测量的电荷噪声增加。
AI.motivation: BLG 量子点是半导体量子比特的有前景平台，但可能最终限制相干性的低频电荷噪声此前尚未被充分研究，因此需要系统表征以验证其可行性。
AI.method: 采用基于输运的噪声光谱学对栅极定义的 BLG 量子点进行系统表征；通过改变电荷占据数、约束条件、源漏偏压和电荷传感器工作条件等参数来评估噪声特性；并使用超导谐振器色散读出作为独立验证手段确认噪声水平。
AI.result: 测得中位噪声幅度为 1.16 μeV/√Hz@1Hz，位于已建立半导体量子点平台报告的范围之内；噪声水平不随静电调谐参数呈现可重复性趋势，说明是本征噪声；双量子点与独立谐振器读出结果一致；弱近邻 TMD 层不增加可测电荷噪声。
AI.conclusion: BLG 具备与成熟半导体平台相当的电荷噪声表现，验证了其作为相干量子信息处理的可行平台。

title: Competing lattice structures induced by Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
summary: Understanding the effect of chemical substitution on competing phases of kagome metals is crucial for disentangling the interplay between local structural distortions and electronic instabilities. In \cvs, Sn substitution strongly modifies the electronic phase diagram, yet the microscopic mechanism driving this remains unclear. Here, we combine $^{121}$Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements and density functional theory calculations to investigate the atomic-scale effects of Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_{5-x}$Sn$_x$. At low Sn concentrations, the observed satellite NQR peaks exhibit signatures of local structural distortion induced by Sn substitution, qualitatively consistent with our computational analysis. These impurity-induced features persist across the entire experimentally investigated doping range, up to $x$ = 0.65, and remain observable up to room temperature. For $x=1$, the fully doped idealized case, the estimated dynamical instabilities of the kagome lattice suggest the stabilization of two nearly energy-degenerate equilibrium structures characterized by V-trimers, distinguished by a zero- or $π$-phase shift between adjacent layers along the $c$-axis. Together, these results show that Sn substitution drives a complex interplay between local impurity-induced distortions and competing structural instabilities in vanadium-based kagome compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过¹²¹Sb核四极共振(NQR)测量和密度泛函理论(DFT)计算，研究了CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ中Sn取代对kagome金属竞争相态的原子尺度影响。发现低Sn浓度下存在由取代引起的局部结构畸变，这些杂质诱导特征在整个掺杂范围内持续存在；在x=1的理想掺杂情况下，预测了两个近简并的V三聚体平衡结构。
AI.motivation: 理解化学取代对kagome金属竞争相态的影响对于厘清局部结构畸变与电子不稳定性之间的相互作用至关重要。在CsV₃Sb₅中，Sn取代强烈改变了电子相图，但其微观机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 结合¹²¹Sb核四极共振(NQR)测量与密度泛函理论(DFT)计算，系统研究CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ中Sn取代的原子尺度效应。通过观察NQR卫星峰来探测Sn诱导的局部结构畸变，并利用DFT分析kagome晶格在不同掺杂浓度下的动力学不稳定性。
AI.result: 低Sn浓度下观测到由Sn取代引起的局部结构畸变NQR卫星峰信号，与计算结果定性一致。这些杂质诱导特征在整个掺杂范围(x≤0.65)内持续存在，并可观测至室温。对x=1的完全掺杂理想化情况，DFT预测kagome晶格存在动力学不稳定性，稳定化了两个近能量简并的V三聚体平衡结构，区别在于沿c轴相邻层间为零相位或π相位位移。
AI.conclusion: Sn取代在钒基kagome化合物中驱动了局部杂质诱导畸变与竞争结构不稳定性之间复杂的相互作用，揭示了化学掺杂对kagome金属电子相图影响的微观机制。

title: Interplay of B-Site Off-Centering and Molecular Orientations in the Mixed Hybrid Perovskite MAGe1xSnxI3
summary: B-site mixing is a common strategy for tuning properties of halide perovskites. In the lead-free system MAGe1-xSn_xI3, it brings tilting and off-centering into competition. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential, we map the structural behavior across the full composition range. MAGeI3 exhibits strong polar B-site off-centering that remains nearly constant up to the cubic transition, together with methylammonium (MA) orientational order that weakens progressively on heating. By contrast, MASnI3 combines octahedral tilting with weaker, predominantly antipolar off-centering. Ge-like behavior persists upon alloying and gives way to Sn-like behavior only beyond roughly 65 % Sn. In the high-temperature phases, the B-site cations remain locally off-centered but directionally disordered. On the Ge-rich side, the distorted inorganic framework biases the soft MA orientational landscape toward a restricted set of preferred directions. This coupling shows how the composition of the inorganic sublattice can tune molecular ordering in lead-free hybrid perovskites.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习势函数驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟，系统研究了无铅杂化钙钛矿MAGe1-xSnxI3在整个组成范围内的结构行为，揭示了B位阳离子偏心与八面体 tilting 之间的竞争、MA分子取向有序性随组成和温度的变化规律，以及无机亚晶格组成对分子取向的调控机制。
AI.motivation: B位混合是调控卤化物钙钛矿性质的常用策略，但在无铅体系MAGe1-xSnxI3中，tilting与off-centering效应相互竞争，其全组成范围内的结构演化机制尚不清楚，理解这一竞争关系对于设计无铅杂化钙钛矿至关重要。
AI.method: 采用机器学习势函数（machine-learned interatomic potential）驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟，对MAGe1-xSnxI3体系在全组成范围（x从0到1）进行结构表征，分析B位off-centering、八面体tilting以及MA取向有序性随组成和温度的变化。
AI.result: MAGeI3具有强极性B位偏心且几乎恒定至立方转变，伴随MA取向有序性随加热减弱；MASnI3则将八面体tilting与较弱且主要为反极性的偏心结合。合金中Ge-like行为持续存在，仅在超过约65% Sn后才过渡为Sn-like行为。高温相中B位阳离子仍局部偏心但方向无序，Ge-rich侧畸变的无机框架将软MA取向景观偏向受限的择优方向。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现无铅杂化钙钛矿无机亚晶格的组成可以调控分子取向有序性，通过B位混合可实现tilting与off-centering之间的竞争平衡，进而调控MA分子取向行为，为设计新型无铅杂化钙钛矿材料提供了理论指导。

title: Performance of Nanoring-based Transparent Conductors: a Computational Investigation
summary: Metallic nanoring networks can serve as promising flexible transparent electrodes. These materials are crucial components in a wide range of applications, including solar cells, touchscreens and displays. In this work, a computational investigation considers in detail (i) the electrical conductance and optical performance of nanoring networks and (ii) the breakdown of these networks due to electrical damage. The electrical resistance of both the nanorings and the contacts between the rings (junctions) is taken into account. In part (i), the effects of 5 parameters on the electrical sheet resistance and optical transparency are presented. It is shown that several parameter combinations achieve better performance in comparison to indium tin oxide, currently the most widely used transparent electrode. In part (ii), due to electrical damage, the nanoring systems display the formation of a crack, running parallel to the vertical terminals, where a voltage difference is applied. The network degradation is measured by its sheet resistance, and a universal effect is observed: networks with varying filling factors exhibit the same degradation profile.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计算模拟研究了金属纳米环网络作为柔性透明电极的性能，包括电导率、光学性能及电损伤导致的退化机制。研究发现多种参数组合性能优于目前广泛使用的ITO透明电极，且网络在电损伤下呈现出与填充因子无关的普适退化规律。
AI.motivation: 金属纳米环网络有望成为柔性透明电极的关键材料，应用于太阳能电池、触摸屏和显示器等领域。然而，目前对其电学性能和光学性能的系统性理解不足，特别是在电损伤下的退化行为尚不明确，需要进行详细的计算研究。
AI.method: 采用计算模拟方法，分别研究：(i) 纳米环网络的电导率和光学性能，考虑纳米环本体电阻及环间接触（结点）电阻，系统考察5个参数对电学方阻和光学透过率的影响；(ii) 电损伤导致的网络破裂，通过施加电压差并测量方阻变化来表征网络退化程度，考察不同填充因子的网络退化行为。
AI.result: (i) 多种参数组合可实现优于ITO的电学与光学综合性能；(ii) 电损伤导致网络沿平行于垂直端子的方向形成裂纹，网络退化通过方阻测量表征，且发现普适效应：不同填充因子的网络表现出相同的退化曲线。
AI.conclusion: 金属纳米环网络在适当的参数配置下可作为优于ITO的柔性透明电极替代方案；其电损伤退化行为具有普适性规律，这一发现有助于预测和设计更可靠的纳米环网络电极。

title: Optimal Control of Periodic Nonequilibrium Mechanochemical Systems via Automatic Differentiation
summary: Biological molecular machines are mesoscopic systems that act repeatedly and periodically to perform important cellular tasks while contending with strong fluctuations and operating in an overdamped regime. Optimal control theory is a tool that can be used to understand the design principles behind efficient operation of these machines; however, most studies on optimal control of classical mesoscopic systems have focused on control problems that do not repeat periodically. Here, we automatically differentiate Fokker-Planck simulations to design efficient nonequilibrium control strategies for simple models of periodic molecular machines with and without explicit changes in the machine's chemical state. The designed protocols and theoretical analysis provide insight into the design principles governing efficient driving in these nonequilibrium systems. Designed control protocols should seek to reduce mechanical heat by rotating the entire angular probability distribution at a constant speed without changing its shape, and should reduce chemical heat by reducing the proportion of chemical transitions with large heat.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用自动微分Fokker-Planck模拟，为周期性分子机器设计高效的非平衡控制策略，发现最优协议应通过整体旋转角概率分布（保持形状不变）以减少机械热，并通过减少高热量化学跃迁比例以减少化学热。
AI.motivation: 生物分子机器是介观系统，需要在强涨落和过阻尼条件下周期性运作完成细胞任务。最优控制理论有助于理解这些机器高效运作的设计原理，但以往对经典介观系统最优控制的研究大多聚焦于非周期性控制问题，缺乏对周期性分子机器的研究。
AI.method: 对Fokker-Planck模拟进行自动微分（automatic differentiation），以设计简单周期性分子机器模型的高效非平衡控制协议，模型包含有无显式化学状态变化的两种情况，并结合理论分析加以验证。
AI.result: 设计出的最优控制协议揭示了高效驱动设计原则：为减少机械热，应使整个角概率分布以恒定速度转动而保持形状不变；为减少化学热，应降低具有大热量化学跃迁的比例。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为周期性分子机器的非平衡控制提供了新的设计见解，揭示了减少机械热与化学热的不同控制原则，有助于理解生物分子机器的设计优化原理。

title: Weak-coupling theory of half-metals and other fractional metallic phases in biased doped Bernal bilayer graphene
summary: The paper presents a theoretical study of many-body electronic phases in doped and electrically biased Bernal-stacked (AB) bilayer graphene. We develop a variational mean-field theory with no fitted parameters. For the electron-electron interaction, we employ a parameter-free random-phase approximation to model the short-range screened Coulomb repulsion. The remaining long-range Coulomb potential energy is dictated by the geometry of the sample, behaving as a parallel-plate capacitor. We formulate the theory directly in terms of the experimentally controlled displacement field $\frak D$ rather than the interaction-renormalized interlayer potential difference. It makes our theory better suited for direct comparison with experiment. The resulting phase diagram is quite rich. It hosts several fractional-metal states connected by first- and second-order transitions. At higher bias and doping, three distinct fractional metallic states emerge. We classify these phases by the number of doped sectors and the symmetry of the order parameters. Our results - obtained without any parameter fitting - reproduce key qualitative and quantitative features of recent experiments. This includes the energy scale associated with the loss of fractional metallic order. At lower bias and doping, the model stabilizes a broad spectrum of fractional-metal phases with more exotic symmetry-breaking patterns. This suggests that further experimental exploration of the latter regime is warranted.

AI.tldr: 本文对掺杂和电偏置的Bernal堆叠(AB)双层石墨烯中的多体电子相进行了理论研究，提出了一种无拟合参数的变分平均场理论，构建了丰富的相图，涵盖了多个分数金属态，并成功复现了近期实验的关键定性与定量特征。
AI.motivation: 理解掺杂和电偏置下Bernal双层石墨烯中电子-电子相互作用所驱动的多体物理相（尤其是分数金属态），并建立与实验可直接对比的理论框架，从而揭示这些新奇量子相的起源与性质。
AI.method: 采用无拟合参数的变分平均场理论；电子间相互作用使用无参数随机相位近似(RPA)来建模短程屏蔽库仑排斥；长程库仑势能由样品几何决定（平行板电容器行为）；理论直接以实验可控的位移场D而非相互作用重整化的层间势差来表述。
AI.result: 得到的相图十分丰富，包含多个由一阶和二阶相变连接的分数金属态。在较高偏置和掺杂下出现三种不同的分数金属态，按掺杂扇区数和序参量对称性进行分类。模型无需参数拟合即可复现实验的关键定性与定量特征，包括分数金属序消失相关的能量尺度。在较低偏置和掺杂下还稳定了具有更奇特对称性破缺模式的宽谱分数金属相。
AI.conclusion: 该无拟合参数理论成功捕捉了实验观测的分数金属态关键特征，验证了理论框架的有效性；同时预测低偏置低掺杂区存在更多具有新奇对称性破缺的分数金属相，建议实验在该区域进行更深入的探索。

title: Non-Resonant Impulsively Stimulated Raman Scattering by a Terahertz Field: a Case Study of 1T-TaS2
summary: Time-domain ultrafast and nonlinear terahertz spectroscopy techniques are recently applied to many condensed matter systems for investigating their collective excitations. In centrosymmetric systems, these collective modes are typically Raman-active and therefore do not couple directly to the terahertz electric field. The mechanism by which light-matter interaction realizes in these studies has not been explicitly discussed in detail. In this work, we perform terahertz pump - optical probe and terahertz third harmonic generation investigations on 1T-TaS2, a material exhibiting a rich charge-density-wave (CDW) phase diagram including the commensurate, nearly-commensurate and incommensurate CDW phases. The transition between these distinct states leaves a clear signature on the dynamical Raman response. We investigate how the Raman-active phonons couple to a broadband monocycle terahertz field as well as a narrowband multicycle terahertz field. Our results indicate that a modified impulsively stimulated Raman scattering mechanism involving two-photon absorption, also known as non-resonant Raman scattering, underlies the coherent excitation and observation of the lattice modes. These results are relevant for future spectroscopy investigation and coherent control of collective modes using low-energy terahertz field as well as cavity electrodynamical dressing of solids.

AI.tldr: 本文对1T-TaS2材料进行了太赫兹泵浦-光探测和太赫兹三次谐波产生研究，揭示了在中心对称体系中拉曼活性声子与太赫兹电场耦合的机制，表明非共振拉曼散射（包含双光子吸收的修正冲激拉曼散射机制）是其相干激发和观测的潜在机制。
AI.motivation: 在中心对称系统中，集体激发模式通常是拉曼活性的，不能直接与太赫兹电场耦合。然而，超快太赫兹光谱技术在这些系统中已被广泛应用，光-物质相互作用的实现机制却未得到明确详细的讨论。本文旨在阐明这一机制。
AI.method: 作者对1T-TaS2进行了太赫兹泵浦-光探测和太赫兹三次谐波产生实验。1T-TaS2具有丰富的电荷密度波相图（包括公度、近公度和非公度CDW相）。作者研究了拉曼活性声子与宽带单周期太赫兹场及窄带多周期太赫兹场的耦合，通过比较不同CDW相之间转变在动力学拉曼响应上的特征来解析耦合机制。
AI.result: 结果表明，这些不同的CDW相之间的转变在动力学拉曼响应上留下了清晰的标志。拉曼活性声子的相干激发和观测是由一种修正的冲激拉曼散射机制（涉及双光子吸收，即非共振拉曼散射）所主导的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究阐明了太赫兹场在中心对称体系中激发拉曼活性集体模式的机制，对未来利用低能太赫兹场进行光谱研究、集体模式相干控制以及固体腔电动力学调控等领域具有重要意义。

title: Electron-phonon coupled hydrodynamics in semimetal TaAs_2
summary: Hydrodynamic corrections to diffusive transport can arise when momentum-conserving collisions between quasiparticles become prominent, and they have been documented for both electrons and phonons. An emerging frontier topic is coupled electron-phonon (e-ph) hydrodynamics. Here, through electrical and thermal transport measurements on TaAs2 crystals with different impurity levels, we document the emergence of an e-ph bifluid in the temperature window of 5 to 15 K. Within this range, the lattice thermal conductivity exhibits a faster-than-T^3 temperature dependence, as a consequence of non-monotonic and purity-dependent phonon mean free paths, a signature of phonon Poiseuille flow. However, strong e-ph coupling impedes the emergence of a ballistic regime. This is corroborated by the observation of quantum oscillations in the lattice thermal conductivity. Prominent phonon-mediated momentum exchange between electrons amplifies the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law and yields a two-order-of-magnitude discrepancy between quantum and transport lifetimes, a signature of electron hydrodynamics in semimetals. Our results imply that in semimetals with optimized e-ph coupling, thanks to matching between the cryogenic phonon wave?length and the Fermi wavelength, momentum and energy flow between the electron and phonon reservoirs as frequently as within each reservoir.

AI.tldr: 本文通过TaAs2晶体的电学和热输运测量，在5-15K温区首次证实了电子-声子双流体（e-ph bifluid）现象，其标志包括声子Poiseuille流导致的非单调声子平均自由程、晶格热导率超T^3的温度依赖，以及强电子-声子耦合下Wiedemann-Franz定律的两数量级违背。
AI.motivation: 电子流体动力学和声子流体动力学已被分别研究，但电子-声子耦合流体动力学（e-ph hydrodynamics）是新兴前沿课题，此前缺乏实验证据。作者旨在通过不同杂质水平的TaAs2晶体，在实验上证实电子-声子双流体行为的存在。
AI.method: 对具有不同杂质水平的TaAs2单晶进行系统的电输运和热输运测量；通过分析5-15K温区内晶格热导率的温度依赖关系、声子平均自由程的纯度依赖及非单调行为，以及量子振荡和量子/输运寿命的比较来表征流体动力学行为。
AI.result: 在5-15K温度窗口观察到声子Poiseuille流（晶格热导率呈快于T^3的温度依赖），但强e-ph耦合抑制了弹道输运；热导率中出现量子振荡；强声子介导的电子间动量交换使Wiedemann-Franz定律被违背达两个数量级，量子寿命与输运寿命相差两个数量级，符合半金属中电子流体动力学特征。
AI.conclusion: 在半金属中当低温声子波长与费米波长匹配时，优化的电子-声子耦合可使动量与能量在电子和声子库之间的交换频率与各库内部相当，从而形成电子-声子双流体。这一发现为耦合流体动力学输运提供了实验证据。

title: Sample-specific rectification-like response in a boundary-driven exclusion process
summary: We investigate the current response of a boundary-driven symmetric exclusion process with quenched site disorder. Hard-core particles hop symmetrically on a one-dimensional lattice with site-dependent rates and are injected and removed at the boundaries by two reservoirs of different densities. We approximate the steady-state density profile using a Galerkin projection at linear order and a mean-field closure at higher orders, and thereby obtain the current as a nonlinear function of the reservoir density difference. At linear order in the reservoir density difference, the current-response coefficient depends on the mean reservoir density $ρ$, in contrast to the homogeneous case. Through the linear-response relation, this dependence leads to an equilibrium current-fluctuation coefficient that is asymmetric under $ρ\rightarrow 1-ρ$. Beyond linear response, nonzero even-order current contributions break the antisymmetry of the current under reversal of the reservoir density difference, producing rectification-like behavior in individual disorder realizations. We further show that spatial-reflection symmetry of the equilibrium density profile rules out such behavior, so broken spatial-reflection symmetry of the profile is a necessary condition for rectification-like behavior. Within the present approximation, we further find that, for continuously distributed site disorder, rectification-like behavior occurs arbitrarily close to equilibrium for almost every disorder realization. At the ensemble level, however, the disorder-averaged current remains antisymmetric because the disorder ensemble is invariant under spatial reflection. These results provide a mechanism for rectification-like transport arising from sample-specific spatial heterogeneity rather than from an explicitly imposed directional asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有淬火无序的边界驱动对称排斥过程。利用Galerkin投影和平均场闭合近似，作者获得了电流作为库密度差非线性函数的表达式。发现线性响应系数依赖于平均密度，导致电流涨落系数在ρ→1-ρ下不对称。高阶偶数阶电流贡献打破反反对称性，产生类整流行为，其必要条件为平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺。但系综平均层面电流仍保持反对称。
AI.motivation: 探索无序系统中由样本特定空间异质性而非显式方向不对称性引起的类整流输运现象的机制，理解无序如何影响平衡与非平衡输运特性。
AI.method: 对一维晶格上具有位点依赖速率的边界驱动对称排斥过程，采用Galerkin投影在线性阶、平均场闭合在高阶近似稳态密度剖面，从而获得电流作为库密度差的非线性函数。同时分析空间反射对称性与电流反对称性的关系。
AI.result: 电流-响应系数在库密度差的一阶依赖于平均密度ρ；偶数阶电流贡献打破反对称性并产生类整流行为；空间反射对称性的破缺是类整流行为的必要条件；对连续分布位点无序，几乎所有无序实现都在接近平衡时出现类整流行为；但系综平均电流仍保持反对称。
AI.conclusion: 无序引起平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺，为样本特定（单次实现）的类整流输运提供了机制，而非依赖显式施加的方向性不对称。系综层面避免整流体现了无序集合的空间反射不变性。

title: Generalized s-d model for Wannier-Mott excitons in layered magnetic semiconductors
summary: The recent discovery of excitons coupled to the magnetic order, and the consequent strong magneto-optic responses, in some van der Waals magnetic semiconductors has triggered intense activity at the interface of magnetism and semiconductor optics. Here, we present an analytically tractable minimal model that describes magnetic order, electrons, holes, and excitons within a unified framework, thereby capturing a wide range of phenomena. It treats the magnetic order and itinerant carriers to be comprised by distinct electronic orbitals that are mutually coupled via orbital-dependent onsite exchange, similar to the treatment of metallic magnets using an s-d model. Investigating CrSBr bilayer as a case study, we benchmark our model and its predictions against recent experimental and ab-initio results finding good agreement as well as new insights enabled by the model's simplicity. Examining the optical selection rules, we find the conservation of a quantum number formed from a combination of spin and layer pseudospin to be a useful guiding principle, even in noncollinear magnetic configurations. Our analysis finds a series of bright and dark excitonic states in such layered A-type antiferromagnets. The presented framework should be valuable in achieving intuitive understanding of recently discovered excitonic phenomena and guiding the discovery of other excitonic states in layered magnetic semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个解析可解的极简模型，在统一框架下描述范德华磁性半导体中的磁序、电子、空穴和激子。该模型将磁序与巡游载流子视为由不同电子轨道构成、通过轨道依赖的局域交换耦合（类似s-d模型），并以CrSBr双层作为案例验证，结果与实验及ab-initio计算吻合良好。研究发现自旋与层赝自旋组合成的守恒量子数可作为光学选择定则的指导原则，并揭示了A型反铁磁体中一系列亮态和暗态激子。
AI.motivation: 近期在范德华磁性半导体中发现激子与磁序耦合以及强磁光响应现象，激起了磁学与半导体光学交叉领域的广泛兴趣，但目前缺乏一个既简洁又能统一描述多种相关现象的解析模型来提供直观理解。
AI.method: 构建一个解析可解的极简模型，将磁序与载流子视为由不同电子轨道组成，二者通过轨道依赖的局域交换相互耦合（类比金属磁体的s-d模型），在统一框架下描述磁序、电子、空穴和激子。以CrSBr双层为案例进行模型基准测试，并分析光学选择定则及激子态结构。
AI.result: 模型在CrSBr双层上与近期实验及ab-initio结果吻合良好，并提供新见解。研究发现由自旋和层赝自旋组合而成的量子数在光学跃迁中守恒，即使非共线磁构型下也可作为选择定则的指导原则。分析发现此类层状A型反铁磁体中存在一系列亮态与暗态激子。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架有助于直观理解新近发现的激子现象，并可为层状磁性半导体中其他激子态的发现提供理论指导。

title: Hidden Magnetic Octupolar Order driven by Spin-Orbit coupling in KFeF$_3$
summary: Phase transitions are typically driven by symmetry-breaking structural distortions that lift electronic degeneracies, yet in some cases, these transitions may be driven by a hidden order without conventional structural signatures. Here, we demonstrate that the 3$d$ perovskite, KFeF$_3$, hosts such a hidden instability. Using a combination of high-resolution powder diffraction, magnetometry, symmetry-based analysis and first principles calculations, we reveal that while the 90 K cubic to rhombohedral transition arises from conventional magnetostriction accompanying antiferromagnetic order, a second transition at 40 K lowers the symmetry to monoclinic without any detectable Jahn-Teller distortion or translational symmetry-breaking. Symmetry-based Landau analysis supports a hidden zone centered magnetic octupole order parameter, whose improper coupling accounts for the weak ferromagnetism and pronounced symmetry-breaking strain. Density functional calculations show that spin-orbit coupling suppresses the competing Jahn-Teller instability, and thereby favors higher rank magnetic multipolar degrees of freedom. These findings establish KFeF$_3$ as a model system in which the competing energy scales between spin-orbit coupling and orbital degeneracy result in the emergence of hidden, multipolar order. We show that the control of such magnetic, multipolar order could, in principle, provide a route to induce altermagnetism.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了KFeF₃钙钛矿中存在一种隐藏的磁性多极序（磁八极序），该序在40K处驱动对称性从菱方降至单斜，而不伴随传统的结构畸变或Jahn-Teller效应。通过粉末衍射、磁测量、对称性分析和第一性原理计算相结合，证明该相变源于自旋轨道耦合与轨道简并之间的竞争，从而产生无结构特征的隐藏多极有序。
AI.motivation: 探索在没有传统结构对称性破缺（如Jahn-Teller畸变）的情况下，相变是否可由隐藏序（如高阶磁性多极序）驱动，从而扩展对相变机制的理解，并为实现交变磁性（altermagnetism）提供可能路径。
AI.method: 结合高分辨率粉末衍射、磁测量（磁化率）、对称性分析与Landau理论、以及基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算，综合分析KFeF₃在两个相变温度（90K和40K）处的结构、磁性和电子特性。
AI.result: 发现90K处菱方相变源于反铁磁序伴随的传统磁致伸缩；而40K处单斜相变无Jahn-Teller畸变或平移对称破缺，由隐藏的区中心磁八极序参数驱动，其非本征耦合产生弱铁磁性和显著对称破缺应变。DFT表明自旋轨道耦合抑制了Jahn-Teller不稳定性并利于高秩磁性多极自由度的出现。
AI.conclusion: KFeF₃是研究自旋轨道耦合与轨道简并竞争导致隐藏多极序浮现的模型体系，控制此类磁性多极序原则上可为诱导交变磁性提供新途径。

title: Orbital-Free DFT-Assisted Machine-Learned Molecular Dynamics for Electric-Field-Driven Ionic Transport
summary:
We propose an orbital-free density functional theory (OFDFT)-assisted machine-learned molecular dynamics method in which field-independent interatomic forces are evaluated using a machine-learned potential and atomic charges that depend on the local environment are obtained from OFDFT calculations. The atomic charges obtained by Bader partitioning of the OFDFT electron density are multiplied by the electric-field vector and added to the forces from the machine-learned potential. This approach enables molecular dynamics simulations under an electric field at a lower computational cost than Kohn-Sham DFT (KSDFT)-based molecular dynamics.
  As a proof of concept, the method was applied to beta-Li3PS4 bulk and an S8/Li3PS4 heterostructure under periodic boundary conditions. For Li3PS4 bulk, OFDFT yielded Li charges and a total charge of the PS4 unit consistent with those obtained using KSDFT. In the heterostructure, Li ions migrated from the Li3PS4 region into the S-rich region within a simulation time of approximately 170 ps. Accompanying this migration, the mean Bader charge of the S atoms that initially formed S8 rings changed from nearly neutral to negative. A comparison with KSDFT for a representative interfacial structure also confirmed that the negative charging of the S atoms upon the arrival of Li and the magnitude of the Li charges were qualitatively reproduced. These results demonstrate the possibility of treating field-driven ionic transport and changes in interfacial charge states using a universal machine-learned potential without training an additional material-specific charge-prediction model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无轨道密度泛函理论（OFDFT）辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法，通过机器学习势评估与局部环境相关的原子间力，并由OFDFT计算获得依赖局部环境的原子电荷。电荷与电场矢量相乘后加到机器学习势的力上，从而以低于Kohn-Sham DFT的代价实现电场下的分子动力学模拟。该方法在β-Li3PS4块体和S8/Li3PS4异质结构中验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统的KSDFT基分子动力学模拟在电场下的计算成本极高，而纯机器学习势方法难以处理电场导致的电荷重新分布。需要一种既能捕捉电场驱动下电荷态变化、又计算成本可控的方法来模拟离子输运过程。
AI.method: 1) 使用机器学习势评估与电场无关的原子间力；2) 从OFDFT计算获得电子密度，通过Bader划分得到原子电荷；3) 将原子电荷乘以电场矢量，作为额外的力项添加到机器学习势中；4) 由此实现无需训练额外的材料特定电荷预测模型即可进行电场下的分子动力学模拟。
AI.result: 1) Li3PS4块体中，OFDFT给出的Li电荷和PS4单元总电荷与KSDFT结果一致；2) 在S8/Li3PS4异质结构中，Li离子在约170 ps内从Li3PS4区域迁移进入富硫区域；3) 迁移伴随S原子（原本构成S8环）的平均Bader电荷从近中性变为负性；4) 与KSDFT在代表性界面结构的比较确认了定性一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了使用通用机器学习势处理场驱动离子输运和界面电荷态变化是可行的，无需为特定材料额外训练电荷预测模型，为研究电场下的固态电解质离子动力学提供了高效计算工具。

title: Real-space Floquet topology written by the orbital angular momentum of light
summary: Floquet engineering usually treats light as a uniform control field that changes the topology of an entire driven material. Here we show that structured light carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) enables a different regime, in which topology is written directly in real space. For ultrathin topological insulator films, circularly polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beams generate a radial Floquet mass whose sign changes define a topological annulus bounded by two concentric chiral ring modes. The transition is helicity selective: below a thickness-dependent critical frequency, left-circularly polarized light drives mass inversion, whereas right-circularly polarized light increases the gap and leaves the film trivial. Independently, the OAM quantum number shifts and reshapes the annulus without changing the frequency, intensity, or helicity. In the decoupled-surfaces limit, the same mechanism produces a purely Floquet-induced topological mass and a vortex-core zero mode. These results identify photon OAM as a control parameter for nonequilibrium topology and provide a route to programmable topological landscapes in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了利用携带轨道角动量(OAM)的结构光实现拓扑性质的实空间写入。在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束产生径向Floquet质量，其符号变化定义了由两个同心手性环模包围的拓扑环带，并揭示了光子OAM作为非平衡拓扑控制参数的新机制。
AI.motivation: 传统的Floquet工程将光视为均匀控制场，只能改变整个驱动材料的拓扑性质，缺乏在实空间中灵活调控拓扑结构的能力。作者希望探索一种新的机制，利用结构光的空间变化特性直接将拓扑写入实空间，从而为可编程拓扑景观提供可能。
AI.method: 作者理论研究了超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜受到携带OAM的圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束驱动的情形。光束的径向强度分布产生空间变化的Floquet质量项，通过分析该Floquet质量符号转变来确定拓扑环带的几何构型，并研究了不同光斑参数（频率、强度、螺旋度、OAM量子数）对拓扑结构的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 径向Floquet质量的符号变化定义了由两个同心手性环模包围的拓扑环带；2) 转变具有螺旋度选择性——低于临界频率时，左旋光驱动质量反转而右旋光保持平庸；3) OAM量子数可独立改变环带的形状和位置，不依赖频率、强度或螺旋度；4) 在退耦表面极限下产生纯Floquet诱导的拓扑质量和涡旋核心零模。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了光子OAM作为非平衡拓扑的控制参数，开启了一个不同于均匀Floquet驱动的新物理机制，为在量子材料中实现可编程拓扑景观提供了可行路径。

title: Fermi-Point Topology Determines Emergent Conformal Criticality in Extended Quantum Spin Chains
summary: Quantum criticality in one-dimensional quantum systems is characterized by emergent conformal field theories (CFTs), whose central charge counts independent gapless degrees of freedom. Establishing a microscopic connection between this universal conformal structure and the momentum-space topology of the underlying quasiparticle spectrum remains challenging. Here, we uncover a direct correspondence between Fermi-point topology, conformal criticality, and quantum entanglement in an extended quantum spin chain with competing cluster interactions, exchange anisotropy, and a transverse magnetic field. We show that interaction- and field-driven Lifshitz transitions generate conformal critical phases with effective central charges $c_{\rm eff}=1/2$, $1$, $3/2$, $2$, and $3$, including a multicritical point where Ising and Luttinger-liquid sectors coexist. Importantly, the central charge is not determined simply by the number of lattice gap closings or Fermi points, but by the number and conformal content of independent low-energy continuum sectors after accounting for lattice symmetries, reciprocal-lattice identifications, and mode equivalences. Thus, Lifshitz transitions may leave the conformal anomaly unchanged or modify the central charge depending on whether spectral reconstruction generates new independent continuum sectors. Real- and momentum-space entanglement spectra provide complementary microscopic signatures, revealing both the conformal content and momentum-space organization of critical modes. Our results establish a microscopic framework linking Fermi-point topology to emergent CFTs and show how interaction-driven spectral reconstruction can generate higher-central-charge criticality and unconventional multicritical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一维量子自旋链中费米点拓扑与共形临界性及量子纠缠之间的直接对应关系。通过扩展量子自旋链中的Lifshitz相变，作者发现了有效中心荷为1/2、1、3/2、2和3的共形临界相，以及伊辛和Luttinger液体扇区共存的量子多临界点。关键发现是中心荷并非简单地由晶格能隙闭合点或费米点的数量决定，而取决于计及晶格对称性、倒格矢等同和模式等价后的独立低能连续统扇区数目。
AI.motivation: 一维量子系统中的量子临界性由涌现的共形场论表征，其中心荷计数独立的无间隙自由度。然而，建立这种普适共形结构与底层准粒子谱的动量空间拓扑之间的微观联系仍然具有挑战性，这正是本文试图填补的空白。
AI.method: 作者研究了一个包含竞争团簇相互作用、交换各向异性和横向磁场的扩展量子自旋链，通过相互作用和场驱动的Lifshitz跃迁来考察费米点拓扑与共形临界性的关系。利用实空间和动量空间的纠缠谱作为互补的微观探针，表征共形内容与临界模式的动量空间组织。
AI.result: 研究发现Lifshitz跃迁可产生有效中心荷c_eff=1/2、1、3/2、2和3的共形临界相，以及一个伊辛与Luttinger液体扇区共存的量子多临界点。中心荷由独立低能连续统扇区的数目和共形内容决定，而非简单由费米点或能隙闭合点数目决定。谱重构是否生成新的独立连续统扇区决定了Lifshitz跃迁对中心荷的影响（不变或修改）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个将费米点拓扑与涌现共形场论相联系的微观框架，展示了相互作用驱动的谱重构如何产生更高中心荷的临界性和非常规的多临界行为，为理解一维量子临界性提供了新的视角。

title: SALTED: a symmetry-adapted machine-learning program for predicting electron-densities in molecules and materials
summary: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, $n(\mathbf{r})$, in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structure programs based on atomic orbitals, namely CP2K, FHI-aims, and PySCF, from which reference electron-density data can be generated and used to train a model. The learning algorithm is based on a symmetry-adapted extension of Gaussian process regression, making SALTED especially efficient in small-data regimes. Thanks to the implementation of vector-field kernel functions, SALTED can also learn the first-order response of the electron density to applied electric fields, $\partial n(\mathbf{r})/\partial \mathbf{E}$. The application of SALTED within computational workflows has already shown its utility in a wide variety of contexts, including the calculation of polarization vectors and polarizability tensors, the accurate evaluation of Coulomb forces in QM/MM molecular-dynamics simulations, and electronic-structure studies of large-scale 2D materials.

AI.tldr: SALTED是一个开源Python包，用于基于原子坐标和种类机器学习量子力学电子密度。它采用线性原子中心分解表示，与CP2K、FHI-aims和PySCF等基于原子轨道的电子结构程序天然兼容，并基于对称自适应扩展的高斯过程回归算法，在小数据场景下尤为高效。该软件还能学习电子密度对电场的响应，已应用于极化矢量、极化率张量计算、QM/MM分子动力学库仑力评估及大尺度二维材料电子结构研究。
AI.motivation: 传统电子密度计算成本高昂，尤其是对大规模分子和凝聚态体系。机器学习电子密度可以显著加速量子力学计算，但需要一个高效、可迁移且能与主流电子结构程序兼容的开源工具来实现这一目标。
AI.method: SALTED采用线性原子中心分解的电子密度表征，确保在不同原子构型间的高迁移性；学习算法基于对称自适应扩展的高斯过程回归，擅长小数据场景；通过实现矢量场核函数，还能学习电子密度对电场的线性响应；同时原生接口支持CP2K、FHI-aims和PySCF等基于原子轨道基组的电子结构程序。
AI.result: SALTED已在多种计算工作流中展现实用性，包括计算极化矢量和极化率张量、在QM/MM分子动力学模拟中精确评估库仑力、以及大规模二维材料的电子结构研究。
AI.conclusion: SALTED作为一个开源且接口友好的电子密度机器学习工具，在多种化学体系和应用场景中证明了其价值和通用性，为加速量子力学计算提供了有效方案。

title: Equivalence classes of finite-time transitions in optimal control and non-equilibrium relaxation
summary: We present a theory for the optimal control of stochastic systems in structured environments, represented by penalty terms in the cost functional. We show that such control problems generically feature sharp finite-time transitions associated with a qualitative change in the control strategy at a critical time. Starting from an overdamped Langevin equation and a quadratic cost functional, we show that all resulting problems fall into three canonical equivalence classes (parabolic, hyperbolic, and elliptic), distinguished by the sign of the determinant of the control Hamiltonian. For each class, we obtain the optimal protocol, the cost function, and the critical time in closed form, and show that the transition exhibits features of a continuous phase transition at mean-field level. We then establish a mapping between the optimal control cost and the large-deviation rate function governing non-equilibrium relaxation after a potential quench. The mapping covers the parabolic and hyperbolic classes, while the elliptic class has no simple relaxation counterpart. This correspondence implies that recently discovered finite-time dynamical phase transitions, which are exponentially costly to sample directly, are accessible through ordinary averages over optimally controlled trajectories. To validate our theoretical findings, we report three experiments with optically trapped colloidal particles: a control transition for the mean stochastic work, and the finite-time dynamical phase transitions in free diffusion and in harmonic relaxation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机系统在结构化环境（由代价函数中的惩罚项表示）中最优控制的理论。研究表明这类控制问题通常在临界时间处出现尖锐的有限时间转变，导致控制策略发生定性变化。所有问题可分为抛物型、双曲型和椭圆型三个规范等价类。作者为每类给出了最优协议、代价函数和临界时间的闭式解，并建立了最优控制代价与非平衡弛豫的大偏差速率函数之间的映射关系。最后通过三个胶体粒子光镊实验验证了理论发现。
AI.motivation: 随机系统的最优控制在物理、生物和工程等领域具有广泛应用，但此前对结构化环境中有限时间动力学相变的理解有限。作者希望揭示此类控制问题中普遍存在的有限时间转变现象，并建立控制问题与非平衡统计物理中弛豫过程之间的联系，从而为难以直接采样的动力学相变提供新的可观测途径。
AI.method: 作者从过阻尼Langevin方程和二次代价函数出发，利用控制哈密顿量行列式的符号将所有最优控制问题分类为抛物型、双曲型和椭圆型三个规范等价类。对每个类别推导闭式的最优协议、代价函数和临界时间，并建立最优控制代价与势垒淬灭后非平衡弛豫的大偏差速率函数之间的映射关系。
AI.result: 所有控制问题可归入三个规范等价类；每类均获得闭式解，转变表现出平均场层面连续相变的特征。抛物型和双曲型类可映射到大偏差速率函数，而椭圆型类无简单弛豫对应。通过三个光镊胶体粒子实验（平均随机功的控制转变、自由扩散和谐波弛豫中的有限时间动力学相变）验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 最优控制代价与大偏差速率函数之间的映射意味着，原本指数级难以直接采样的有限时间动力学相变，可以通过对最优控制轨迹的普通平均来观测。这为实验上探测此类相变提供了可行且高效的新方法，并用光镊实验成功验证。

title: Coherent interaction of WS$_2$ and quasi-2D perovskite excitons over micrometer distances via a cavity field
summary: The coherent coupling of cavity-confined photons and excitonic matter resonances leads to the formation of cavity polaritons, hybrid light-matter quasi-particles. If multiple exciton resonances couple to the same photonic mode, the resulting polariton constitutes a coherent interaction between matter resonances that can be spatially separated without any direct electronic coupling. In this work, we demonstrate the formation of such a coherent coupling at room temperature using an open optical cavity containing two distinct van der Waals materials - monolayer WS2 and layered quasi-2D halide perovskites (HaPs) - separated by $1.5 μ\rm m$. The system forms three polariton branches, with the middle branch possessing nearly equal fractions of both excitons and the photonic mode. White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements are in good agreement with simulations using a coupled harmonic oscillator and a microscopic Wannier-Hopfield framework. Our results lay the foundation to combine highly complementary degrees of freedom in 2D materials in an in-situ tunable fashion to enable new polaritonic functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温下利用含两个不同范德华材料（单层WS2和准二维卤化物钙钛矿）的开放光学腔，展示了空间分离的激子共振之间的相干耦合，形成三个极化激元分支，中间分支同时具有两种激子和光子的主要成分。
AI.motivation: 腔光子与多个激子共振耦合可形成极化激元，实现空间分离物质共振之间的相干相互作用，无需直接电子耦合。作者希望展示这种相干耦合可在室温下实现，并拓展二维材料极化激元的功能性。
AI.method: 使用包含单层WS2和准二维卤化物钙钛矿（HaPs）两种不同材料的开放光学腔，两材料间距1.5微米，研究腔-激子耦合形成的极化激元；采用白光反射和发光光谱测量，并与耦合谐波振荡器模型和微观Wannier-Hopfield框架模拟对比。
AI.result: 系统形成三个极化激元分支，中间分支同时包含几乎等比例的两种激子成分和光子成分；白光反射和发光测量与耦合谐波振荡器及微观Wannier-Hopfield模型模拟结果高度一致，证实了室温下相干耦合的形成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在二维材料中以原位可调方式组合高度互补的自由度奠定基础，为开发新型极化激元功能开辟了新途径。

title: Ground-State Phase Diagram, Higher-Winding Topology, and Lifshitz Criticality in an Anisotropic Four-Spin XX Chain
summary: We investigate the quantum critical and topological properties of a spin-$1/2$ XX chain with anisotropic four-spin cluster interactions in a transverse magnetic field. The interplay of exchange anisotropy, cluster interactions, and the external field produces a rich phase diagram with multiple gapped topological phases and distinct quantum critical boundaries. We identify several Lifshitz-type transitions arising from reconstructions of the low-energy Fermi-point structure, including an unconventional multicritical point where distinct critical branches intersect and the momentum-space topology undergoes a singular reorganization. In the isotropic limit, a conventional Lifshitz transition emerges through the merging and annihilation of Fermi points, revealing distinct mechanisms of Fermi-point reconstruction within the same model. The gapped phases are characterized by quantized winding numbers $ν=0,\pm1,-2,$ and $\pm3$, with the higher-winding phases induced by the extended cluster interactions. The $ν=\pm3$ phases exhibit a richer topological structure than conventional short-range Kitaev-type chains and are separated from other sectors by field- and interaction-driven gap closings. These topological distinctions are further reflected in characteristic degeneracy patterns of the lowest levels of the bulk entanglement spectrum. Our results demonstrate that anisotropic multispin interactions provide a versatile route to realizing higher-winding topological phases and unconventional multicriticality in one-dimensional quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了横向磁场中具有各向异性四自旋团簇相互作用的自旋-1/2 XX链的量子临界与拓扑性质，发现丰富的相图包含多种有能隙拓扑相和独特的量子临界边界。识别了多种由低能费米点结构重构引起的Lifshitz型相变，包括一个非常规多临界点。能隙相由量子化绕数ν=0,±1,-2,±3表征，其中更高绕数相由扩展团簇相互作用诱导。ν=±3相比传统短程Kitaev型链具有更丰富的拓扑结构。
AI.motivation: 探索各向异性多自旋相互作用能否在低维量子系统中实现更高绕数的拓扑相和非常规多临界性，为操控一维量子系统中的拓扑物态提供新的调控途径。
AI.method: 对自旋-1/2 XX链引入各向异性四自旋团簇相互作用并置于横向磁场中，通过分析费米点结构的重构来识别Lifshitz型转变，利用动量空间拓扑（绕数）来表征不同能隙相，并通过体纠缠谱的简并模式区分拓扑性质。
AI.result: 发现了包括ν=0,±1,-2,±3在内的多个拓扑相，识别了常规Lifshitz转变和非常规多临界点，ν=±3相展现比短程Kitaev链更丰富的拓扑结构，且这些拓扑区别反映在体纠缠谱最低能级的特征简并模式中。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性多自旋相互作用为实现更高绕数拓扑相和非常规多临界性提供了一条通用途径，拓展了一维量子系统拓扑物态的研究框架。

title: High-Throughput Computational Discovery of Inverted Resistive Switching in Two-Dimensional Materials
summary: Atomristors, non-volatile resistive switching devices based on two-dimensional (2D) monolayers, are promising building blocks for energy-efficient memory and neuromorphic computing. However, their design remains restricted to a few materials such as MoS2 and h-BN, limiting functional diversity and design flexibility. Here, a high-throughput computational framework combining density functional theory, machine-learning molecular dynamics, and quantum transport simulations screens about 2,900 exfoliable monolayers for vacancy-mediated resistive switching, identifying 17 thermally stable candidates in two mechanistically distinct classes. In Class 1 monolayers, such as GaS, Au adsorption at the native vacancy introduces conducting states, switching the insulating monolayer from a high- to a low-resistance state (HRS-to-LRS). Class 2 monolayers, comprising ionically bonded metal oxyhalides and nitrohalides such as BiOCl, exhibit previously unreported inverted switching. Vacancy-released electrons delocalize and push the Fermi level into the conduction band, placing the device natively in the LRS; Au adsorption re-localizes these carriers and returns the Fermi level to the gap, driving LRS-to-HRS switching. Quantum transport simulations confirm both mechanisms, while migration-barrier calculations identify the electrode-2D separation as a key parameter governing Au migration and the resistance window. These findings expand the atomristor landscape and establish complementary switching as a design paradigm for multifunctional memory and neuromorphic hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高通量计算框架（DFT + 机器学习分子动力学 + 量子输运模拟），从约2900种可剥离单层材料中筛选出17种热稳定性良好的原子忆阻器候选材料，并发现了两种机理截然不同的电阻开关类型，包括一种前所未见的新型倒置开关机制。
AI.motivation: 原子忆阻器（基于二维单层材料的非易失性阻变器件）是节能存储和神经形态计算的有前景构件，但目前设计仅限于MoS2和h-BN等少数材料，限制了功能多样性和设计灵活性，亟需拓宽材料选择范围并理解其潜在机理。
AI.method: 采用结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、机器学习分子动力学和量子输运模拟的高通量计算框架，系统筛选约2,900种可剥离单层材料中的空位介导阻变行为，并通过迁移势垒计算分析电极-二维材料间距对Au迁移和电阻窗口的影响。
AI.result: 鉴定出17种热稳定候选材料，分为两类：Class 1（如GaS）中Au在固有空位上的吸附引入导电态，实现高阻态到低阻态（HRS-to-LRS）转换；Class 2（如BiOCl等金属氧卤化物和硝基卤化物）表现出此前未见报道的倒置开关，空位释放的电子使费米能级推入导带（本征处于LRS），Au吸附重新局域化载流子并将其拉回带隙，实现LRS-to-HRS转换。量子输运模拟证实了两种机制。电极-2D间距被认为是控制Au迁移和电阻窗口的关键参数。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现极大地扩展了原子忆阻器的材料版图，并确立了互补开关作为多功能存储和神经形态硬件设计的全新范式。

title: Effective Hamiltonian description on monitored Majorana chains: correlated power-law hoppings and unconventional entanglement scaling
summary: We investigate the structures of effective Hamiltonians governing monitored dynamics of a one-dimensional Majorana chain through the Lyapunov spectral analysis. We focus on a gapless phase characterized by finite-size scalings different from those in conventional critical and/or frustration-free systems; the spectral gap closing faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$ and the entanglement entropy growing as $[\ln(L)]^2$ with $L$ being the system size. We find that the corresponding effective Hamiltonians have random long-range power-law hoppings with nontrivial magnitude correlations, rather than being independently and identically distributed. To elucidate the role of these non-Gaussian correlations, we construct random power-law hopping models that capture the essential features of the effective Hamiltonians. The spectral gaps of the constructed models decay faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$. We find that, in the absence of hopping correlations, the ground-state entanglement exhibits $\ln(L)$ scaling. In the presence of correlations, by contrast, the entanglement entropy is enhanced and its system-size dependence is consistent with $[\ln(L)]^2$ scaling over the system sizes studied. These results suggest that correlations among long-range hopping magnitudes are responsible for the entanglement scaling that seldom appears in ground states of conventional isolated quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Lyapunov谱分析研究一维Majorana链受监视动力学的有效哈密顿量结构，聚焦于具有非传统有限尺寸标度的无间隙相。发现有效哈密顿量具有带非平凡幅度相关的随机长程幂律跳跃（而非独立同分布），并通过构造随机幂律跳跃模型证明：缺乏跳跃相关时纠缠呈ln(L)标度，而存在相关时纠缠增强为[ln(L)]²标度，表明长程跳跃幅度间的相关性是这种罕见纠缠标度的根源。
AI.motivation: 理解一维Majorana链受监视动力学中的无间隙相，该相具有不同于传统临界系统或免挫系统的有限尺寸标度（能隙闭合快于1/L但慢于1/L²，纠缠熵按[ln(L)]²增长）。作者希望揭示控制该相的有效哈密顿量的具体结构，特别是解释非常规纠缠标度的物理起源。
AI.method: 1) 对监视动力学下的Majorana链进行Lyapunov谱分析，提取有效哈密顿量；2) 分析有效哈密顿量中跳跃项的结构，发现其为随机长程幂律跳跃且幅度间存在非高斯相关；3) 构造随机幂律跳跃模型，分别探究有无跳跃相关两种情况，对比其谱隙和基态纠缠熵的系统尺寸标度。
AI.result: 有效哈密顿量具有带相关性的随机长程幂律跳跃。构造模型中，当无跳跃相关时基态纠缠为ln(L)标度；当存在相关时，纠缠熵增强且系统尺寸依赖性符合[ln(L)]²标度。构造模型的谱隙衰减也复现了介于1/L与1/L²之间的行为。
AI.conclusion: 长程跳跃幅度间的关联性是该受监视无间隙相中[ln(L)]²纠缠标度的关键原因，这种标度在常规孤立量子系统的基态中极为罕见。研究揭示了一类由跳跃相关性驱动的新型纠缠行为，深化了对受监视量子动力学及非厄米/有效哈密顿量结构的理解。

title: Unravelling the Li-Haldane Conjecture with the Projected Ensemble
summary: The entanglement spectra of fractional quantum Hall states contain universal fingerprints of their underlying topological order, as posited by the Li-Haldane conjecture. In this work, we uncover a finer universal structure within the entanglement spectra unravelled by projective measurements. Concretely, we study the projected ensemble of fractional quantum Hall states, defined as the collection of quantum states on a subsystem conditioned on measurement outcomes of its complement. We find that this ensemble exhibits a hidden hierarchy inside the Li-Haldane edge manifold: by conditioning on measurement outcomes, the entanglement spectrum's support is split into measurement-dependent sectors whose ranks we demonstrate are fixed by conformal field theory counting, an observation we dub the measurement-resolved Li-Haldane conjecture. For the non-Abelian Moore-Read state, this hierarchy is particularly rich: each parity-resolved edge manifold contains internal subspaces whose dimensions reproduce the conformal field theory counting of the opposite-parity sector. This structure persists even in realistic Coulomb-interacting ground states, establishing the projected ensemble as a sharp new probe of topological order beyond what the entanglement spectrum alone can detect.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分数量子霍尔态在投影测量下，其纠缠谱存在一种比Li-Haldane猜想更精细的普适结构：纠缠谱的支撑被划分为依赖于测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数决定，作者称之为"测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想"。对于非阿贝尔Moore-Read态，这种层级结构尤其丰富，且在实际库仑相互作用基态中依然保持。
AI.motivation: Li-Haldane猜想指出分数量子霍尔态的纠缠谱包含其拓扑序的普适指纹，但纠缠谱本身只能反映整体信息。作者希望通过投影测量的方式，揭示纠缠谱内部更精细的普适结构，从而提供超越传统纠缠谱分析的拓扑序探测新工具。
AI.method: 研究分数量子霍尔态的投影系综（projected ensemble），即对某子系统的补空间进行投影测量后，收集子系统的条件量子态集合。通过分析不同测量结果下的纠缠谱支撑结构，将其划分为测量依赖的扇区，并与共形场论计数进行对比验证。对Moore-Read态特别分析奇偶分辨的边缘流形内部结构。
AI.result: 发现投影系综中纠缠谱的支撑被划分为测量依赖的扇区，其秩可由共形场论计数精确确定，证实了"测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想"。对于非阿贝尔Moore-Read态，每个奇偶分辨的边缘流形内部存在子空间，其维度重现了相反奇偶扇区的共形场论计数。该结构在库仑相互作用的实际基态中依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 投影系综是探测拓扑序的崭新的灵敏工具，能够揭示传统纠缠谱无法探测到的更精细的普适拓扑结构，深化了对Li-Haldane边缘流形内部层次结构的理解。

title: Universal Driven Critical Dynamics of Entanglement Entropy
summary: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) and finite-time scaling (FTS) provide a foundational framework for driven critical dynamics, yet their predictive power has been largely confined to local observables. Here, we establish a universal finite-time scaling theory for the nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum entanglement. Using unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the corner entanglement entropy of (2+1)-dimensional interacting Dirac fermions driven from ordered phases toward a quantum critical point. We find that the corner entanglement accurately obeys a universal driven scaling governed by the driving rate and system size, persisting whether the initial ordered state is fully gapped or hosts gapless Goldstone modes. Crucially, this dynamical entanglement exhibits a logarithmic dependence on the driving rate, from which the universal corner coefficient of the underlying conformal field theory can be robustly extracted far from equilibrium. These results generalize the KZM from local observables to the intrinsic nonlocal quantum information measures, offering a practical blueprint for characterizing quantum criticality and entanglement on programmable quantum simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了量子纠缠非平衡动力学的普适有限时间标度理论，通过 unbiased 量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究 (2+1) 维相互作用 Dirac 费米子从有序相驱动至量子临界点过程中的角纠缠熵，发现其遵循由驱动速率和系统尺寸支配的普适驱动标度，且动力学纠缠对驱动速率呈对数依赖，可由此在远离平衡态时稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数。该工作将 KZM 从局域可观测量推广至非局域量子信息度量。
AI.motivation: Kibble-Zurek 机制和有限时间标度是驱动临界动力学的理论基础，但其预测能力此前局限于局域可观测量。量子纠缠作为表征量子多体系统关键的非局域信息度量，其在驱动临界动力学中的普适标度行为尚未被建立，这构成了本工作的核心动机。
AI.method: 采用 unbiased 量子蒙特卡洛模拟方法，研究 (2+1) 维相互作用 Dirac 费米子系统从有序相（包括完全带隙态和具有无能隙 Goldstone 模的态）驱动至量子临界点过程中的角纠缠熵，并系统分析其对驱动速率和系统尺寸的标度依赖关系。
AI.result: 发现角纠缠熵精确遵循由驱动速率与系统尺寸支配的普适驱动标度，无论初始有序态是完全带隙还是包含无能隙 Goldstone 模均成立。关键发现是动力学纠缠对驱动速率呈对数依赖，由此可在远离平衡条件下稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 KZM 的适用范围从局域观测量推广到内在非局域的量子信息度量，为在可编程量子模拟器上表征量子临界性和纠缠提供了切实可行的蓝图。

title: Gd-4f Exchange Splitting and Mo-4d Crystal-Field Redistribution in Gd/W Co-doped La2Mo2O9: A DFT+U Study
comment: Conference: International Conference on Advanced Functional Materials and Devices (AFMD-2026)
summary: La2Mo2O9 (LAMOX) is a promising oxide-ion conductor for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cells, but its practical application is limited by a first-order monoclinic-to-cubic (alpha to beta) phase transition. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of pristine La2Mo2O9 and the Gd/W co-doped composition La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9 using spin-polarized density functional theory with an on-site Hubbard correction for the localized Gd-4f states. The projected density of states reveals that pristine La2Mo2O9 is an O-2p/Mo-4d charge-transfer oxide in which La contributes negligibly near the band edges. Gd/W co-doping introduces a strongly exchange-split Gd-4f manifold with a majority-minority separation of approximately 1011 eV, substantially redistributes the Mo-4d electronic states through a threefold increase in crystal-field splitting, and reduces the O-2p contribution near the valence-band maximum from 78% to 66%. These electronic signatures are consistent with the experimentally observed lattice contraction, MoO Raman-mode softening, and the non-monotonic evolution of oxide-ion conductivity across the co-doped series. In particular, the pronounced crystal-field splitting and localized Gd magnetism at the highest doping level provide a microscopic electronic explanation for the observed suppression of ionic conductivity. The present results establish an atomistic electronic-structure framework for understanding dopant-induced phase stabilization and oxide- ion transport in Gd/W co-doped LAMOX electrolytes, providing design principles for improved solid oxide fuel cell materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用自旋极化DFT+U方法研究了纯La2Mo2O9与Gd/W共掺杂LAMOX材料的电子结构，揭示了掺杂如何通过改变Mo-4d晶体场劈裂、Gd-4f局域磁性与O-2p态分布来影响相稳定性和氧离子传导，为SOFC电解质材料设计提供了原子层面的电子结构机理。
AI.motivation: LAMOX材料是很有前景的中温固体氧化物燃料电池氧离子导体，但其一阶单斜到立方相变限制了实际应用。需要从电子结构层面理解掺杂（如Gd/W共掺杂）如何稳定立方相并影响离子输运，从而指导更好的电解质材料设计。
AI.method: 采用自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）并加入Hubbard U修正来处理局域Gd-4f态，对纯La2Mo2O9和Gd/W共掺杂体系La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9进行电子结构计算，包括投影态密度（PDOS）分析。
AI.result: 纯相为O-2p/Mo-4d电荷转移型氧化物，La对带边贡献可忽略；Gd/W共掺杂引入强交换劈裂的Gd-4f能带（自旋多数/少数分离约10-11 eV），使Mo-4d晶体场劈裂增大三倍，并将价带顶O-2p贡献从78%降至66%。这些电子结构特征可解释实验观察到的晶格收缩、MoO拉曼模式软化以及共掺杂系列中离子电导率的非单调变化，特别是高掺杂水平下显著的晶体场劈裂和Gd局域磁性从微观电子层面解释了离子电导率被抑制的原因。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了Gd/W共掺杂LAMOX电解质的原子级电子结构框架，阐明了掺杂诱导相稳定化与氧离子输运的微观机制，为改进固体氧化物燃料电池材料提供了设计原则。

title: Thermodynamic Concentration Inequalities: Controlling Uncertainty in Finite-Time and Small-Sample Thermodynamic Inference
summary: We derive nonasymptotic upper bounds on the probability that a generalized current of a geometrically ergodic diffusion observed for any amount of time, or its sample mean over any arbitrary sample size, deviates from the stationary mean by more than any given amount. The concentration-of-measure behavior of generalized currents is universally governed by the relaxation time of the underlying dynamics, the locally observed dissipation rate, and the intrinsic local fluctuations of the observable. We uncover stark qualitative and quantitative differences in fluctuations in and out of thermodynamic equilibrium. We further obtain refined inverse thermodynamic uncertainty relations, bounding the variance of generalized currents from above. We construct nonasymptotic confidence intervals for controlling uncertainty in thermodynamic inference from small data, i.e., from short trajectories and small samples, and provide the first quantitative answer to when a trajectory is sufficiently long and a sample is sufficiently large. As an illustration, we apply our results to currents observed on a two-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process in and out of equilibrium and show how they can be used to rigorously detect broken detailed balance.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了几何遍历扩散过程广义电流偏离稳态均值的非渐近上界浓度不等式，揭示其由弛豫时间、耗散率和局部波动共同控制，并给出热力学平衡内外波动的显著差异，建立了逆热力学不确定性关系及小数据下的非渐近置信区间，首次定量回答了轨迹和样本需多长才算"足够"的问题。
AI.motivation: 热力学推断（如熵产生估计、细致平衡破缺检测）通常依赖于长时间轨迹或大样本渐近结果，但实际中数据往往有限（短轨迹、小样本），缺乏对有限时间/有限样本下涨落行为的定量刻画，也无法回答"数据需要多长才足够"这一问题。
AI.method: 基于几何遍历扩散的谱理论与浓度不等式方法，推导广义电流的指数型(Prob)非渐近上界，将偏差概率分解为弛豫时间（动力学时间尺度）、局部耗散率（偏离平衡的程度）与可观测量内在局部波动三个因素的耦合；在此基础上进一步推导方差上界的逆热力学不确定性关系，并构建非渐近置信区间。以二维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的平衡/非平衡电流为例进行验证。
AI.result: 获得广义电流任意观测时长与任意样本量下的非渐近浓度上界；揭示平衡态与非平衡态在涨落行为上存在显著的定性与定量差异；获得改进的逆热力学不确定性关系（方差上界）；构建适用于小数据的非渐近置信区间，并在二维OU过程上展示如何基于这些结论严格检测细致平衡破缺。
AI.conclusion: 广义电流的浓度行为具有普适的解析刻画，其控制因素可明确分解；该理论为小数据热力学推断提供了严格保证，并首次给出轨迹长度与样本量充分性的定量判据，为检测非平衡性与细致平衡破缺提供了严格的统计工具。

title: The Casimir free energy of peptide films on a silicon substrate: Impact of dielectric-to-metal transition in silicon and nanoparticles in peptide
summary: Using the Lifshitz theory of the van der Waals and Casimir forces, we calculate the Casimir free energy of thin peptide films deposited on silicon substrates. The Casimir free energy is found as a function of film thickness for different fractions of water in the film, in the presence of either nonmagnetic or magnetic nanoparticles, and under the impact of irradiation of a silicon substrate with laser pulses or dopants resulting in the dielectric-to-metal phase transition. It is shown that for a dielectric silicon there is the borderline value of the film thickness, such that the Casimir free energy is negative and contributes to the film stability for thicker films, but is positive and makes the film less stable for thinner ones. According to our results, the borderline value of peptide film thickness decreases with increasing volume fractions of water and in the film. This decrease is more pronounced for the magnetic nanoparticles and becomes stronger with increasing their radius. The borderline value of peptide film thickness is found as a function of the fraction of water in the film. If the silicon substrate is in metallic state, the Casimir free energy of peptide coating is always positive, which makes it less stable. Possible applications of the obtained results in organic electronics and biomedicine are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Lifshitz理论计算了沉积在硅基底上的薄肽膜Casimir自由能，研究了膜厚、含水量、纳米颗粒、激光照射和掺杂等因素的影响，发现介电硅上存在临界膜厚决定膜的稳定性，而金属态硅使膜始终不稳定。
AI.motivation: 肽膜在有机电子和生物医学应用中扮演重要角色，其稳定性受范德华力和Casimir力等纳米尺度相互作用影响。理解这些色散力对薄膜稳定性的影响，对于优化肽涂层器件设计具有重要意义。
AI.method: 基于Lifshitz理论计算van der Waals和Casimir力，将Casimir自由能表示为膜厚、水含量分数、纳米颗粒（非磁性/磁性）等因素的函数，并考虑硅基底从介电态到金属态的相变（通过激光脉冲或掺杂实现）。
