AI.result: (1) 对介电硅基底，存在临界膜厚：较厚膜Casimir自由能为负（利于稳定），较薄膜为正（不利稳定）；(2) 临界膜厚随水体积分数增加而减小，此效应在磁性纳米颗粒和较大颗粒半径时更显著；(3) 硅基底处于金属态时，肽膜Casimir自由能始终为正，使其稳定性降低。
AI.conclusion: Casimir自由能对肽膜稳定性有显著的厚度依赖和材料依赖效应，其结果对有机电子学和生物医学中的肽涂层应用具有指导价值，特别是可通过调控含水量、纳米颗粒性质及基底导电状态来主动控制膜的稳定性。

title: Evolution of electron spin resonance through a metallic quantum critical phase diagram
comment: accepted for Physical Review Letters, Editors Suggestion, 7 pages, 9 pages Supplementary Material, 4+7 figures
summary: In the heavy-fermion metal YbRh2Si2, quantum criticality at a suppressed antiferromagnetic order is governed by the interplay of local magnetic moments and itinerant conduction electrons. We demonstrate how this can be investigated by a new experimental approach that enables the observation of electron spin resonance (ESR) across a broad range of frequencies and fields at very low temperatures. This allowed us to cover a large part of the phase diagram from the paramagnetic Fermi-liquid phase to the phase with antiferromagnetic order and including the quantum-critical regime. Both the ESR g-factor and the linewidth present distinct behaviors in these three regimes, providing further insight into the physics across a quantum critical point. Notably, when cooling down at a field directly towards the quantum critical point, both g-factor and linewidth continuously decrease. Furthermore, we observe a very good matching of the g-factor behavior upon field-tuning and temperature-tuning towards the quantum-critical point. We analyze and discuss the results in the context of present theories on ESR in strongly correlated electron systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一种新的实验方法（在极低温度、宽频段和宽磁场范围内进行电子自旋共振ESR测量），研究了重费米子金属YbRh2Si2中的量子临界性。研究覆盖了从顺磁费米液体相到反铁磁有序相以及量子临界区的广泛相图区域，发现ESR的g因子和线宽在这三个区域呈现不同行为，并在趋向量子临界点时连续减小。g因子在磁场调谐和温度调谐两种趋近路径下表现出良好的一致性。
AI.motivation: 理解重费米子金属中量子临界性背后的物理机制，特别是局域磁矩与巡游传导电子之间的相互作用如何主导被抑制的反铁磁有序系统的量子临界行为。
AI.method: 开发了一种新的实验方法，使得在极低温度下、跨越宽频率和宽磁场范围内能够观测电子自旋共振（ESR），从而覆盖YbRh2Si2相图的广泛区域（顺磁费米液体相、反铁磁有序相及量子临界区），系统测量并分析ESR的g因子和线宽行为。
AI.result: 发现ESR的g因子和线宽在顺磁费米液体相、反铁磁有序相和量子临界区三个区域内呈现截然不同的行为。当冷却过程中磁场直接指向量子临界点时，g因子和线宽均连续减小。g因子在磁场调谐和温度调谐两条趋近量子临界点的路径上表现出一致行为。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为量子临界点附近的物理提供了新的实验见解，观测结果需在强关联电子系统ESR理论框架内进一步分析与讨论，以深化对重费米子体系量子临界性的理解。

title: Multimodal and Multiscale Interrogation of a Mechanically Tough Glass Forming Copper-Based Metal-Organic Framework
summary: A copper-based metal-organic framework, Cu(Im)2, was synthesized using a sol-gel process and subsequently melt-quenched into glass upon heating above 240 °C. In this paper, we present a multimodal, multiscale interrogation of the MOF nanocrystals and the resulting glasses. Structural characterization using X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and electron microscopy was performed to understand the morphology and size of the synthesized nanocrystals and glasses. Thermogravimetric analysis and differential scanning calorimetry were employed to understand the melting process of the crystals to form the glass. Synchrotron pair distribution function analysis was performed to verify that the framework structure is maintained upon melting, and nearfield infrared nanospectroscopy provided insight into the local chemical structure of the materials. The mechanical characterization via nanoindentation revealed that the resulting glasses exhibit an appreciably high elastic modulus (~10 GPa) and the highest fracture toughness (K_1c ~ 0.5 MPa m^1/2) yet reported for MOF glasses. This development is central to the emerging field of MOF-based materials processing and shaping, while upholding mechanical robustness and resistance to cracking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过溶胶-凝胶法合成了铜基金属有机框架Cu(Im)2，并加热至240°C以上熔融淬火成玻璃。通过多模态、多尺度的表征手段（X射线衍射、原子力显微镜、电子显微镜、热分析、同步辐射对分布函数分析、近场红外纳米光谱及纳米压痕力学测试）系统研究了MOF纳米晶体及其玻璃化产物的结构、形貌、热学与力学性能。结果显示所得MOF玻璃表现出约10 GPa的弹性模量和迄今报道最高的断裂韧性（K_1c约0.5 MPa·m^1/2），为MOF基材料加工成型领域提供了重要进展。
AI.motivation: MOF玻璃作为一种新兴的无定形多孔材料，兼具MOF的可设计性和玻璃的可加工性，但此前报道的MOF玻璃普遍存在力学性能（特别是断裂韧性）不足的问题，限制了其在实际应用中的可靠性。因此，开发具有优越机械性能和抗开裂能力的MOF玻璃材料是该领域的关键挑战。
AI.method: 采用溶胶-凝胶法合成Cu(Im)2 MOF纳米晶体，并在240°C以上通过熔融淬火制备MOF玻璃。综合运用X射线衍射、原子力显微镜和电子显微镜表征形貌与尺寸；热重分析和差示扫描量热法研究熔融过程；同步辐射对分布函数分析验证熔融后框架结构的保持；近场红外纳米光谱研究局部化学结构；纳米压痕测试评估弹性模量和断裂韧性。
AI.result: 成功合成了Cu(Im)2 MOF纳米晶体并将其转化为MOF玻璃。结构表征确认了框架结构在熔融过程中得以保持。力学测试表明所得MOF玻璃具有约10 GPa的高弹性模量，断裂韧性K_1c约0.5 MPa·m^1/2，为迄今MOF玻璃中报道的最高值，展现出优异的抗裂纹扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究开发出一种兼具高弹性模量和迄今最高断裂韧性的Cu(Im)2基MOF玻璃，在保持MOF框架结构完整性的同时，解决了MOF玻璃力学性能不足的关键问题，推动了MOF基材料在加工成型及实际应用中的发展前景。

title: Hierarchy of topological superconductivity generated via heterostructures of unconventional $p$-wave magnets
comment: 6 Pages + 5 PDF Figures (Main Text) and 6 Pages (Supplementary Material); Comments are welcome
summary: A theoretical framework is proposed to engineer both first and second-order topological superconducting phases in a two-dimensional (2D) heterostructure, consisting of a quantum spin Hall insulator (QSHI) and an unconventional $p$-wave magnet in presence of proximity-induced $s$-wave superconducting pairing. Our analysis establishes that the transitions between the trivial and topological superconducting (TSC) phases can be regulated though the parameters of $p$-wave magnet. Presence of chiral symmetry leads to the characterization of both types of TSC phases by the respective invariants, one-dimensional winding number and quadrupolar winding number. These results are supplemented by an analytical effective low-energy edge theory that yields a deeper insight into the emergence of the different topological phases of the system. Bulk pairing analysis reveals the competition between the effective $(p_x+p_y)$ and $(p_x+ip_y)$ type pairings that are governed by the intrinsic spin-orbit coupling inherited to the QSHI and spin-split bands of the $p$-wave magnet, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，在由量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（QSHI）与非传统p波磁体构成的二维异质结构中，通过近邻诱导的s波超导配对来工程化一阶和二阶拓扑超导相。
AI.motivation: 探索如何在二维异质结构中实现并调控高阶拓扑超导相（包括一阶和二阶），特别是利用p波磁体的参数来调节拓扑相变，为拓扑超导体的可调控设计提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与解析方法：1) 通过p波磁体参数调控平凡与拓扑超导相之间的转变；2) 利用手征对称性，分别用一维绕数（winding number）和四极绕数来刻画两类拓扑超导相；3) 构建解析的有效低能边缘理论深入理解拓扑相的涌现；4) 进行体态配对分析，揭示(p_x+p_y)与(p_x+ip_y)型配对之间的竞争机制。
AI.result: 建立了QSHI与p波磁体异质结构中一阶和二阶拓扑超导相的理论框架；通过p波磁体参数可有效调控拓扑相变；确立了手征对称性下两类拓扑超导相的拓扑不变量表征；揭示了体态配对中(p_x+p_y)与(p_x+ip_y)型配对的竞争关系，前者源于QSHI固有的自旋轨道耦合，后者源于p波磁体的自旋劈裂能带。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在二维异质结构中可调控地实现高阶拓扑超导相提供了完整的理论方案，并通过边缘理论和体态配对分析深化了对拓扑相涌现机制的理解，为实验上构建拓扑超导器件提供了理论指导。

title: HyperDet Wavefunction: A Phase-Agnostic Ansatz for Strongly Correlated Systems
summary: Describing competing phases of strongly correlated systems often requires trial wave functions built from phase-specific assumptions. We propose the \emph{hyperdeterminant (HyperDet) wavefunction} as a phase-agnostic ansatz for both bosonic and fermionic quantum many-body systems exhibiting spontaneous symmetry-breaking order, fractionalization, and/or topological order with anyonic excitations. The HyperDet structure emerges naturally by fusing auxiliary fermionic parton Slater determinants into physical orbitals through a fully learnable \emph{fusion tensor} $\mathcal F$. Optimized using variational Monte Carlo, a single HyperDet architecture can achieve exceptionally high overlaps $\geq 99.9\%$ with exact-diagonalization ground states throughout the entire fractional Chern insulator phase in both bosonic and fermionic models, and across their nearby competing phases. We introduce the singular-value spectrum of the \emph{bipartite fusion matrix} as a structural diagnostic of fusion tensor, and find that its redistribution tracks many-body phase transitions without computing phase-specific observables. The optimized fusion tensor also encodes the parton-level topological data: it reproduces the parton Chern numbers expected for the bosonic and fermionic FCI states, completing their field-theory descriptions and the resulting topological order. Its intrinsic gauge structure further determines whether physical symmetries admit virtual lifts and, when faithful lifts exist, extracts their projective class; for the bosonic FCI, this recovers the expected parton translation fractionalization. We thus anticipate the HyperDet wavefunction to be a promising variational platform for both accurate ground-state searches and phase-diagram explorations across strongly correlated phases, and for providing interpretable theoretical insights from parton-level microscopics to field-theory descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与相位无关的变分波函数——超行列式（HyperDet）波函数，通过可学习的融合张量将辅助费米子部分子Slater行列式融合到物理轨道中，可用于描述玻色子与费米子强关联系统的自发对称破缺、分数化及拓扑序等多类相位。在分数陈绝缘体相及其邻近竞争相中，单一HyperDet架构与精确对角化基态的重叠度可达≥99.9%，并能通过融合矩阵的奇异值谱诊断多体相变，同时从部分子层面提取拓扑数据与投影表示等理论信息。
AI.motivation: 描述强关联系统的竞争相通常需要依赖特定相位假设的试探波函数，缺乏统一的相位无关框架，难以同时覆盖自发对称破缺、分数化和拓扑序等多种相互竞争的物相。
AI.method: 提出HyperDet波函数：通过完全可学习的融合张量F将辅助费米子部分子Slater行列式融合进物理轨道，形成相位无关的拟设；采用变分蒙特卡洛优化；引入二分融合矩阵的奇异值谱作为结构诊断工具。
AI.result: 单一HyperDet架构在整个分数陈绝缘体相（玻色子与费米子模型）及其邻近竞争相中与精确对角化基态重叠≥99.9%；奇异值谱的再分布可追踪多体相变；优化后的融合张量能重现部分子陈数、恢复玻色子FCI的部分子平移分数化，并判定物理对称性的虚拟提升及其射影类。
AI.conclusion: HyperDet波函数是强关联系统中兼具高精度基态搜索、相图探索和理论可解释性的有前景的变分平台，能从部分子微观层面连接到场论描述。

title: Ion-Engineered Insulator-to-Semiconductor Transition in Natural 2D Biotite
summary: Naturally occurring layered silicates offer an abundant yet unexplored class of 2D materials, but their insulating nature limits their functional utility. Here, we demonstrate a chemical strategy that transforms liquid-phase-exfoliated biotite nanosheets into a tunable 2D semiconductor through controlled NaOH treatment. The resulting insulator-to-semiconductor transition originates from Na incorporation, defect generation, and local structural reconstruction while largely preserving the layered framework. Structural and chemical analyses reveal lattice distortion, interlayer reorganization, hydroxylation, and partial Na+-K+ exchange, establishing the origin of the electronic restructuring. This transformation broadens the optical response, shifting the approximately 221 nm absorption toward approximately 280 and 975 nm, reducing the optical bandgap from approximately 5.2 to 3.2-3.5 eV, and introducing low-energy transitions at approximately 1.12-1.17 eV. Electrical measurements reveal nonlinear transport with currents reaching close to 10 microA, demonstrating activated carrier conduction. Ultrafast transient absorption reveals pronounced excited-state absorption, with carrier cooling (0.16-0.38 ps) followed by fast (35-60 ps) and long-lived (336-491 ps) relaxation associated with trap-mediated recombination. Fluence-dependent dynamics reveal a hot-phonon bottleneck at elevated carrier densities. Together with density functional theory calculations, these results establish chemical defect and ion engineering as a powerful route for converting naturally abundant layered minerals into electronically tunable 2D materials for emerging optoelectronic and ultrafast photonic technologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究展示了通过NaOH处理将液相剥离的黑云母纳米片转化为可调谐的二维半导体，实现绝缘体到半导体的转变，并系统表征了其结构、光学和电学性质的变化。
AI.motivation: 天然层状硅酸盐是一类丰富但未被充分探索的二维材料，但其绝缘特性限制了功能应用。作者希望探索化学手段将这些丰富天然矿物转化为功能性半导体材料。
AI.method: 对液相剥离的黑云母纳米片进行可控NaOH处理，通过Na嵌入、缺陷生成和局部结构重构实现绝缘体到半导体的转变。使用结构化学分析（含DFT计算）表征晶格畸变、层间重组、羟基化和Na+-K+交换，并通过超快瞬态吸收光谱研究载流子动力学。
AI.result: 光学带隙从约5.2 eV降至3.2-3.5 eV，引入约1.12-1.17 eV低能跃迁；电流接近10微安的非线性输运；载流子冷却（0.16-0.38 ps）后伴随快速（35-60 ps）和长寿命（336-491 ps）的弛豫过程；高载流子密度下观察到热声子瓶颈效应。
AI.conclusion: 化学缺陷和离子工程是转化天然层状矿物为电子可调谐二维材料的有效途径，为新兴光电和超快光子技术提供了新思路。

title: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers electron spin as a quantum coherence probe of angular fluctuations
summary: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers rare-earth ions combine giant longitudinal g-factors with a vanishing transverse component imposed by time-reversal symmetry, a combination that makes their spin transitions exquisitely sensitive to the orientation of the applied magnetic field. We show that this sensitivity carries a dual identity: it is simultaneously an overlooked decoherence channel and the basis for a spin-coherence-based angular probe. Using pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance at X-band, we report the first measurements of the quantum coherence of Tb$^{3+}$ in a native-doped CaWO$_4$ crystal (15 ppb) and map the Hahn-echo coherence time $T_2$ as a function of temperature (2 to 10 K) and resonant field ($10^3$ to $10^4$ G). A parameter-free model combining spin-lattice relaxation, instantaneous diffusion and spectral diffusion from all independently quantified impurities overestimates $T_2$ by an order of magnitude at low temperature and wrongly predicts the field dependence of $T_2$, inconsistent with the observed monotonic decrease of $T_2$ with $B_r$. A two-parameter extension, including dynamical angular fluctuations of the crystal axis, reproduces the full dataset across multiple setups and laboratories. Two controlled experiments nominally identical except for different mechanical configuration of the setup establish the mechanical origin of the dominant contribution. The two-parameter extension corresponds to an angular amplitude noise spectral density of overall order 36 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ from global external vibrations (ranging from 10 to 66 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ depending on the exact setup mechanical configuration) estimated at $\sim$ 2.5 kHz plus a temperature-dependent contribution assumed to come from local phonon-driven angular jitter. It identifies and highlights a decoherence pathway of practical relevance to any anisotropic solid-state spin system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了强各向异性非Kramers稀土离子（Tb³⁺）在CaWO₄晶体中的量子相干性。研究发现这种对磁场方向的极端敏感性既是被忽视的退相干通道，也可作为基于自旋相干的角向探针。通过脉冲EPR测量了Tb³⁺的Hahn回波相干时间T₂，发现简单模型低估了退相干，而引入晶体轴力学角度涨落的双参数模型能完美解释所有实验数据，确立机械振动是主要退相干来源。
AI.motivation: 强各向异性非Kramers稀土离子具有巨大的纵向g因子和由时间反演对称性决定的微小横向分量，使其自旋跃迁对磁场方向极为敏感。这种敏感性可能既是重要的退相干通道，又可能作为角度传感的基础，但此前从未被系统研究。
AI.method: 在X波段使用脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR）技术，测量天然掺杂CaWO₄晶体中Tb³⁺（15 ppb）的Hahn回波相干时间T₂，作为温度和共振磁场的函数。构建参数自由模型（包含自旋-晶格弛豫、瞬时扩散和所有杂质的谱扩散），再通过双参数扩展（引入动力学角度涨落）来拟合实验数据。设计两个名义相同但机械配置不同的控制实验验证机械根源。
AI.result: 参数自由模型在低温下高估T₂达一个数量级，且错误预测了T₂与磁场的关系。引入角度涨落噪声的双参数扩展模型能够完美复现跨多个实验设置的全部数据集。角度噪声幅度谱密度约为36 n°/√Hz（10-66 n°/√Hz取决于机械配置），来自约2.5 kHz的全局外部振动，外加温度依赖的局域声子驱动角抖动贡献。
AI.conclusion: 机械振动引起的晶体轴角向波动是各向异性固态自旋体系中一个此前被忽视但具有实际重要性的退相干通道。该发现不仅解释了对各向异性自旋体系的退相干来源于环境机械振动，还为基于自旋相干的角向传感应用（如纳米级角度探测器）提供了原理验证和定量基准。

title: Non-uniform quantum geometry stabilizes generalized Wigner crystals
summary: Moiré materials host fractional Chern insulators and electron crystals in close proximity, but the mechanism selecting between them remains an open question. We address this competition in Chern bands with ideal but momentum-dependent quantum geometry -- Aharonov-Casher bands. We present an ansatz wave function for generalized Wigner crystals and, by comparing its energy to that of the competing Laughlin-like state, map out the phase diagram at filling fraction $ν=1/m$ as a function of the degree of geometric non-uniformity. Our work identifies quantum geometry-controlled zero point fluctuations of the charge density of the generalized Wigner crystal as the mechanism controlling its relative stability, implying a kind of quantum Lindemann criterion for the crystal-liquid phase boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了moire材料中分数量子霍尔态与广义Wigner晶体之间的竞争关系，聚焦于具有理想但动量依赖量子几何的Aharonov-Casher能带，通过提出广义Wigner晶体的尝试波函数并与其能量对比，绘制了填充分数ν=1/m下的相图，发现量子几何控制的零点涨落是决定晶体稳定性的关键机制，从而提出了晶体-液体相边界的量子Lindemann判据。
AI.motivation: Moire材料中分数量子霍尔绝缘体与电子晶体在相近条件下共存，但选择这两种不同物态的微观机制尚不清楚，理解这一竞争关系对预测和控制moire材料中的量子物态至关重要。
AI.method: 作者在具有理想但动量依赖量子几何（Aharonov-Casher能带）的Chern能带中研究竞争问题。具体方法包括：1) 提出广义Wigner晶体的尝试波函数ansatz；2) 将该波函数的能量与竞争的Laughlin类态能量进行比较；3) 以量子几何非均匀程度为参数绘制填充分数ν=1/m下的相图。
AI.result: 研究发现量子几何控制的电荷密度零点涨落（zero point fluctuations）是决定广义Wigner晶体相对稳定性的控制机制，并由此推导出一种类似于Lindemann判据的量子晶体-液体相边界判据。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了量子几何非均匀性通过影响广义Wigner晶体的零点涨落来调控晶体与分数量子霍尔液体之间的竞争，为理解moire材料中的物相选择提供了新的理论框架，并建立了量子Lindemann类判据来描述晶体-液体相边界。

title: Heesch Nodal Lines in Inadmissible Achiral Antiferromagnets
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, and 4 tables, including Supplementary Information
summary: Recently, a new class of Weyl semimetals in antiferromagnets named Heesch Weyl semimetals was discovered, which have inadmissible chiral magnetic point group symmetries (inadmissible magnetic point groups are incompatible with ferromagnetic order) and distinctive surface Fermi arcs. In Heesch Weyl semimetals, the Weyl points are pinned at high symmetry momenta with two-dimensional irreducible corepresentations in the Brillouin zone. As the Weyl points are pinned, the Weyl points with opposite topological charges cannot emerge or be brought together for creation and annihilation as in conventional Weyl semimetals. In this work, we show that when mirror or rotoinversion symmetries are restored so that the point group becomes achiral, long doubly degenerate lines connecting Weyl points with opposite topological charges emerge. We call these lines the Heesch nodal lines (HNLs) and their host materials the Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets. HNLs result in a large number of two-dimensional massless Dirac cones for planes intercepting the HNLs in the Brillouin zone. Moreover, a large subset of the HNL antiferromagnets has the special property that the lowest nonvanishing order of the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect starts with the third order. First-principles calculations on representative collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnets, such as MnTe, CrSb, and Mn$_3$GaN, confirm our predictions on the presence of HNLs. When the inadmissible symmetry is broken by strain, the double degeneracy of the HNLs is lifted and the associated massless Dirac cones are gapped out, providing a route to realizing sizable anomalous Hall effects in antiferromagnetic crystals. We conclude that all inadmissible antiferromagnets without parity-time symmetry are topological. They are either Heesch Weyl antiferromagnets or Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类新的拓扑材料——Heesch nodal line反铁磁体（HNL反铁磁体）。当手性磁点群中恢复镜面或旋转反演对称性而变成非手性时，会出现连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并线（Heesch nodal lines, HNLs）。这些线在布里渊区中产生大量二维无质量Dirac锥，且其中很大一部分HNL反铁磁体的最低阶非线性反常霍尔效应从三阶开始。第一性原理计算在MnTe、CrSb和Mn₃GaN等代表性反铁磁体中证实了HNL的存在。应变打破该对称性会打开能隙，为实现可观的反常霍尔效应提供途径。
AI.motivation: 近期发现的Heesch Weyl半金属中，Weyl点被钉扎在高对称动量点，具有二维不可约共表示，因此相反拓扑荷的Weyl点无法像常规Weyl半金属那样产生和湮灭。作者希望探究当点群变为非手性（恢复镜面或旋转反演对称性）时，拓扑性质会发生什么变化，从而发现一类新的拓扑物态。
AI.method: 作者从对称性分析出发，证明当镜面或旋转反演对称性恢复使点群变为非手性时，会形成连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并线——Heesch nodal lines（HNLs）。他们分析了HNL导致的二维无质量Dirac锥，并研究了非线性反常霍尔效应的最低非零阶次。通过第一性原理计算，在MnTe、CrSb和Mn₃GaN等共线和非共线反铁磁体中验证了HNL的存在，并展示了应变对HNL双重简并和Dirac锥的破坏效应。
AI.result: 第一性原理计算证实了MnTe、CrSb和Mn₃GaN中存在Heesch nodal lines。HNLs产生大量二维无质量Dirac锥。大量HNL反铁磁体的最低非零非线性反常霍尔效应阶次为三阶。应变打破不可允许对称性后，HNL双重简并被解除，Dirac锥被打开能隙，可实现可观的反常霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 所有没有宇称-时间（PT）对称性的不可允许反铁磁体都是拓扑的，它们要么是Heesch Weyl反铁磁体，要么是Heesch nodal line反铁磁体。HNL反铁磁体为研究二维无质量Dirac费米子和高阶非线性反常霍尔效应提供了新的平台。

title: Extrinsic orbital Edelstein effect from asymmetric scattering
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. We invite comments and feedback
summary: The generation and manipulation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) by an external electric field constitute one of the central themes of orbitronics. In particular, the electrically induced nonequilibrium OAM polarization, known as the orbital Edelstein effect (OEE), has attracted considerable attention in recent years. While the intrinsic band-geometric mechanism and the role of conventional symmetric impurity scattering in the OEE are well understood, the contribution from disorder-induced asymmetric scattering remains unclear. Here, we develop a semiclassical theory that separates the OEE into intrinsic, Drude, side-jump, and third- and fourth-order skew-scattering channels. Unlike the Drude channel, the intrinsic, side-jump, and skew-scattering responses survive only in systems with broken time-reversal symmetry. We find that in a magnetized Rashba two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), these disorder-induced mechanisms can substantially exceed the intrinsic contribution. Remarkably, we find that for a system with Rashba coupling of $1$ $eV Å$, the orbital magnetization is about one order of magnitude larger than the spin magnetization for the chosen parameters, highlighting the crucial role of orbital degrees of freedom in the Edelstein effect.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了半经典理论，将轨道Edelstein效应（OEE）分解为内禀、Drude、side-jump及三阶和四阶斜散射通道。研究发现，在破缺时间反演对称性的系统中，无序诱导的散射机制可显著超过内禀贡献，且在Rashba二维电子气中轨道磁化可比自旋磁化大约一个数量级。
AI.motivation: OEE的电学诱导非平衡轨道角动量极化受到广泛关注，但以往研究主要关注内禀能带几何机制和常规对称杂质散射，无序诱导的不对称散射对OEE的贡献尚不清楚。
AI.method: 发展了半经典理论框架，将OEE系统分解为内禀、Drude、side-jump以及三阶和四阶斜散射等不同通道，并应用于磁化的Rashba二维电子气模型进行分析。
AI.result: 在磁化Rashba二维电子气中，无序诱导机制可大幅超过内禀贡献；当Rashba耦合为1 eV Å时，选区参数下轨道磁化比自旋磁化大约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 轨道自由度在Edelstein效应中扮演了至关重要的角色，无序诱导的散射机制对OEE的贡献不可忽视，对轨道电子学（orbitronics）的理论理解具有重要意义。

title: Exciton multipolarity controls coherent and squeezed phonons in van der Waals heterostructures
summary: Photoexcitation-driven changes in the electronic distribution displace atoms, generating coherent phonons on ultrafast timescales. Two-dimensional (2D) materials and their heterostructures offer a powerful platform for engineering these phonons. Yet, despite the widespread observation of photoexcited coherent phonons, a design principle for controlling their character remains elusive. Here, using detailed atomistic simulations of multilayers of alternating MoSe$_2$ and WSe$_2$, we reveal exciton multipolarity as a design principle for tuning photoinduced phonons from coherent to squeezed. These phonons are interlayer breathing modes, with dipolar excitons coupling linearly to generate coherent states and quadrupolar excitons coupling quadratically to produce squeezed states. Moreover, an out-of-plane electric field enables switch-like control, converting quadrupolar excitons into dipolar excitons and switching the phonon state from squeezed to coherent. For example, in trilayer WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$, the photoexcited 1.04-THz breathing mode switches from a squeezed state at zero field to a coherent state under an applied vertical field. Experimentally, these phonon states can be directly probed by ultrafast X-ray or electron diffraction and indirectly through transient reflectivity. Our results open new avenues for ultrafast control of lattice and electronic dynamics on picosecond timescales, with implications for THz quantum phononics, nanophotonic technologies, and quantum-noise-limited sensing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过原子级模拟MoSe₂/WSe₂多层异质结构，揭示"激子多极性"可作为调控光激发相干声子态（从相干态到压缩态）的设计原则，并发现外电场可实现声子态的开关式调控。
AI.motivation: 尽管二维材料中光激发相干声子已被广泛观测，但缺乏控制其性质（如相干态vs压缩态）的设计原则，限制了太赫兹量子声子学等领域的应用。
AI.method: 对MoSe₂和WSe₂交替堆叠的多层异质结构进行详细原子级模拟，分析激子多极性（偶极子与四极子）与层间呼吸模声子的耦合机制及电场调控效应。
AI.result: 发现偶极激子线性耦合产生相干声子态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩声子态；垂直电场可将四极激子转化为偶极激子，实现声子态从压缩到相干的切换。如在WSe₂/MoSe₂/WSe₂三层结构中，1.04THz呼吸模可在零场压缩态与有场相干态间切换。
AI.conclusion: 激子多极性为控制光致声子态提供了全新设计原则，开辟了皮秒尺度晶格与电子动力学超快调控的新途径，对太赫兹量子声子学、纳米光子学和量子噪声极限传感具有重要意义。

title: Hydrodynamics of two-dimensional electrons due to scattering by disorder
summary: The hydrodynamic regime of electron transport, induced by fast inter-electron collisions, was discovered in high-quality nanostructures in recent ten years. However, signs of hydrodynamic transport, primarily, the giant negative magnetoresistance, were observed even at very low temperatures, when electron-electron scattering is too weak to affect the transport. To address this puzzle, here we develop a theory of mixed, hydrodynamic and non-Markovian, magnetotransport of two-dimensional electrons at zero temperature in samples with weak but still important disorder. Namely, we account for both the memory effects at electron scattering by localized defects in magnetic field and an unconventional viscosity effect due to electron scattering by defects in bulk and by rough sample edges. Solution of the model yields a strong negative magnetoresistance, which exhibits at zero magnetic field a sharp maximum in narrower samples or a blunt maximum in wider samples. This and other our results explain various properties of the giant negative magnetoresistance observed on ultra-high-quality GaAs quantum wells, thereby we apparently reveal the nature of low-temperature magnetotransport in these systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合理论模型，将流体动力学与非马尔可夫输运机制结合，解释超高质量GaAs量子阱中极低温度下观测到的巨大负磁阻现象，并通过考虑缺陷散射的记忆效应和非传统粘性效应成功复现了实验观测的各种特性。
AI.motivation: 电子输运的流体动力学机制通常需要强电子-电子散射，但实验在极低温度下仍观测到巨大负磁阻，此时电子-电子散射太弱无法支持流体动力学传输，这一矛盾亟需理论解释。
AI.method: 在零温度下建立二维电子的混合磁输运理论，同时纳入两个关键效应：（1）缺陷散射时的记忆效应（非马尔可夫过程），（2）由体缺陷和粗糙边缘散射引起的非常规粘性效应；构建包含弱无序的模型并数值求解。
AI.result: 模型求解得到强负磁阻现象，在零磁场下窄样品呈现尖锐极大值而宽样品呈现钝极大值；结果能解释超高质量GaAs量子阱中观测到的巨大负磁阻的各种特性。
AI.conclusion: 该理论揭示了这些系统中低温磁输运的本质，表明巨大负磁阻无需依赖强电子-电子散射即可产生，解决了流体动力学输运理论在极低温下的适用性矛盾。

title: Experimentally constrained modeling of the Pockels response of KNbO3 and KTaNbO3
summary: The soft-mode of electro-optic (EO) metal-oxide perovskites plays a critical role in determining their Pockels responses. This is the case of potassium tantalate niobate (KTN), which exhibits an intrinsic Pockels response 2.5 times larger than that of state-of-the-art barium titanate (BTO), highlighting its potential for high-performance EO applications. By combining ab initio calculations at the density-functional theory level and far-IR measurements, we reveal that the harmonic approximation combined with semi-local exchange-correlation functionals fails to accurately capture the soft transverse optical (TO) Slater mode of both potassium niobate and KTN, which dominates the technologically relevant r51 Pockels coefficient. Replacing the calculated mode frequency with its measured value provides an experimentally constrained approach that substantially improves the predicted Pockels response. For that purpose, the previously unreported TO Slater-mode frequency of KTN is extracted from far-IR reflectivity measurements. The results emphasize the potential of KTN-based EO modulators as an alternative to standard lithium niobate and BTO technologies, with a potentially lower energy consumption and device footprint.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过结合从头算（DFT级别）与远红外测量，揭示了谐波近似结合半局域交换关联泛函无法准确捕捉KTN和铌酸钾中主导r51 Pockels系数的软TO Slater模频率。通过实验测量的Slater模频率替换计算值，可显著改进Pockels响应的预测，并首次从远红外反射率测量中提取了KTN的TO Slater模频率。研究表明KTN电光调制器有望成为铌酸锂和钛酸钡技术的低能耗替代方案。
AI.motivation: KTN具有比BTO大2.5倍的内在Pockels响应，极具电光应用潜力，但理论计算无法准确预测其Pockels系数，需要理解理论方法的局限并发展改进方案。
AI.method: 结合DFT级别的从头算和远红外反射率测量；采用实验约束方法（用实测Slater模频率替换理论计算值）来改进Pockels响应预测；测量了此前未报道的KTN的TO Slater模频率。
AI.result: 发现谐波近似+半局域泛函不能准确描述KN和KTN的软TO Slater模（该模主导r51系数）；实验约束方法显著改善了Pockels响应预测；成功提取了KTN的Slater模频率；确认KTN具有替代铌酸锂和BTO技术的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 计算-实验结合的方法是准确预测软模主导电光材料Pockels响应的有效策略，KTN基电光调制器有望实现更低能耗和更小器件占地，是下一代电光器件的有力候选。

title: Hierarchical automation of scanning probe microscopy through agentic orchestration and algorithmic control
summary: Rapid advances in agentic artificial intelligence enable scientific systems to interpret open-ended objectives, combine heterogeneous information, invoke specialized tools, and revise experimental strategies as evidence accumulates. However, physical experimentation also contains many tasks for which agentic reasoning provides little advantage and can reduce reliability. Quantitative analysis, optimization, spatial targeting, validation, and instrument execution are often better posed as deterministic or algorithmic operations with explicit objectives and verifiable outputs. Here, we introduce a hierarchical architecture for autonomous experimentation that separates these roles. Agentic components interpret scientific intent, construct task-dependent experimental representations, evaluate accumulated evidence, and select high-level actions, whereas deterministic algorithms perform numerical analysis, coordinate selection, validation, and physical execution. We implement this architecture in piezoresponse force microscopy. Starting from a broad scientific question concerning the relation between local domain structure and polarization switching, the system constructs spatial descriptors from multichannel imaging, selects and analyzes local hysteresis measurements, adapts the spectroscopy waveform, and terminates the experiment when additional measurements cease to provide new evidence. The autonomous trajectory also identifies a confounding relationship between polarization state and domain-wall proximity and recognizes that the requested contrast is not independently represented within the available field of view. These results demonstrate a route toward scientific autonomy in which agents determine what evidence is required while algorithms determine how that evidence is acquired reproducibly and within validated physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层架构用于自主实验，将智能体组件与确定性算法分离：智能体负责科学意图解读、证据评估和高层行动选择，而确定性算法负责数值分析、坐标选择、验证和物理执行。该架构在压电响应力显微镜中实现，系统能够从广泛的科学问题出发自主构建空间描述符、选择和分析局部迟滞测量、自适应调整光谱波形，并在证据不再增加时终止实验，展示了一条将"智能体决定需要什么证据"与"算法决定如何可靠获取证据"相结合的科学自主性路径。
AI.motivation: 尽管智能体AI在开放性目标解读和实验策略修订方面有优势，但物理实验中许多任务（定量分析、优化、空间定位、验证、仪器执行）更适合用确定性或算法化操作来处理，因为后者具有明确目标和可验证输出。将两者粗暴混合会降低可靠性，因此需要一种能将智能体推理与确定性算法各自优势结合的分层架构。
AI.method: 提出分层自主实验架构：上层为智能体组件，负责解读科学意图、构建任务相关的实验表征、评估累积证据、选择高层行动；下层为确定性算法，负责数值分析、坐标选择、验证和物理执行。该架构在压电响应力显微镜（PFM）中实现，从多通道成像构建空间描述符，选择并分析局部迟滞测量，自适应光谱波形，并基于证据增益决定实验终止。
AI.result: 系统自主完成了从科学问题到实验终止的完整轨迹，识别出极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混杂关系，并发现所请求的对比度在可用视野内未被独立表征。实验在证据不再增加时自主终止。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一条通往科学自主性的可行路线：智能体决定需要何种证据（科学问题层面），算法决定如何可靠地在已验证的物理约束下获取这些证据（执行层面），从而实现既灵活又可靠的自主实验系统。

title: Synthesis and Characterization of Compositionally Complex (Gd/Ho/Er/Dy)2Zr2O7 Thin Film Combinatorial Library
summary: High-throughput synthesis and characterization of novel ceramic materials with improved thermomechanical properties and phase stability are needed to accelerate the discovery of next-generation thermal barrier materials. A combinatorial thin film material library of (GdDyHoEr)2Zr2O7 were created via combinatorial magnetron reactive sputtering with rare-earth/zirconium alloy targets. Structural, chemical, and thermal property characterization mapping across the four component composition space was performed and correlated with thermal transport measurements. Steady state thermoreflectance mapping identifies a pronounced minimum in thermal conductivity within the Dy/Gd-rich quadrant. This minimum does not coincide with either the equiatomic composition or the region predicted to exhibit maximum cation size disorder. Instead, it corresponds to the largest experimentally observed lattice parameter, despite deviating from Vegard-like chemical averaging, and is independent of grain size and whole-pattern microstrain. These observations suggest that the way the fluorite lattice accommodates compositional complexity, rather than cation size disorder alone, provides a more informative descriptor of thermal transport. Overall, this work establishes a high-throughput workflow for combinatorial thin-film synthesis and multimodal characterization, enabling the rapid identification of previously inaccessible structure-property relationships in compositionally complex ceramics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过组合磁控反应溅射技术合成了(GdDyHoEr)2Zr2O7高熵烧绿石材料库，结合多种表征手段绘制了成分-性能图谱，发现热导率最小值出现在Dy/Gd富集区域而非阳离子尺寸无序度最大区域，揭示晶格对成分复杂性的容纳方式而非阳离子尺寸无序度是热输运的更有效描述符。
AI.motivation: 下一代热障涂层材料需要具有优异热机械性能和相稳定性的新型陶瓷材料，但传统单点试错法效率低下，亟需高通量方法加速发现成分复杂陶瓷中的结构-性能关系。
AI.method: 采用组合磁控反应溅射（使用稀土/锆合金靶）制备(GdDyHoEr)2Zr2O7四组分薄膜材料库，结合结构与化学表征，利用稳态热反射（thermoreflectance）技术进行全成分空间的热输运映射。
AI.result: 热导率最小值位于Dy/Gd富集象限，既不与等原子成分重合，也不与预测的阳离子尺寸无序度最大区域对应，而是与实验观测到的最大晶格参数一致（尽管偏离Vegard平均规律），且与晶粒尺寸和微应变无关。
AI.conclusion: 氟石晶格容纳成分复杂性的方式（而非单纯的阳离子尺寸无序度）是热输运的更有效描述符；该工作建立了组合薄膜合成与多模态表征的高通量工作流程，可加速成分复杂陶瓷中结构-性能关系的发现。

title: Strengthened Silicate Glasses by Residual Stress: Depth of Compression and Surface Flaws Stability Conditions
comment: 35 pages, 15 figures, 6 tables, 27 equations, 1 appndix with 10 equations, 27 references
summary: The application of silicate glasses in severe service environments requires a precise evaluation of structural strength under mechanical loads and surface tribological conditions. Because glass strength is governed by surface flaws and microcracks rather than being an intrinsic material property, residual surface compression fields, balanced by interior tensile zones, are widely implemented to inhibit flaw opening. Rather than relying on conventional allowable stress criteria to establish product acceptance, this study adopts a fracture mechanics framework based on the stress intensity factor KI and fundamental material limits: the critical stress intensity factor KIC for rapid fracture and the threshold stress intensity factor KIth for time-delayed static fatigue failure. Using the Weight Function Method (WFM), KI is evaluated across generic surface flaw depths for two-dimensional continuous (2D-Continuous) surface cracks subjected to non-uniform internal residual stress fields and external loads. Flaw stability criteria are established for both zero-risk and moderate-risk design methodologies. Finally, the interaction and superposition of externally applied mechanical and thermal stresses with internal residual stress fields are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于断裂力学的框架来评估硅酸盐玻璃在严苛服役环境中的结构强度，利用应力强度因子KI及材料极限参数（KIC和KIth），通过权函数法（WFM）评估二维连续表面裂纹在非均匀残余应力场和外部载荷作用下的裂纹稳定性，并建立了零风险和中风险两种设计方法。
AI.motivation: 硅酸盐玻璃在严苛服役环境中的强度受表面缺陷和微裂纹控制而非材料固有属性，传统容许应力准则不足以准确评估产品可靠性，需要采用更精确的断裂力学框架来评估裂纹扩展风险并指导产品验收设计。
AI.method: 采用基于应力强度因子KI和材料极限（临界应力强度因子KIC用于快速断裂、阈值应力强度因子KIth用于延迟静态疲劳失效）的断裂力学框架；使用权函数法（WFM）评估非均匀内部残余应力场和外部载荷作用下的一般表面裂纹深度的KI；建立零风险和中风险设计方法的裂纹稳定性准则，并评估外部机械应力、热应力与内部残余应力场的交互与叠加效应。
AI.result: 通过权函数法定量评估了残余压应力场与外部载荷共同作用下表面裂纹尖端的应力强度因子，建立了基于KI与KIC/KIth对比的缺陷稳定性判据，并明确了机械应力、热应力与残余应力场叠加时的失效边界条件。
AI.conclusion: 该断裂力学方法为玻璃产品在复杂载荷和严苛环境下的结构完整性评估提供了更科学的框架，替代传统容许应力准则，实现零风险与中风险两种级别的产品设计验收标准。
